Oh. I'm sorry. I didn't
realize you were carrying
a pass and had authorization.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
站住——！
啊，抱歉，我沒注意到您帶著通行證，而且持有許可。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Recently too many people
have been traveling between
Uptown and the ghetto, so
we've heightened security
around here. But how can
so many sneak through us?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
最近有太多人在裡希塔樂鎮上城區和貧民窟之間往返，所以我們加強了這裡的安保。
但為什麼還是有這麼多能溜進來？

ZZZzzzzzzzzzz... Zzz...

現在是溜過去的好機會！^000000

to enter the slums.
Go back to where you
came from, adventurer!
scripts.translation:

站住！
我不能讓任何人進入貧民窟。
回你來的地方去，冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Hold it right there!
I can't permit anyone to
enter Uptown Lighthalzen!
If you don't have a pass,
then move on out of here!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
站住！
我不能讓任何人進入裡希塔樂鎮上城區！
如果沒有通行證，就趕緊離開這裡！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Oh hey, it's you!
Now, listen. If you wanna
get into Regenschirm again,
you gotta enter that Sewer Pipe
that's like, northeast from me.
It's gross, but you gotta...
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
哦，是你啊！
聽著，如果你想再次進入雷根席爾姆，就從我東北方向的下水道管道進去。
雖然很噁心，但你必須去...

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Anyway, good luck in
whatever it is you're doing
here in Lighthalzen. Oh, and
be real careful! Something
shadier than me is going
on in this big city~
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
總之，祝你在裡希塔樂鎮這裡做什麼都順利。哦，對了，一定要小心！
這座大城市裡有些比我更陰暗的事在發生~

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
What...?
Is there something
on my face? Quit looking
at me and let me do my work.
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
什...？
我臉上有什麼嗎？
別盯著我看，讓我專心工作。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Hey. Hey you.
You're still looking
at me. Quit it. I'm busy
here and you're bothering me.
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
喂。喂，你。
你還在盯著我看。
別這樣。我這邊正忙著呢，你在打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Seriously, you are
starting to really get
on my nerves! What could
you possibly want from me?!
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
說真的，你真是越來越讓我煩了！
你到底想從我這裡得到什麼？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nothing really.
I just feel like
watching you work.
What exactly are you
doing anyway, huh?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒什麼。
我只是想看看你工作。
你具體在做什麼，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Hey! If I could just show
you what I'm doing, I wouldn't
be so uptight about you looking
at what I'm doing, now would I?
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
嘿！如果我能直接給你看我在做什麼，我也不會這麼介意你盯著我看了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nah...
I just think
you're uptight
in general.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不...
我只是覺得你平時就很緊張。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Muthafruit!
So you're just
gonna sit and watch
me all day?! Fine! Then
I'll just ignore you, jerk!
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
Muthafruit!
你就打算整天坐在這裡看我工作嗎？！好吧，那我就不理你了，混蛋！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
...
......
Damn it!
This is really
ticking me off! Why
don't you go away?!
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
...
...
該死！
這真的讓我很火大！
你為什麼不離開？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I was also
wondering why you're
working in a place that's
so, um... depressing.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實，我也在想，你為什麼要在一個這麼...壓抑的地方工作。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Alright, fine!
But once I tell you
what I do here, you're
outta here! Okay? Now,
your lips are frickin' sealed.
See, what I do is kinda illegal.
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
好吧，行！
但我告訴你我在這裡做什麼之後，你就得離開！明白嗎？
現在，你可得把嘴閉嚴實了。
我做的事有點違法。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
I provide routes that let
people enter Lighthalzen,
or even go anywhere in this
city, without authorization.
Hell, I could even get you
into that Laboratory...
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
我提供路線，讓人們在沒有許可的情況下進入裡希塔樂鎮，甚至去這座城市的任何地方。
天哪，我甚至能把你帶進那個實驗室...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W-wait!
Laboratory?!
Are you serious?
Can you get me
into that place?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等！
實驗室？！
你是認真的嗎？
你能帶我進去那個地方嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Sonuva--You're not
gonna leave me alone,
are you? Look, you seem
okay, even if you are kinda
stubborn, kid. But I don't trust
or serve strangers, period.
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
該死——你就不打算放過我嗎？
聽著，你看起來還算不錯，雖然有點固執，小鬼。但我絕不信任陌生人，也不會為陌生人做事。就這樣。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But isn't there
anything I can do
so you can help me
get into the Laboratory?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是，有沒有什麼我能做的，讓你願意幫我進入實驗室？

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
No way, no how.
No matter how much you
beg, I can't take a chance
and just trust anyone who
wants to know a secret
route. Now get outta here!
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
絕對不行。
不管你怎麼求，我都不可能冒險去信任任何想要知道秘密路線的人。
現在給我滾！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please...
Please tell me
how I can get inside
the Laboratory. I'm...
I'm begging you!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
求你了...
求你告訴我怎麼進入實驗室。我...
我在求你了！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
No! Now shaddup
and stop begging, okay?
You're only embarassing
yourself! Good grief...
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
不！
閉嘴，別求了，好嗎？
你只是在丟人現眼！
真是夠了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why won't you
heeeeelp meee?
Pleeeeeeeease~
You're the only one
who knoooooows~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你為什麼不幫幫我呢？
求求你了~
只有你知道方法~

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Yeesh, you're a nutty
kid. Look, ''no'' means
''no.'' That's it. That's
final. How many times do
you gotta make me spell it out?
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
天哪，你真是個怪小孩。
聽著，“不”就是“不”。
就這樣，這是最終決定。
我要說多少遍你才肯明白？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But there's gotta
be something I can
do so you'll help me?
Th-that's the way i-it
always w-works. You
can't just-- You c-can't...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是肯定有什麼辦法能讓你幫我吧？
這...這向來都是...這樣做的。
你不能就這樣——你...你不能...

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Alright, you got me.
But if I'm gonna risk
my life to help you get
into that Laboratory I want
something in return. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
好吧，你說服我了。
但如果我要冒生命危險幫你進入那個實驗室，我需要得到一些回報。
好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
All you need to do is
come back here with
^FF000071,381,305,294,921,000 zeny^000000.
Then I'll give you all the help
you need. Alright, good luck
to you, brave adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
你只需要帶著
^FF000071,381,305,294,921,000 Zeny^000000
回到這裡。
然後我會給你你需要的所有幫助。
好了，祝你好運，勇敢的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're joking right?!
There's no way I can ever
get that much zeny! I'd...
I'd have to at least take
over the world or, or...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在開玩笑吧？！
我怎麼可能弄到那麼多Zeny！
我...
我至少得統治世界才行，或者...

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Good point.
Fine, maybe that
price is a little high.
I'll just cut it in half,
then. Still want my
help? Then bring me...
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
有道理。
好吧，也許那個價格有點高。
那我就減半吧。
還想要我的幫助嗎？
那就給我帶來...

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
 
 
...^FF000020 Jellopy^000000.

[Fishbone]
Gosh.
It's like I'm
doing this for free...
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
天哪。
感覺我是在免費幫忙一樣...

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: No! It's impossible!
scripts.translation: 不！不可能！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Alright, then
bring me back a
total of 20 Jellopy.
But you gotta have
exactly 20 Jellopy on
you, okay? Seeya pal~
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
好吧，那就給我帶來總共20個傑勒比結晶。
但你身上必須正好有
20個傑勒比結晶，好嗎？
再見了，朋友~

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
What are you--
Okay, now you're the
one who's joking around.
Look, it's either bring me
20 Jellopy or 71,381,3--
whatever number I said-- zeny!
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
你想幹什麼——
好吧，現在輪到你開玩笑了。
聽著，要麼給我
20個傑勒比結晶，要麼給我
71,381,3——
不管我說了多少——Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
So...
Did you bring
the stuff?
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
那麼...
你帶來東西了嗎？

scripts.text: I'm still working on it.
scripts.translation: 我還在準備中

scripts.text: Here you go!
scripts.translation: 給你！

scripts.text: Um... Stuff?
scripts.translation: 呃...什麼東西？

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Still working on it?
Okay, I know I didn't
ask you for very much,
but gimme some respect
and get serious about it!
It's 20 friggin' Jellopies!
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
還在準備中？
好吧，我知道我沒讓你帶多少東西，但你得給我點尊重，認真點啊！
那可是20個該死的傑勒比結晶！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Uh...
I said 20 Jellopies,
didn't I? This ain't
enough pal, so go out
and get some more!
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
呃...
我說了要20個傑勒比結晶，對吧？這不夠啊，朋友，快出去再弄點來！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Ooh. Hey, good work.
Okay, I can see you're
the reliable type. A deal
is a deal, so I'll tell you
how you can get inside
that Laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
哦。嘿，幹得不錯。
看來你是個靠譜的人。
既然答應了，我就告訴你怎麼進入那個實驗室。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Now, if you're wondering
why I don't got much qualm
against helping you, it's
because I used to work in
the Laboratory... But then
they laid me off unfairly.
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
如果你想知道我為什麼這麼樂意幫你，那是因為我以前在實驗室工作過...
但他們不公平地解僱了我。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Anyway, anything I can
do to cause them trouble
is good in my book. Let me
get some stuff ready and
then I'll tell you what you
really need to know.
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
總之，任何能給他們添麻煩的事我都樂意做。讓我準備點東西，然後我會告訴你你真正需要知道的事情。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
What the...?
How could you forget
something like that?
Anyway, I asked you to
bring 20 Jellopies.
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
什麼...？
你怎麼能忘了這種事？
總之，我讓你帶20個傑勒比結晶。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
way to get into Regenschrim
Lab. However, I do know of
this secret maze that should
get you there. Still, if you're
willing and ready to go...
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
進入雷根席爾姆實驗室的方法。
不過，我知道一個秘密迷宮，應該能帶你到那裡。不過，如果你願意並準備好了的話...

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Okay...
Are you ready now?
I'm gonna send you
someplace where you
can find the Lab entrance.
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
好吧...
你準備好了嗎？
我要把你送到一個能找到實驗室入口的地方。

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 還沒有準備好

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Eh...?
Alright, it's
not a problem.
Just take your time.
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
呃...？
好吧，沒關係。
慢慢來就好。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Great!
Okay then,
here we go!
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
太好了！
那麼，我們出發吧！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Hm, you must not have
accomplished whatever
it is you need to do in the
Regenschirm Laboratory yet.
you want me to send
you there again?
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
嗯，看來你還沒在雷根席爾姆實驗室完成你需要做的事情。
你想讓我再把你送過去一次嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Hm, you must not have
accomplished whatever
it was you were doing
in the Laboratory. Do
you want me to send
you there again?
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
嗯，看來你還沒在實驗室完成你正在做的事情。
你想讓我再把你送過去一次嗎？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Geez, you must have
really had a hard time
there. Okay, well, when
you're ready to go there,
just let me know, got it?
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
天哪，看來你在那邊真的過得很艱難。好吧，當你準備好再去那裡時，告訴我一聲，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Got a lot of
spirit in you,
don't you? Heh!
I like you style~
Get ready, 'cuz
here we go...!
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
你很有幹勁，不是嗎？嘿！
我喜歡你的風格~
準備好，因為我們要出發了...！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Hey, you came back!
Good, I was starting
to get a little worried
about what happened to
you. So did you get what
you wanted over there?
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
嘿，你回來了！
很好，我開始有點擔心你出什麼事了。
那麼，你在那邊拿到你想要的東西了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeah...
I hope so,
anyway.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的...
至少，我希望如此。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Good! Whatever you did,
I hope it messes them up big
time! I usedta be a respected
scientist for Regenschirm till
they laid me off! Serves those
ungrateful jerkoffs right!
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
很好！不管做了什麼，我希望這會讓他們大受打擊！我曾經是雷根席爾姆受人尊敬的科學家，直到他們解僱了我！
那些忘恩負義的混蛋活該！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Then again, my current
line of work seems to suit
me much better. And I don't
gotta worry about formulas
and algorithms anymore.
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
不過話說回來，我現在的工作似乎更適合我。
而且我不再需要擔心公式和演算法了。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Oh yeah, the place you
just went to? There's a
secret path the Laboratory
there. If you want, I can
send you back there. So
what do you say?
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
哦對了，你剛才去的地方？那裡有一條通往實驗室的秘密通道。
如果你願意，我可以再把你送過去。怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: No thanks~
scripts.translation: 不用了~

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Okay then, here
we go! Good luck
to you, buddy.
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
好的，那我們出發吧！祝你好運，夥計。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Alright, it's your
choice. Oh, and that
pass you have should
let you into the Laboratory
anyway. Good luck to you, pal.
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
好吧，隨你。哦，對了，你手裡的那張通行證應該能讓你進入實驗室。祝你好運，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Heya pal!
It's been a while.
You doin' good? I'm
just peachy, thanks~
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
嘿，朋友！
好久不見。
你過得還好嗎？我一切都好，謝謝~

scripts.text:
Hey kid, get
outta here! Can't
you tell I'm dealin'
in something shady
here? This is no place
for baby faced guys like you!
scripts.translation:
嘿，小鬼，快滾開！
看不出我正在做見不得人的勾當嗎？
這裡可不是你們這種娃娃臉能來的地方！

scripts.text:
[Fishbone]
Heya pal!
It's been a while.
You doin' good? I'm
just peachy, thanks~
scripts.translation:
[魚骨]
嘿，朋友！
好久不見。
你過得還好嗎？我一切都好，謝謝~

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are a bunch
of files scattered
on the ground.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF地上散落著一堆檔案。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are a bunch
of files scattered
on the ground. They
seem to contain all
sorts of information,
but they're all mixed up.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地上散落著一堆檔案。
它們似乎包含各種各樣的資訊，但全都混在一起了。^000000

scripts.text: Rummage through the files.
scripts.translation: 翻找檔案

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhile you are
rummaging through
the files, a Red Key
drops to the ground
with a clink. You decide
to keep this ^000000Red Key^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FFWhile you are
rummaging through
the files, a Red Key
drops to the ground
with a 叮. You decide
to keep this ^000000Red Key^3355FF.^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the place
where you found the
^000000Red Key^3355FF while you were
looking through the files
scattered on the ground.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡是你之前在翻找散落在地上的檔案時找到^000000紅色鑰匙^3355FF的地方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the place
where you found the
^000000Red Key^3355FF while you were
looking through the files
scattered on the ground.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡是你之前在翻找散落在地上的檔案時找到^000000紅色鑰匙^3355FF的地方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis picture hanging
on the wall catches
your attention for some
inexplicably strange reason.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF掛在牆上的這幅畫不知為何引起了你的注意。^000000

scripts.text: Look behind picture.
scripts.translation: 看看畫後面

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou push and pull
with all your strength,
but the picture won't
budge. If it's too hard
to move, there must be
something hidden behind it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你使出全身的力氣推拉，但這幅畫紋絲不動。
如果它這麼難移動，後面一定藏著什麼東西。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis picture hanging
on the wall catches
your attention for some
inexplicably strange reason.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF掛在牆上的這幅畫不知為何引起了你的注意。^000000

scripts.text: Look behind picture.
scripts.translation: 看看畫後面

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou push and pull
with all your strength,
but this picture is too
hard to move with just
brute strength alone.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你使出全身的力氣推拉，但這幅畫太重了，光靠蠻力是移不動的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou take the
Jackknife, thrust
it under the picture
and twist it in order to
pry the picture off the wall.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你拿出小刀，把它塞到畫下面，然後轉動刀身，試圖把畫從牆上撬下來。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFBehind the picture, you
find that the following
numbers are written:^000000
 
4 3 2 9 1 6 8 2 7
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在畫的後面，你發現寫著以下數字：^000000
 
4 3 2 9 1 6 8 2 7

scripts.text:
^3355FFBehind the picture, you
find that the following
numbers are written:^000000
 
3 6 4 1 2 8 7 1 5
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在畫的後面，你發現寫著以下數字：^000000
 
3 6 4 1 2 8 7 1 5

scripts.text:
^3355FFBehind the picture, you
find that the following
numbers are written:^000000
 
4 9 3 7 6 2 8 6 6
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在畫的後面，你發現寫著以下數字：^000000
 
4 9 3 7 6 2 8 6 6

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately,
doing that apparently
wasn't enough to move
the picture. Perhaps you
should try something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF不幸的是，這樣做顯然不足以移動這幅畫。
也許你應該試試別的方法。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe following numbers
were written behind the
picture. If they were hidden,
these numbers must have
some kind of importance.^000000
 
4 3 2 9 1 6 8 2 7
scripts.translation:
^3355FF畫的後面寫著以下數字。
既然它們被藏了起來，這些數字一定有著某種重要的意義。^000000
 
4 3 2 9 1 6 8 2 7

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe following numbers
were written behind the
picture. If they were hidden,
these numbers must have
some kind of importance.^000000
 
3 6 4 1 2 8 7 1 5
scripts.translation:
^3355FF畫的後面寫著以下數字。
既然它們被藏了起來，這些數字一定有著某種重要的意義。^000000
 
3 6 4 1 2 8 7 1 5

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe following numbers
were written behind the
picture. If they were hidden,
these numbers must have
some kind of importance.^000000
 
4 9 3 7 6 2 8 6 6
scripts.translation:
^3355FF畫的後面寫著以下數字。
既然它們被藏了起來，這些數字一定有著某種重要的意義。^000000
 
4 9 3 7 6 2 8 6 6

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe following numbers
were written behind the
picture. If they were hidden,
these numbers must have
some kind of importance.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF畫的後面寫著以下數字。既然它們被藏了起來，這些數字一定有某種重要意義。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere is a picture
hanging on the wall.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF牆上掛著一幅畫。^000000

scripts.text: Look beneath picture.
scripts.translation: 檢視畫的下面

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are some
numbers behind the
picture, but now there is
no need to memorize them.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF畫的後面有一些數字，但現在不需要記住它們了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe drawer here
looks interesting,
but it's locked and
you can't open it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡的抽屜看起來很特別，但它上了鎖，你打不開。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF The drawer here
looks interesting, but
it's locked. Hopefully, you
can figure how to open it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡的抽屜看起來很特別，但它上了鎖。
希望你能想辦法開啟它。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou insert the Red Key
into the lock and open the
drawer. Inside, you find a
^000000Jackknife^3355FF that you decide
to take. After all, it might
be handy sometime.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你將紅色鑰匙插入鎖孔，打開了抽屜。裡面有一把^000000小刀^3355FF，你決定把它拿走。畢竟，說不定什麼時候用得上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately, you
can't open or break
the lock on the drawer
by doing that. You need
to try something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF不幸的是，這樣做無法開啟或破壞抽屜上的鎖。
你需要嘗試其他方法。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the drawer
in which you found the
^000000Jackknife^3355FF. It is now empty
and devoid of purpose.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這就是你發現^000000小刀^3355FF的那個抽屜。
現在它空了，也失去了存在的意義。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a chest
with an axe laid on
top. The axe's purpose
is completely utilitarian
and isn't suited for battle.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一個箱子，上面放著一把斧頭。
這把斧頭完全是為了實用而設計的，並不適合戰鬥。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a chest,
but more importantly,
there is a utility Axe
laid on top of it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一個箱子，但更重要的是，上面放著一把實用斧頭。^000000

scripts.text: Take the utility Axe.
scripts.translation: 拿走實用斧頭

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFWithout shame or
an ounce of guilt, you
pick up the utility ^000000Axe^3355FF
and claim it as your own.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你毫無羞恥感，也沒有一絲愧疚，撿起了這把實用^000000斧頭^3355FF，並把它據為己有。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is just a normal
chest. There used to be
a utility ^000000Axe^3355FF on top of
it until you picked it up.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這只是一個普通的箱子。
在你拿走之前，上面放著一把實用^000000斧頭^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have
found a shabbily
constructed barrel.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一個做工粗糙的木桶。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have
found a shabbily
constructed barrel.
You sense that there's
something inside, but
you need something to
smash the barrel open.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一個做工粗糙的木桶。
你感覺到裡面有什麼東西，但你需要某種東西來砸開這個木桶。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAxe in hand, you lift
it above your head and
swing it downwards,
smashing off the top of
the barrel. Inside, you find a
box topped with a metal plate.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你手持斧頭，高舉過頭頂，再猛地向下揮砍，劈開了木桶頂部。裡面有一個箱子，頂部蓋著一塊金屬板。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe numbers one
through nine are
etched on the surface
of the metal plate on
top of the box you found,
like some kind of keypad...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF盒子上方金屬板的表面刻著從1到9的數字，看起來像是某種密碼鍵盤...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFDoing that probably won't
break open this keg. You'll
need to try something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這樣做可能無法開啟這個木桶。
你需要嘗試其他方法。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide to enter
some numbers into the
metallic keypad. Remember,
you can only enter single
digit numbers at one time...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你決定在金屬鍵盤上輸入一些數字。
記住，你一次只能輸入一位數字...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened...^000000

^3355FFYou decide to enter
some numbers into the
numberpad etched on the
metal plate on top of the box
you found inside the keg.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你決定在木桶內盒子上方金屬板刻著的數字鍵盤上輸入一些數字。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe metal plate slides
open and you find a key
Key inside the box. You
to keep this ^000000Yellow Key^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF金屬板滑開了，你在盒子裡發現了一把鑰匙。
你獲得了^000000黃色鑰匙^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened.
It's likely that you did not
enter the correct numbers.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什麼也沒發生。
你輸入的號碼可能不正確。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the box with
the keypad in which you
found the ^000000Yellow Key^3355FF.
The box is now empty.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這就是那個帶有密碼鍵盤的盒子，你之前在裡面找到了^000000黃色鑰匙^3355FF。
現在盒子是空的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is a box
topped with a metal
plate that looks like
a crudely made keypad.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這是一個頂部帶有金屬板的盒子，看起來像是一個粗糙製作的密碼鍵盤。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is a noisily
operating huge machine
with a front panel that has
a strange mark. There is a
keyhole on the machine
right next to this panel.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這是一臺轟隆作響的巨型機器，前面板上有一個奇怪的標記。面板旁邊的機器上有一個鑰匙孔。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened.
You probably need
to find the right key to
insert into the keyhole.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什麼也沒發生。
你可能需要找到正確的鑰匙插入鑰匙孔。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is a noisily
operating huge machine
with a front panel that has
a strange mark. There is a
keyhole on the machine
right next to this panel.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這是一臺正在嘈雜執行的巨大機器，前面板上有奇怪的標記。機器上有一個鑰匙孔，就在這個面板旁邊。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou insert the
Yellow Key into the
keyhole and turn it,
causing the machine
to sputter and deactivate.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你將黃色鑰匙插入鑰匙孔並轉動，機器隨即發出故障般的聲響，然後停止運轉。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou notice that the
^000000Status Light ^3355FFnext to the
bed has now turned off.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你注意到床邊的^000000狀態燈^3355FF現在熄滅了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened.
You probably need
to find the right key to
insert into the keyhole.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什麼也沒發生。
你可能需要找到正確的鑰匙插入鑰匙孔。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFIt's a giant machine.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這是一臺巨大的機器。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe Status Light is
on. It looks like there's
something inside the
bulb, but you can't get
near it since it generates
incredibly scorching heat.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF狀態燈亮著。看起來燈泡裡面有什麼東西，但由於它產生極高的熱量，你無法靠近。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNow, if you could
somehow shut down the
Power Generator in this
room, the bulb would be
cool enough for you to touch...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF現在，如果你能設法關閉這個房間裡的發電機，燈泡就會冷卻到你可以觸控的程度...^000000

scripts.text:
The Status Light
is now off and the
bulb has cooled down.
scripts.translation: 狀態燈現在熄滅了，燈泡已經冷卻。

scripts.text: Smash the light bulb.
scripts.translation: 砸碎燈泡

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou smash the
Status Light's bulb
and discover another key.
You obtained a ^000000Black Key^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你砸碎了狀態燈的燈泡，發現了另一把鑰匙。
你獲得了^000000黑色鑰匙^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find the remains
of a broken light bulb.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一個破碎的燈泡殘骸。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found
a completely
cluttered desk.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一張雜亂無章的桌子。^000000

scripts.text: On the desk
scripts.translation: 桌面上

scripts.text: Under the desk
scripts.translation: 桌子下面

scripts.text: Desk drawer
scripts.translation: 抽屜

scripts.text:
^3355FFVarious documents,
books and lab equipment
are scattered on the desk.
But none of them seem
all that useful right now.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF桌面上散落著各種檔案、書籍和實驗器材。
不過它們現在似乎都沒什麼用。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnder this desk, of
all conceivable places,
you find a ^000000Short Stick^3355FF
that you decide to keep.
You never know when
you'll need one of those.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在所有你能想到的地方中，你竟然在這張桌子下面發現了一根^000000短棍^3355FF，你決定把它收起來。
說不定什麼時候用得上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you
found your ^000000Short Stick^3355FF.
Sadly, there are no more
hidden treasures for you to
discover beneath this desk.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡就是你之前找到^000000短棍^3355FF的地方。
遺憾的是，桌子下面沒有更多隱藏的寶藏供你發現了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe desk drawer is
locked and probably
with good reason. After all,
you just tried to invade this
private and intimate space.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這張桌子的抽屜鎖著，而且很可能有充分的理由。
畢竟，你剛才試圖闖入這個私密的空間。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou're back at the
messy desk which
is probably used by
a high ranking executive
who has someone else
do his desk tidying for him.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你回到了這張雜亂的桌子前，它可能屬於某位高管，而且他肯定有專人幫他整理桌面。^000000

scripts.text: On the desk
scripts.translation: 桌面上

scripts.text: Under the desk
scripts.translation: 桌子下面

scripts.text: Desk drawer
scripts.translation: 抽屜

scripts.text:
^3355FFAlas, no matter how much
you rummage through it,
the clutter on the desk
proves to be useless to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF唉，無論你怎麼翻找，桌面上的雜物對你來說似乎都毫無用處。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAn issue of the
Dancer magazine,
''Harmonic Lick'' catches
your eye, but you really
shouldn't be interested
in that publication just
because of the pictures.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF一本舞者雜誌《和聲樂句》吸引了你的目光，但你真的不應該僅僅因為裡面的圖片就對這本刊物感興趣。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAn issue of the female
entertainment magazine,
''Magnum Break'' catches
your eye, but adventurers
have no time to look at
pictures of beautiful men.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF一本女性娛樂雜誌《Magnum Break》吸引了你的目光，但冒險者可沒時間欣賞俊美男子的照片。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnder the desk, you
discover another Short
Stick which happens to
fit perfectly into the other
Short Stick you found earlier.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在桌子下面，你發現了另一根短棍，它恰好能完美地接在你之前找到的那根短棍上。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou combine the two
lesser sticks to create
a stick that is superior
to the sum of its parts.
You are now the proud
bearer of a ^000000Long Stick^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你將兩根較短的棍子組合起來，創造出了一根超越部分之和的棍子。
你現在自豪地擁有了一根^000000長棍^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis desk drawer is
locked shut and probably
always will be. It's likely
that nothing really valuable
is inside, aside from perhaps
a hip flask or a candy stash.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這張桌子的抽屜鎖得嚴嚴實實，而且可能永遠都打不開。
裡面可能沒有什麼真正值錢的東西，除了也許是一個酒壺或一堆糖果。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis desk is cluttered
with all sorts of random
objects, but such is its
destiny as office equipment.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這張桌子上堆滿了各種雜七雜八的東西，但這正是辦公裝置的宿命。^000000

scripts.text: On the desk
scripts.translation: 桌面上

scripts.text: Under the desk
scripts.translation: 桌子下面

scripts.text: Desk drawer
scripts.translation: 抽屜

scripts.text:
^3355FFAlas, no matter how much
you rummage through it,
the clutter on the desk
proves to be useless to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF唉，無論你怎麼翻找，桌面上的雜物對你來說似乎都毫無用處。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's part of a newspaper
here, but it's only the Comics
section which, of course, isn't
informative enough for world
savvy adventurers like you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡有一份報紙的殘頁，但只有漫畫版塊，當然，這對像你這樣見多識廣的冒險者來說資訊量是不夠的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you found
one of two Short Sticks
to make your ^000000Long Stick^3355FF.
There isn't anything else
under here, so it's impossible
to make your stick any longer.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡是你找到兩根短棍之一用來製作^000000長棍^3355FF的地方。
下面沒有其他東西了，所以你的棍子不可能再變長了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis desk drawer is
locked very securely.
The owner of this desk
was wise to provide a
measure of drawer security.
But why put sticks under the
desk? This is most curious...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這張桌子的抽屜鎖得非常牢固。
這張桌子的主人很明智，採取了抽屜安全措施。
但為什麼要把棍子放在桌子下面？
這太奇怪了...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a bed
in which the sheets
are slovenly arranged.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一張床，床單凌亂地鋪在上面。^000000

scripts.text: On the bed
scripts.translation: 床上

scripts.text: Under the bed
scripts.translation: 床下

scripts.text:
^3355FFNo one's in the bed
and if you climbed in,
you'd just be alone. For
some people, this may
be an immutable truth.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF床上沒有人，如果你爬上去，也只是孤身一人。
對某些人來說，這可能是一個不變的真理。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnder the bed, you
discover a ^000000Short Stick^3355FF
which you decide to
keep. You never know
when certain, seemingly
useless objects will save you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在床下，你發現了一根^000000短棍^3355FF，你決定把它收起來。
你永遠不知道，某些看似無用的物品何時會救你一命。^000000

^3355FFUnder the bed, you
discover another Short
Stick which happens to
fit perfectly into the other
Short Stick you found earlier.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在床下，你發現了另一根短棍，它正好能完美地接在你之前找到的那根短棍上。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou combine the two
lesser sticks to create
a stick that is superior
to the sum of its parts.
You are now the proud
bearer of a ^000000Long Stick^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你將兩根較短的棍子組合起來，創造出了一根超越部分之和的棍子。
你現在自豪地擁有了一根^000000長棍^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIn a distant and
dusty corner beneath
the bed, you manage to
spot an object. If only you
could reach it somehow...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在床下遠處佈滿灰塵的角落裡，你勉強看到了一個物體。
要是能想辦法夠到它就好了...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou try to reach
the object by using
your Short Stick. After
a few attempts, you had no
choice but to admit that your
stick just wasn't long enough.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你試著用短棍去夠那個物體。
嘗試了幾次後，你不得不承認，你的棍子還是不夠長。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately,
whatever you used to
try to reach the object
didn't work. You'll have
to think of something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF很遺憾，無論你用什麼去夠那個物體都沒用。
你得想點別的辦法。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a messy
bed that may be more
than meets the eye.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一張凌亂的床，它可能並不像表面看起來那麼簡單。^000000

scripts.text: On the bed
scripts.translation: 床上

scripts.translation: 床下

scripts.text:
^3355FFWith Long Stick in
hand, you manage to
reach the object and drag
it under the bed towards you.
You now possess the ^000000Cube^3355FF
that was under the bed.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF手持長棍，你終於夠到了那個物體，並將其從床下拖到了身邊。
你現在擁有了床下的那個^000000立方體^3355FF。^000000

whatever you used to

你得想點別的辦法。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you
managed to find some
sort of strange ^000000Cube^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡是你找到某種奇怪的^000000立方體^3355FF的地方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou see an empty
bottle and a goblet.
It looks like you
missed the party.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你看到一個空瓶和一個高腳杯。
看起來你錯過了那場派對。^000000

scripts.text: Examine the goblet.
scripts.translation: 檢查高腳杯

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFInside the goblet,
you find a ^000000Rusty Key^3355FF
which you decide to keep.
However, you'll need to get
rid of that rust somehow.
Perhaps you can dip the key
in some corrosive chemical?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在高腳杯裡，你發現了一把^000000生鏽的鑰匙^3355FF，你決定把它收起來。
不過，你得想辦法除掉上面的鏽跡。
也許可以把鑰匙泡在某種腐蝕性化學劑裡？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the goblet where
you found that ^000000Rusty Key^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這就是你找到那把^000000生鏽的鑰匙^3355FF的高腳杯。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is goblet cup where
you found that ^000000Rusty Key^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這就是你找到那把^000000生鏽的鑰匙^3355FF的高腳杯。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere is a bottle
containing slightly
corrosive chemicals
that is sitting on the ledge.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF架子上放著一個瓶子，裡面裝著略帶腐蝕性的化學劑。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhatever you tried to
pour the chemicals on
wasn't affected at all.
You should try pouring the
chemicals on something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF無論你把化學劑倒在哪裡，都沒有產生任何影響。
你應該試著把化學劑倒在別的東西上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere is a bottle
containing slightly
corrosive chemicals
that is sitting on the ledge.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF架子上放著一個瓶子，裡面裝著略帶腐蝕性的化學劑。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFPouring the chemicals
on the Rusty Key removes
the rust, making it usable
again. Now that it is clean,
the Rusty Key has become
a sparkling ^000000Green Key^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF將化學劑倒在生鏽的鑰匙上，鏽跡被去除了，鑰匙又能使用了。
現在它變得乾淨了，生鏽的鑰匙變成了一把閃閃發光的^000000綠色鑰匙^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:

pour the chemicals on
wasn't affected at all.
You should try pouring the
chemicals on something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF無論你把化學劑倒在哪裡，都沒有產生任何影響。
你應該試著把化學劑倒在別的東西上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese are the chemicals
that you used to clean the
Rusty Key so that it was
restored to its original glory,
becoming the ^000000Green Key^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這就是你用來清潔生鏽的鑰匙，使其恢復原本光彩，變成^000000綠色鑰匙^3355FF的化學劑。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a
cabinet that contains
many drawers. Perhaps
something useful is inside?
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一個有很多抽屜的櫃子。
裡面也許藏著什麼有用的東西？

scripts.text: Open
scripts.translation: 開門

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately, the
cabinet has been locked.
You'll need the right key
in order to open the drawers.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF不幸的是，櫃子被鎖住了。你需要正確的鑰匙才能開啟抽屜。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a
cabinet that contains
many drawers. Perhaps
something useful is inside?
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一個有很多抽屜的櫃子。
裡面也許藏著什麼有用的東西？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou take the Green Key
and finds that it fits into
one of the drawer keyholes.
You open the drawer and
obtain a strange ^000000Polygon^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你拿起綠色鑰匙，發現它正好能插入其中一個抽屜的鎖孔。你開啟抽屜，獲得了一個奇怪的^000000多邊形^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhatever you tried
did not succeed in
opening this cabinet.
Think. Think of how
locks are unlocked...
Then you'll find the
answer you seek.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你嘗試的方法沒能開啟這個櫃子。想想看。想想鎖是怎麼被開啟的...然後你就會找到你想要的答案。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the locker
where you used the
Green Key to open one
of the Drawers and obtained
a ^000000Polygon^3355FF. You're pretty happy
with your Polygon and don't
need to open the other drawers.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這就是你用綠色鑰匙開啟其中一個抽屜並獲得^000000多邊形^3355FF的地方。你對你的多邊形很滿意，不需要開啟其他的抽屜了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a strange
tube that seems to
contain something.
Underneath the tube is
a thin plate with a keyhole
and a card insertion slot.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一個奇怪的試管，裡面似乎裝著什麼東西。試管下方有一塊薄板，上面有一個鎖孔和一個卡片插槽。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened.
You'll probably need
to find the right key for
the keyhole and the correct
card to insert into the slot.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF什麼也沒發生。你大概需要找到適合鎖孔的鑰匙，以及正確的卡片插入插槽。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a strange
tube that seems to
contain something.
Underneath the tube is
a thin plate with a keyhole
and a card insertion slot.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一個奇怪的試管，裡面似乎裝著什麼東西。試管下方有一塊薄板，上面有一個鎖孔和一個卡片插槽。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou insert the Black Key
into the keyhole, causing
the experiment tube to open
and reveal an ^000000Oval^3355FF which you
you choose to take with you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你將黑色鑰匙插入鎖孔，試管隨之開啟，露出了一個^000000橢圓形^3355FF，你決定把它帶走。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened...^000000

^3355FFThis is where you
obtained the ^000000Oval^3355FF.
As you look around
the tube's location,
you notice an artificial
ground fissure which
can probably open up...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這就是你獲得^000000橢圓形^3355FF的地方。當你環顧試管周圍時，你注意到地面上有一道人工裂縫，它似乎可以開啟...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere is a narrow,
rectangular card slot
in front of the tube.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF試管前方有一個窄長的矩形卡片插槽。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou insert the
Laboratory Permit
into the slot and the
man made fissure in the
ground splits open, revealing
an underground staircase.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你將研究所進出卡片插入卡槽，地面上的人工裂縫隨之開啟，露出一段通往地下的樓梯。^000000

scripts.text: Go downstairs
scripts.translation: 下樓

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou walk down
the long flight
of winding stairs...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你沿著長長的蜿蜒樓梯走下去...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened.^000000

^3355FFThis is where you
obtained the ^000000Oval^3355FF.
As you look around
the tube's location,
you notice an articial
ground fissure which
can probably open up...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這就是你獲得^000000橢圓形^3355FF的地方。當你環顧試管周圍時，你注意到地面上有一道人工裂縫，它似乎可以開啟...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a box with
three distinctively
shaped holes.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一個盒子，上面有三個形狀各異的孔。^000000

scripts.text: Oval Hole
scripts.translation: 橢圓孔

scripts.text: Cubic Hole
scripts.translation: 立方孔

scripts.text: Polygon Hole
scripts.translation: 多邊形孔

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened.^000000

^3355FFYou find a box with
three distinctively
shaped holes.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一個盒子，上面有三個形狀各異的孔。^000000

scripts.text: Oval Hole
scripts.translation: 橢圓孔

scripts.text: Cube Hole
scripts.translation: 立方孔

scripts.text: Polygon Hole
scripts.translation: 多邊形孔

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou insert the Oval
into the Oval shaped
hole where it fits perfectly.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你將橢圓放入橢圓形的孔中，完美契合。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened.^000000

^3355FFThe Oval shaped hole
already has an Oval in it.
Besides, it's not you have
any Ovals to spare, anyway.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF橢圓形的孔裡已經有一個橢圓了。
而且，你手頭也沒有多餘的橢圓。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened.^000000

^3355FFYou insert the Cube
into the Cubic hole
and it clicks into place.
Your formal Kindergarten
training is finally justified.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你把立方體放進方形凹槽，咔噠一音效卡了進去。看來你在幼兒園學到的知識終於派上用場了。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened.^000000

^3355FFYou already placed
a Cube into the hole.
You could take it back
out and put it in again,
but that would just be
a total waste of time.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你已經把立方體放進孔裡了。
你可以把它拿出來再放進去，但那純粹是浪費時間。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened.^000000

^3355FFFortunately, the
nondescript Polygon
that you have is exactly
the same shape as this
nondescript Polygonal hole.
The Polygon fits perfectly,
almost as if it were destiny.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF幸運的是，你手中的這個普通多邊形與這個普通的多邊形孔形狀完全一致。
多邊形完美契合，彷彿命中註定一般。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened.^000000

^3355FFThe Polygon is already
inserted into the hole.
Trust that this is as much
as this Polygon can do for you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF多邊形已經插入孔中了。
相信這就是這個多邊形能為你做的極限了。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFNothing happened.^000000

^3355FFYou find a box with
three distinctively
shaped holes that
are now filled with the
objects you've inserted.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一個盒子，上面有三個形狀各異的孔，現在這些孔已經被你插入的物體填滿了。^000000

scripts.text: Open the box.
scripts.translation: 開啟盒子

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou open the box
and find that there's
a small card labeled
''Laboratory Permit'' inside.
You pocket this ^000000Laboratory
Permit^3355FF, knowing that you
will be needing it later.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你開啟盒子，發現裡面有一張寫著
“^000000研究所進出卡片^3355FF”的小卡片。
你將它收好，知道之後會用到它。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find the open box
which used to contain
the ^000000Laboratory Permit^3355FF.
This box is no longer
useful to you now, but
once upon a time, its
mysteries were a challenge.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你找到了那個曾經裝著
^000000研究所進出卡片^3355FF的開啟的盒子。
這個盒子對你已經沒用了，但曾經，它的謎題是一個挑戰。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've come upon a
door that leads outside.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一扇通往室外的門。^000000

scripts.text: Exit
scripts.translation: 出口

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou found a passage that
seems to lead somewhere,
but you get the feeling that
you shouldn't enter it for now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一條似乎通向某處的通道，但你覺得現在不應該進去。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FF*SHHHHHHUK!*^000000

[{0}]
Huh...?
I could have sworn
that these pockets full
of zeny were heavier
just a second ago...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...？
我發誓，剛才這些裝滿Zeny的口袋明明更重一些...

scripts.text: ^3355FF*SHHHHHHUK!*^000000

[{0}]
Huh...?
What the?!
That guy, did he just...?
He did! Hey! That guy
stole some of my money!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...？
什麼鬼？！
那個人，他剛才...？
他幹了！嘿！那個人偷了我的錢！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Oh crap!
Gotta scram!
Eat my dust, good gu--!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的傢伙]
糟糕！
快跑！
嚐嚐我揚起的塵土吧，好——！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh no, you don't!
I'm turning you in,
you pickpocket!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
別想跑！
我要把你交給衛兵，你這個扒手！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
No...! I'm sorry!
I'll give you back
your money, just 
let me go! Crap!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的傢伙]
不...！對不起！
我把錢還給你，放過我吧！糟糕！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright, fine,
but you better quit
this life of crime!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，算了，但你最好改邪歸正，別再幹這種勾當了！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
You're right, that was
wrong of me. Thanks
for letting me go. Since
you did me a favor, I'll
sell you some tonic that
I use to run really fast.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的傢伙]
你說得對，是我做錯了。
謝謝你放過我。既然你幫了我，我就賣給你一些我用來跑得飛快的藥水吧。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
I can only sell up to
three of my secret tonic
to you since that's all
I have. Each one will
cost 15,000 zeny. So
what do you say?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的傢伙]
我只有三瓶這種秘製藥水，所以最多隻能賣給你三瓶。
每瓶售價15,000 Zeny。
你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Give me 1.
scripts.translation: 給我1瓶

scripts.text: Give me 2.
scripts.translation: 給我2瓶

scripts.text: Give me 3.
scripts.translation: 給我3瓶

scripts.text: No, I'm fine.
scripts.translation: 沒有，我沒事

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Well...
You're just gonna
let me go, then?
That's awful generous.
Thanks, I appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的傢伙]
那...你就這樣放過我？
真是大方啊。
謝謝，我很感激。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Anyway, I'm gonna
get back to work.
Heh heh heh~
[Suspicious Guy]
Er, since I'm quitting
pickpocketing, I need
to make cash legitimately
as a business person. I'm
real sorry pal, but I can't just
give these tonics away!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的傢伙]
總之，我要回去工作了。
嘿嘿嘿~~
[可疑的傢伙]
呃，既然我不做扒手了，就得靠正當生意賺錢。真不好意思，朋友，這些藥水我可不能白送！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Anyway, I'm gonna
get back to work.
Heh heh heh~
[Suspicious Guy]
Eh, I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough room
in your inventory to even
hold these tonics. Sorry
pal, but this deal's off.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的傢伙]
總之，我要回去工作了。
嘿嘿嘿~~
[可疑的傢伙]
呃，抱歉，你的背包空間不足，連這些藥水都裝不下。不好意思，朋友，這筆交易取消了。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Anyway, I'm gonna
get back to work.
Heh heh heh~
[Suspicious Guy]
Only one? Alright, you
might be a cheapskate,
but I do owe you. Just
take this and I hope we never
bump into each other again!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的傢伙]
總之，我要回去工作了。
嘿嘿嘿~~
[可疑的傢伙]
只要一瓶？好吧，你可能是個吝嗇鬼，但我確實欠你人情。拿著吧，希望我們以後再也不見面！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Anyway, I'm gonna
get back to work.
Heh heh heh~
[Suspicious Guy]
Two, huh? I can dig it.
Now take these and I hope
we never see each other
ever again! Ciao, baby~
scripts.translation:
[可疑的傢伙]
總之，我要回去工作了。
嘿嘿嘿~~
[可疑的傢伙]
兩瓶？可以接受。
拿著吧，希望我們以後再也不見面！拜拜，寶貝~

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Anyway, I'm gonna
get back to work.
Heh heh heh~
[Suspicious Guy]
You want all three?
Heh, you're much smarter
than I thought! Alright, take
these with my compliments,
but I hope we never bump
into each other ever again!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的傢伙]
總之，我要回去工作了。
嘿嘿嘿~~
[可疑的傢伙]
總共三瓶？
嘿，你比我想像的聰明多了！好吧，拿去吧，不過希望我們以後再也不要見面！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Anyway, I'm gonna
get back to work.
Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[可疑的傢伙]
總之，我要回去工作了。
嘿嘿嘿~~

Heh, you're much smarter
