these with my compliments,
but I hope we never bump
into each other ever again!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的傢伙]
你要全部三瓶？
嘿，你比我想像的聰明多了！好吧，這些就當作我的敬意送給你，但希望我們以後再也不見面！

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Oh, an adventurer?
Welcome to Uptown
Lighthalzen. However,
I'm afraid this area won't
have much to offer you
in the way of excitement.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
哦，是位冒險者？
歡迎來到裡希塔樂鎮上城區。不過，恐怕這個區域不會給你提供太多刺激的經歷。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Not to be rude or
anything, but this town
should be safe enough for
you to explore. I mean, you
just seem to be kind of new
at this adventurer thing...
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
別誤會，我不是故意冒犯，但這鎮上應該足夠安全，你可以放心探索。我是說，你看起來像是剛入行的冒險者...

scripts.text:
^3355FFDigotz has passed
away, but the look on
his face seems very
peaceful and content.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF迪戈茨已經離世，但他臉上的神情顯得非常安詳和滿足。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFDigotz is seriously
injured from a wound
by a knife that is still
embedded in his belly.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF迪戈茨傷勢嚴重，一把刀還插在他的腹部。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Digotz...?
Oh no, let me
get you some help!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
迪戈茨...？
天哪，讓我去叫人來幫忙！

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
H-hey... It's the
adventurer... Man,
that Maku. He always
did bring me bad luck...
It's too late for me and
I don't have much time...
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
嘿...是你啊，冒險者...唉，又是馬庫。他總是給我帶來厄運...
我撐不了多久了...

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Those guards I told you
about... The ones who don't
want the poor and the rich to
mingle? I... Guess they found
I was gonna meet my old pal.
I just wanted to see him...
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我之前跟你提過的那些衛兵...就是那些不希望窮人和富人混在一起的人？
我...我想他們發現我要去見我的老夥計了。
我只是想看看他...

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
This guy... In a black
suit... He just... He just
stabbed me! I... God. It's
been so long since I've talked
to him. We'll hang out and have
fun, just like the good old days.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
那個傢伙...穿著黑色西裝...他...他刺了我一刀！天哪。
我已經很久沒和他說過話了。我們要像以前那樣一起玩樂，重溫舊夢。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
I missed my buddies, but now...
Now I can hear them calling me.
Now we can all be together just
like we all promised. Yeah...
I was wrong. Life's too short
to be angry with your frie--
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我很想念我的夥伴們，但現在...
現在我能聽到他們在呼喚我了。現在我們可以像當初承諾的那樣永遠在一起了。是的...
我錯了。人生苦短，不該對朋友懷有憤--

scripts.text:
^3355FFDigotz stopped breathing.
You remove the Knife from
his lifeless body as a final
courtesy to a man who
dearly loved his friends.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF迪戈茨停止了呼吸。
你從他那失去生機的身體上拔出那把刀，作為對這位深愛朋友的男子最後的敬意。^000000

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Wh-whoa, I need to
get ready! That Maku's
gonna make fun of me if
I look too rich and pampered.
Damn! Where did I put all of
my fashionable street clothes?
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
哇哦，我得趕緊準備一下！如果我看起來太有錢太嬌貴，馬庫肯定會嘲笑我的。
該死！我把那些時髦的街頭衣服放哪兒了？

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Even if Benkaistein
did come back, I don't
think I could forgive Maku.
In fact, you know what?
I think I'd even be madder!
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
即使本凱斯坦真的回來了，我也不覺得我能原諒馬庫。
事實上，你知道嗎？
我覺得我會更生氣！

scripts.text: Show Benkaistein's Journal.
scripts.translation: 出示本凱斯坦的日誌

scripts.text: Don't show Benkaistein's Journal.
scripts.translation: 不展示本凱斯坦的日誌

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Why am I so ticked off?
^3355FF*Sigh*^000000 You have something
to show me? Huh? Benkaistein
wanted me to read this diary
of his? Sure, why not? I do
owe him a lot over the years...
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我為什麼這麼生氣？
^3355FF*嘆氣*^000000 你有什麼要給我看的嗎？嗯？
本凱斯坦想讓我讀他的這本日記？好吧，為什麼不呢？多年來我確實欠他很多...

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Today, me, Digotz and
Maku played this crazy flying
game. Basically, we make
these wings out of wood and
paper, jump off these hills
and try to fly. Dumb, I know.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦的日誌]
^856363今天，我、迪戈茨和馬庫玩了一種瘋狂的飛行遊戲。基本上，我們用木頭和紙做翅膀，從山上跳下來嘗試飛行。
很蠢，我知道。^000000

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Today it was my turn to
jump and flap my arms with
these fake, badly made wings.
It's not really a fun game when
I think about it. Boy, I hope
we don't do that again.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦的日誌]
^856363今天輪到我了，我揮舞著這些做工粗糙的假翅膀跳了下去。仔細想想，這遊戲其實並不好玩。
天哪，希望我們別再玩這個了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Oh yeah, I remember that!
Maku wore the wings most
of the time, but I still hold
the record for staying in the
air the longest! Yeah, I was
a regular Kid Pegasus~
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
哦對，我記得那次！
馬庫大部分時間都戴著翅膀，但我保持著在空中停留最久的記錄！
沒錯，我可是真正的飛馬少年~

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Maku, Digotz and me went
outside of town. Of course,
we didn't tell anyone or else
we'd get in trouble. It was
a really exciting day. But
then, we ran into a monster!^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦的日誌]
^856363馬庫、迪戈茨和我偷偷溜出了鎮子。當然，我們沒告訴任何人，不然肯定會惹上麻煩。那天真的非常刺激。但後來，我們遇到了一隻魔物！^000000

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363I wanted to run away but Maku
and Digotz wanted to beat it so
that we could become heroes.
Of course, we got hurt pretty
bad and the monster got away.
Boy, mom was not happy...^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦的日誌]
^856363我想逃跑，但馬庫和迪戈茨想打敗它，這樣我們就能成為英雄了。結果我們受了很重的傷，魔物也逃走了。天哪，媽媽當時很不高興...^000000

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Huh. I don't remember
that so well. But I know that
Benkaistein, me and Maku
weren't afraid of anything back
then. We must have been totally
nuts to fight a monster, though.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
嗯。那段記憶有點模糊了。但我知道，那時候的本凱斯坦、我和馬庫什麼都不怕。不過，敢去跟魔物打架，我們當時肯定都是瘋了。

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Digotz's been sick for three
days now. It's just a normal
cold and Maku keeps saying
it's Digotz's fault he got sick.^FFFFFF ^856363 But he's always asking me to
go visit him and see if he's okay.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦的日誌]
^856363迪戈茨已經病了三天了。只是普通的感冒，馬庫一直說是迪戈茨自己活該生病。^FFFFFF ^856363但他總是讓我去探望他，看看他好點了沒有。^000000

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
I think I remember being
pretty sick. Maku was worried?
I... I must have had a horrible
life threatening disease like,
um, Gonorrhitis. You know.
That might have been it.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我記得我病得很重。馬庫很擔心我？我...我一定是得了什麼危及生命的重病，比如，嗯，Gonorrhitis。你知道的，可能就是那種病。

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Mom and dad keep telling
me not to hang out with Maku
anymore. Their reason is really
dumb, and I don't care if he is
poor. He's one of the best guys
that I'll ever know.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦的日誌]
^856363爸爸媽媽一直讓我別再跟馬庫混在一起了。他們的理由真的很蠢，我才不在乎他窮不窮。他是我認識的最棒的人之一。^000000

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Digotz's family is really
rich and they don't want him
to see Maku anymore either.
But Digotz doesn't care.
I know he likes Maku a lot.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦的日誌]
^856363迪戈茨家裡很有錢，他們也不希望迪戈茨再跟馬庫來往了。但迪戈茨不在乎。我知道他很喜歡馬庫。^000000

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Well, we were a lot
younger and closer back
then, so... ^333333*Ahem!*^000000 Why did
Benkaistein even write that?!
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
嗯，那時候我們年紀小，關係也更親密，所以... ^333333*咳咳!*^000000 本凱斯坦為什麼要寫那些東西？！

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Today, the three of us
made an oath of brotherhood,
just like we read in the comic
book. We swore we'd always
be friends no matter what.
For always and for always.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦的日誌]
^856363今天，我們三個像漫畫書裡那樣，結下了兄弟之誓。我們發誓無論發生什麼，永遠都是朋友。永遠，永遠。^000000

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
I... I was forced to make
that oath! And people do
change, you know! I mean,
we were basically just kids,
it's not like that oath really
means anything now, does it?
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我...我是被迫立下那個誓言的！而且人總是會變的，你知道嗎？我是說，我們當時基本上還是小孩子，那個誓言現在應該沒什麼意義了吧？

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
That does it. I'm gonna
go see that Maku. I don't
miss him or anything, but
I gotta get him to cancel
that oath. And maybe I'll
beat up him a little bit.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
夠了。我要去找那個馬庫。我並不是想念他什麼的，但我必須讓他取消那個誓言。也許我會揍他一頓。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
I don't understand
why I'm so angry!
I'm starting to act
more like Maku, though,
don't get me wrong, it's
not like I care about the guy.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我不明白我為什麼這麼生氣！我開始變得像馬庫一樣了，別誤會，我並不是在乎那個人。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Even if Benkaistein came
back from wherever he was
studying, I don't think he'd be
able to get Maku to apologize
to me. That guy is just way
too stubborn for his own good!
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
就算本凱斯坦從他在讀書的地方回來，我覺得他也沒法讓馬庫向我道歉。那個人就是太固執了，對自己沒好處！

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Oh, it's been a while.
What are you doing back
over here? And, um, did
you deliver that message
to Maku? Now when I think
about it, I was kind of--
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
哦，好久不見。你回這邊做什麼？還有，嗯，你把那條訊息帶給馬庫了嗎？現在回想起來，我其實有點--

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I delivered your message
word for word, and Maku
got angry, called you names
and has been threatening to
beat you up pretty badly.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我原封不動地轉達了你的話，馬庫很生氣，罵了你一頓，還威脅說要狠狠揍你。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
That no-good, dirty
lying rotten scoundrel!
If it weren't for those
guards, I'd head over to
the ghetto and beat Maku
up myself! That stupid guy!
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
那個無賴、骯髒、撒謊成性的混蛋！要不是有那些衛兵攔著，我早就去貧民窟把馬庫揍一頓了！那個蠢貨！

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
During times like this,
I really miss ^FF0000Benkaistein^000000.
That guy would always have
an answer for this kind of
situation. Yeah, I think he's
in some far off town, studying.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
在這種時候，我真的想念^FF0000本凱斯坦^000000。遇到這種情況，他總是有辦法解決。是啊，我想他在某個遙遠的城鎮讀書。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Supposedly he's in that
place, whatever it's called,
since there's a ton of books
there that he can use. But
yeah, Benkaistein would
always be the mediator...
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
據說他在那個地方，叫什麼來著，因為那裡有很多書供他使用。不過是啊，本凱斯坦總是那個調解人...

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Even back then, when
me, him and Maku used to
hang out, Benkaistein would
mediate if we got into some
argument. Still, he couldn't
do anything about Maku now...
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
即使是在以前，我、他和馬庫一起出去玩的時候，如果我們吵架，本凱斯坦也會來調解。不過，現在他對馬庫也無可奈何...

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
I don't know why,
but I'm so angry!
Why am I stressing
out so much over this?!
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我不知道為什麼，但我好生氣！我為什麼要在意這件事？！

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Still checking out
Uptown Lighthalzen?
Not like I'd care, but if you
do happen to see Maku,
deliver this little message
for me, sentence by sentence.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
還在裡希塔樂鎮上城區閒逛嗎？
雖然我不在乎，但如果你碰巧見到馬庫，請幫我逐句傳達這句話。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
^FF0000Hopeless bastard!
^FF0000You're still a stubborn jerk!
^FF0000You owe me at least 3 lunches!
^FF0000Not to mention an apology!
^FF0000But who cares what you think?!
I'm so goddamn happy without you!^000000
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
^FF0000沒救的混蛋！
^FF0000你真是個固執的蠢貨！
^FF0000你至少欠我三頓午飯！
^FF0000還有道歉！
^FF0000不過誰在乎你怎麼想？！
沒有你我開心得很！^000000

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
I know that the
opulence of Uptown
seems rather attractive,
but trust me. This place
is colorless. Now, have
you visited the poor district?
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我知道上城區的繁華看起來很誘人，但相信我，這裡毫無色彩。
那麼，你去過貧民窟嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I did already...
scripts.translation: 是的，我去過了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I did already...
And I met someone
named Maku there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我去過了...
而且我在那裡遇到了一個叫馬庫的人。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Maku?! Oh, he must have
mentioned something about
me. But I don't care what he
says, unless it's an apology
for being a fully blown jerk.
Ever since we were kids...
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
馬庫？！哦，他肯定提過我。但我不在乎他說什麼，除非他是來為自己徹頭徹尾的混蛋行徑道歉。
自從我們小時候...

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Anyway, we used to be close,
but that guy was never a true
friend of mine! Like that one
time he cheated to beat me at
arm wrestling! Or when he never
thanked me for buying us lunch!
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
總之，我們以前很親近，但那傢伙從來不是我真正的朋友！
就像那次他作弊贏了我的掰手腕！
或者他從不感謝我請他吃午飯！

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Sure, he might have helped
me a little in meeting my first
girlfriend, but I'll never ever
forgive him for fixing me up
on the worst blind dates a
man can possibly experience!
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
沒錯，他可能在我認識第一個女朋友時幫了點忙，但我永遠不會原諒他給我安排那些男人可能經歷過的最糟糕的相親！

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Maku doesn't know a damn
about friendship! Even if I did
want to see him, there are these
people who don't want the rich
to ever meet with the poor.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
馬庫根本不懂什麼是友誼！
即使我想見他，也有這些人不希望富人和窮人見面。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
If Maku's fine, that's
good enough to hear for
me! There's no need for me
to go all the way over there
and check up on him! I only
have one regret though...
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
如果馬庫沒事，對我來說這就夠了！
我不需要特意跑過去看他！我只有一個遺憾...

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
I only wish I had one
last chance to see Maku...
So that I could kick his sorry
ass myself! Yeah, that's right!
Arrogant bastard! But still,
I'm not able to do that...
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我只希望能有最後一次見馬庫的機會...
這樣我就能親自揍他一頓！
沒錯，就是這樣！
傲慢的混蛋！但即便如此，我也做不到...

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
The security guards here
will never allow the rich and
poor to meet, fearing that
the poor will disturb the peace
and order of the city. It's a dumb rule made for dumb people.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
這裡的保安絕不允許富人和窮人見面，擔心窮人會擾亂城市的和平與秩序。這是為蠢人制定的愚蠢規則。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Still, it's pretty scary that
someone can get punished
for violating such a stupid
taboo, actually. Anyway, if
you see Maku again, tell
him this for me, got it?
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
不過，違反這種愚蠢的禁忌真的會受到懲罰，這挺嚇人的。總之，如果你再見到馬庫，替我告訴他這句話，聽到了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
^FF0000Hopeless bastard!
^FF0000You're still a stubborn jerk!
^FF0000You owe me at least 3 lunches!
^FF0000Not to mention an apology!
^FF0000But who cares what you think?!
I'm so goddamn happy without you!^000000
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
^FF0000沒救的混蛋！
^FF0000你真是個固執的蠢貨！
^FF0000你至少欠我三頓午飯！
^FF0000還有道歉！
^FF0000不過誰在乎你怎麼想？！
沒有你我開心得很！^000000

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
What are you still
doing hanging around
here? There's nothing
interesting in Uptown
for you to see, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
你還在這裡閒逛什麼？
上城區沒有什麼值得你看的，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Gosh...!
Just hearing about
Maku makes me so feel
so upset for some reason!
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
天哪...！
光是聽到馬庫的名字我就莫名地感到心煩意亂！

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Oh, an adventurer?
Welcome to Uptown
Lighthalzen. However,
I'm afraid this area won't
have much to offer you
in the way of excitement.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
哦，是位冒險者？
歡迎來到裡希塔樂鎮上城區。不過，恐怕這個區域不會給你提供太多刺激的經歷。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
My name is Digotz,
just another citizen
of Upper Lighthalzen.
I hope that you enjoy
your stay in my hometown.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
我叫迪戈茨，只是裡希塔樂鎮上城區的一名市民。
希望你在我的家鄉玩得開心。

scripts.text: Do you know someone named Maku?
scripts.translation: 你認識一個叫馬庫的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Maku? Maku. Yes, he's my
childhood friend. Or he was,
anyway. Now he's just a jerk.
In any case, we can't hang
out, even if we wanted to,
for several reasons.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
馬庫？馬庫。是的，他是我的兒時玩伴。或者說曾經是。
現在他只是個混蛋。
無論如何，即使我們想，由於幾個原因，我們也無法在一起閒逛。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Hey, why am I even
talking about this? It's
not like I'm bothered by
the fact me and Maku aren't
pals anymore. You know what?
Just forget everything I said.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
嘿，我為什麼要談論這個？
我和馬庫不再是朋友這件事並沒有困擾我。
你知道嗎？
忘掉我說的一切吧。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Oh, an adventurer?
Welcome to Uptown
Lighthalzen. However,
I'm afraid this area won't
have much to offer you
in the way of excitement.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
哦，是位冒險者？
歡迎來到裡希塔樂鎮上城區。不過，恐怕這個區域不會給你提供太多刺激的經歷。

scripts.text:
[Digotz]
Feel free to take
a look around if you
so wish. I'm actually
glad to see somebody
aside from the stuck up
rich people who live here.
scripts.translation:
[迪戈茨]
如果你願意，可以四處看看。
我很高興看到除了住在這裡的勢利眼富人之外的人。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Why is this guy so
late? Once he shows
up, I swear, I'm gonna...!
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
這傢伙怎麼這麼晚？
等他來了，我發誓，我要...！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Hey, what is that? You want
I should read this journal?
Er, okay, but I'm none too
comfortable going through
somebody's diary. It's just
kinda... creepy, you know?
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
嘿，那是什麼？你想讓我讀這本日誌？
呃，好吧，但我翻別人的日記實在有點不習慣。就是...
有點瘮人，你懂吧？

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Arrrrgh! Whenever I hear
about that Digotz, I get so
peeved! Is that guy giving
me the brushoff just because
I'm not a rich guy like he is?!
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
啊啊啊！一聽到迪戈茨那個名字我就火大！他是不是因為我不像他那樣有錢才不理我？！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
RrrrRrrrr....
RrrrrRRRrrRR....
GGGGGRRRRR...
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
RrrrRrrrr...
RrrrrRRRrrRR...
GGGGGRRRRR...

scripts.text:
[Maku]
What the hell are you
still doing around here?
You must have better things
to do than talk to a ruffian
like me or that snobby and
totally prickish Digotz.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
你他媽還賴在這裡幹嘛？
你肯定有比跟像我這樣的混混，或者那個勢利眼、自命不凡的迪戈茨說話更好的事做吧。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Man, I need to blow off some
steam! Sure, me and Digotz
were buds before and maybe
we might seem like friends now,
but not anymore, though we used
to be closer than this. Argh!
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
真是的，我得發洩一下！
沒錯，我和迪戈茨以前是死黨，現在看起來也許還是朋友，但已經不是了，雖然以前我們比現在更親近。
啊！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Hey, what are you
doing back over here?
I thought I recommended
going over to check out
Uptown Lighthalzen. This
place is pretty run-down...
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
嘿，你怎麼又回來了？
我剛才不是建議你去裡希塔樂鎮上城區看看嗎？
這地方挺破舊的...

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Hey, you're one of
those adventurers, eh?
Welcome to the ghetto.
Nothing too adventurous
here, but hey, you can
explore all you want.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
嘿，你是那些冒險者之一吧？
歡迎來到貧民窟。
這裡沒什麼冒險的，不過，你可以隨便逛逛。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Why is Digotz
so late? This isn't
like him at all. Maybe
something's wrong?
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
迪戈茨怎麼這麼晚？
這完全不像他啊。
難道出什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Eh, he might have
some kinda reason for
being late, but if he don't,
I've been saving a whole
six pack of kickass to open,
just for him. Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
呃，他可能有什麼理由遲到，但如果不是，我特意留了一整箱超棒的酒給他開。嘿嘿嘿~~

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Hey, this thing is
Benkaistein's. I haven't
seen that guy in a long while.
Ah, so he gave it to you for me
to read? Alright, I owe him a
favor or two, so I oughta...
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
嘿，這東西是本凱斯坦的。
我好久沒見那傢伙了。
啊，所以他是讓你給我讀的？好吧，我欠他兩個人情，所以我應該...

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Today, me, Digotz and
Maku played this crazy flying
game. Basically, we make
these wings out of wood and
paper, jump off these hills
and try to fly. Dumb, I know.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦的日誌]
^856363今天，我、迪戈茨和馬庫玩了一種瘋狂的飛行遊戲。基本上，我們用木頭和紙做翅膀，從山上跳下來嘗試飛行。
很蠢，我知道。^000000

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Today it was my turn to
jump and flap my arms with
these fake, badly made wings.
It's not really a fun game when
I think about it. Boy, I hope
we don't do that again.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦的日誌]
^856363今天輪到我了，我揮舞著這些做工粗糙的假翅膀跳了下去。仔細想想，這遊戲其實並不好玩。
天哪，希望我們別再玩這個了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maku]
What is he talking about?!
That game was real fun!
Yeah, I usually wore the
wings and Digotz always
wanted to wear them too.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
他在說什麼？！
那個遊戲真的很好玩！
對，我通常戴翅膀，迪戈茨也總想戴。

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Maku, Digotz and me went
outside of town. Of course,
we didn't tell anyone or else
we'd get in trouble. It was
a really exciting day. But
then, we ran into a monster!^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦的日誌]
^856363馬庫、迪戈茨和我偷偷溜出了鎮子。當然，我們沒告訴任何人，不然肯定會惹上麻煩。那天真的非常刺激。但後來，我們遇到了一隻魔物！^000000

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363I wanted to run away but Maku
and Digotz wanted to beat it so
that we could become heroes.
Of course, we got hurt pretty
bad and the monster got away.
Boy, mom was not happy...^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦的日誌]
^856363我想逃跑，但馬庫和迪戈茨想打敗它，這樣我們就能成為英雄了。結果我們受了很重的傷，魔物也逃走了。天哪，媽媽當時很不高興...^000000

scripts.text:
[Maku]
That's right! Back then,
the three of us weren't
afraid of anything! Of course,
Digotz got beat up the most.
But I gotta say, he was also
the most fearless of us.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
沒錯！那時候，我們三個什麼都不怕！
當然，迪戈茨被打得最慘。
但我得說，他也是我們中最無畏的。

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Digot's been sick for three
days now. It's just a normal
cold and Maku keeps saying
it's Digotz's fault he got sick.^FFFFFF ^856363 But he's always asking me to
go visit him and see if he's okay.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦的日誌]
^856363迪戈茨已經病了三天了。
只是普通的感冒，馬庫一直說是迪戈茨的錯才讓他生病的。^FFFFFF ^856363但他總是讓我去探望他，看看他是否沒事。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Wh-what?! No, I wasn't
worried at all! That must
have been the time Digot
caught Clymonia. You know,
that, uh, horrible disease. No
one should have that one!
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
什-什麼？！不，我完全不擔心！那肯定是迪戈茨感染克呂莫尼亞症的時候。
你知道，就是那個，呃，可怕的疾病。沒人應該得那個！

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Mom and dad keep telling
me not to hang out with Maku
anymore. Their reason is really
dumb, and I don't care if he is
poor. He's one of the best guys
that I'll ever know.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦的日誌]
^856363爸爸媽媽一直讓我別再跟馬庫混在一起了。他們的理由真的很蠢，我才不在乎他窮不窮。他是我認識的最棒的人之一。^000000

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Digotz's family is really
rich and they don't want him
to see Maku anymore either.
But Digotz doesn't care.
I know he likes Maku a lot.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦的日誌]
^856363迪戈茨家裡很有錢，他們也不希望迪戈茨再跟馬庫來往了。但迪戈茨不在乎。我知道他很喜歡馬庫。^000000

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein's Journal]
^856363Today, the three of us
made an oath of brotherhood,
just like we read in the comic
book. We swore we'd always
be friends no matter what.
For always and for always.^000000
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦的日誌]
^856363今天，我們三個像漫畫書裡那樣，結下了兄弟之誓。我們發誓無論發生什麼，永遠都是朋友。永遠，永遠。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Well, that's true,
I guess, but people
change! Besides, we got
that idea from a comic book!
Well, if he apologizes first,
I guess I better forgive him.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
嗯，那倒是真的，但人會變的！而且，我們的想法是從漫畫書裡學來的。好吧，如果他先道歉，我想我還是應該原諒他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good...
Because Digotz said
that he'll be coming
by in a few days.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很好...
因為迪戈茨說他幾天後會來。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
What?! He's really coming
here? What for? It's too late
to patch things up! Still, I'd be
a real prick if I didn't see him. Alright, fine! I'll teach that guy
a lesson once he's here!
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
什麼？他真的要來？為了什麼？
現在補救已經太晚了！
不過，如果我不見他，我才是個真正的混蛋。好吧，行！等他來了，我要給他點教訓！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
And, um, gimme that
journal! I'm gonna read
more of it so I can make
fun of Digotz. Bwahahaha!
But yeah, um, thanks. Not
that I'm grateful or anything.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
還有，呃，把那本日誌給我！我要多讀點，好嘲笑迪戈茨。哇哈哈哈！
不過，呃，謝謝。不是說我很感激之類的。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
So, uh, I guess
I'll see you later.
Um, now I gotta get
ready for something.
^333333(But not to see Digotz!)^000000
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
那，呃，我想我們改天再見吧。
嗯，我現在得去準備點事情了。
^333333(但不是去見迪戈茨！)^000000

scripts.text:
[Maku]
I can't...
I can't even beat him up
all properly because of
all those freakin' guards!
Arrrrrrrgh! Man, where's
Benkaistein when I need him?
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
我連...
連好好揍他一頓都做不到，全怪那些該死的衛兵！
啊————！本凱斯坦，我需要你的時候你在哪兒？

scripts.text:
^3355FFUh oh...
It looks like Maku
is starting to rage
just a bit too much.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF哎呀...
看起來馬庫開始有點失控了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Gggrrrr...

[Maku]
GRAAAAAAAAH~!
Who the hell does he
think he is, telling me
all sorts of crap!? Digotz,
you're not getting away
with this! Gonna wreck you!!
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
嘎啊啊啊啊啊~！
他以為他是誰啊，對我指手畫腳的？！迪戈茨，你別想就這麼算了！
我要把你揍扁！！

scripts.text:
^3355FFMaku's seething quickly
explodes into pure, violent
rage. You manage to calm
him down after a while, but
barely keep yourself from
getting killed in this outburst.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF馬庫的怒火迅速爆發成純粹的暴力狂怒。
你花了好一會兒才讓他冷靜下來，但你自己也差點被這陣爆發給弄死。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maku]
^333333*Pant pant* *Whew~*^000000
D-don't worry, I've got
a grip on myself now.
Thanks for not letting me
get too crazy. Times like
this, I really miss ^FF0000Benkaistein^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
^333333*氣喘吁吁* *呼~*^000000
別、別擔心，我現在已經控制住了。
謝謝你沒讓我徹底發瘋。這種時候，我真想念^FF0000本凱斯坦^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Benkaistein would always
make sure that I'd stay out
of fights. I really miss that
guy. Still, he ain't around...
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
本凱斯坦總是能確保我不惹事。
我真的很想念那個人。不過，他不在...

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Damn those guards!
If they weren't there,
I could just go over and
kick Digotz's ass! I swear,
if it weren't for them...!
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
該死的衛兵！
要不是有他們在，我早就衝過去把迪戈茨揍得滿地找牙了！
我發誓，要不是因為他們...！

scripts.text: Speaking of which...
scripts.translation: 說到這個...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Speaking of which...
I spoke to Digotz again.
He told me to give you a
message, but I'm not sure th--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
說到這個...
我又和迪戈茨談了一次。
他讓我給你帶個口信，但我不確定他——

scripts.text:
[Maku]
That no-good bastard
has a message for me?!
Oh, I'm soooo honored~
Tell me what that fink
has to say, line by line!
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
那個混蛋居然有口信給我？！
哎呀，真是受寵若驚~
告訴我那個無賴說了什麼，一字不漏地！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
''Hopeless bastard?!''
Well, at least he had
the stomach to say that.
Through somebody else
anyway! What else'd he say?!
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
“沒救的混蛋？！”
哼，至少他還有膽量說出來。
雖然是借別人的嘴！
他還說了什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
''Stubborn jerk?!''
Takes one to know one,
bastard! Why I oughta--
Grrr! What'd he say next?!
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
“固執的蠢貨？！”
物以類聚，混蛋！我本該——
哼！他接著說了什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Three lunches?!
I treated that guy to
lunch, like, fifteen times!
I tell you, the guy does not
know the meaning of friendship!
What else did that moron say?!
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
三次午餐？！
我請那個傢伙吃了大概十五次午餐！
我告訴你，這傢伙根本不懂什麼是友誼！
那個白痴還說了什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Me, apologize?!
He should be on his hands
and knees begging for my
frickin' forgiveness! That...
That selfish no-good stupid...
W-what else did he tell you?!
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
我，道歉？！
應該是他跪在地上乞求我的原諒才對！
那個...
那個自私的、該死的、愚蠢的...
他、他還跟你說了什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
''Who cares what I think?!''
GRRRAAAH~!! Who cares
what he thinks!! ^333333*Pant Pant*^000000
I'm gonna murderlize that
dumb creep! He can't possibly
make me angrier than I am now!
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
“誰在乎我怎麼想？！”
嘎啊啊啊~！！
誰在乎他怎麼想啊！！^333333*氣喘吁吁*^000000
我要把那個蠢貨殺了！他不可能讓我比現在更生氣了！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
That's it.
It's decided. The
next time I see Digotz,
I'm gonna plaster his
face all over the floor.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
就這樣。
決定了。下次見到迪戈茨，我要把他的臉狠狠拍在地上。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Wha...? I dunno if Digotz
would say something like
that. You sure you heard
him carefully enough? It's
been a while, but I know
how Digotz talks, man.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
什...？我不確定迪戈茨會說那種話。
你確定你聽清楚了嗎？
雖然已經很久沒見了，但我還是知道迪戈茨怎麼說話的，兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Don't get me wrong, I don't
miss the guy or anything like
that and I don't feel sorry about
what happened. But if he ever
came to apologize to me, I'd
probably accept, you know.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
別誤會，我並不是想念那個傢伙之類的，我也對發生的事不覺得抱歉。但如果他真的來向我道歉，我大概會接受的，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Well, after thinking
about it, of course.
I mean, I'm not the one
holding a grudge. It's all
that guy's fault! Sheeeesh!
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
嗯，想清楚之後，當然是這樣了。
畢竟，我才是那個沒有記仇的人。都是那個傢伙的錯！真是的！

scripts.text: I actually met Digotz and...
scripts.translation: 我其實見過迪戈茨，而且...

scripts.text:
[Maku]
You what...?!
You saw my old pal,
Digotz?! Er, I mean,
Mister Alexander Digotz,
who usedta be my buddy,
but obviously not anymore.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
你什麼...？！
你見到我以前的哥們兒，迪戈茨了？！呃，我是說，亞歷山大·迪戈茨先生，他以前是我的好朋友，但顯然現在不是了。

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Sure, we were real close
at one time, but that was
too long ago. It's been a
long time since we hung
out and he probably hates
my penniless guts and...
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
沒錯，我們以前確實很親密，但那都是很久以前的事了。我們已經很久沒一起玩了，他大概很討厭我這個窮光蛋，而且...

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Crud, just listen to
me, I sound like a wuss.
I don't miss Digotz! In fact,
I hate the guy, one hundred
percent! The next time I see
him, I'll beat him to a pulp!
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
該死，聽聽我說的話，我像個膽小鬼一樣。
我才不懷念迪戈茨！事實上，我百分之百討厭那個傢伙！下次見到他，我要把他揍得滿地找牙！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
I don't know if you know,
but actually, the people who
live here ain't allowed to
explore this whole city. It's
kind of taboo to talk about,
but what do I care, right?
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
我不知道你知不知道，但住在這裡的人其實是不允許探索整座城市的。談論這件事有點禁忌，但我才不在乎呢，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Yeah, basically the rich
people here are too afraid
of the poor people comin' to
see them, so the security in
this city is pretty tight! Those
upper class guys are trash...
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
是的，基本上這裡的富人太害怕窮人來找他們了，所以這座城市的安保非常嚴密！那些上層階級的人真是垃圾...

scripts.text:
[Maku]
I didn't used to think
this way. I actually used
to have a pretty rich friend
till I found out he's not all
I thought he was. That
moron! Why's he like that?!
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
我以前不是這樣想的。我其實曾經有一個挺有錢的朋友，直到我發現他並不是我以為的那樣。那個蠢貨！他為什麼那樣？！

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Eh, forget about it.
Why am I even talking
about my personal life
to someone I just met
anyway? Sure, we all
do it, but still...
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
呃，算了。
我為什麼要把我的私生活告訴一個剛認識的人呢？
雖然大家都會這樣做，但還是...

scripts.text:
[Maku]
Well, when you get
bored of the ghetto,
you really oughta check
out the rich section of town.
I'm bitter, but I'll also admit
it's way nicer than this place.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫]
好吧，當你厭倦了貧民窟，你真的應該去看看富人區。
我雖然很嫉妒，但我也承認那裡比這裡好多了。

scripts.text:
[Joey Choryee]
This is a study area where
you're not supposed to speak,
walk or even breathe loudly.
Still, students like Benkaistein can tune out the whole world
when they study hard enough...
scripts.translation:
[喬伊·喬裡]
這是自習區，禁止說話、走動，甚至不能大聲呼吸。
不過，像本凱斯坦這樣的學生，只要足夠專注，就能忘卻整個世界...

scripts.text:
[Joey Choryee]
Benkaistein...?
He's in the north part
of this room. He's a real
nice guy, but a little anal.
Well, he's too organized
and he labels everything!
scripts.translation:
[喬伊·喬裡]
本凱斯坦...？
他在這間教室的北邊。他人很好，但有點強迫症。
嗯，他太有條理了，而且給一切都貼標籤！

scripts.text:
[Joey Choryee]
Property damage. Huh.
It has to do with lightning
and fire and water and stuff
like that? Here I thought it
meant, I dunno, buildings
getting wrecked or something.
scripts.translation:
[喬伊·喬裡]
財產損壞。嗯。
這跟閃電、火、水之類的有關？
我還以為是指建築物被毀之類的呢。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務將部分物品存入倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Were you able to bring
my journal to Digotz and
Maku? I'm pretty sure it'd
remind them of all the good
times we had. I know they
sure can be stubborn...
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦]
你能把我的日記帶給迪戈茨和馬庫嗎？
我確信那會讓他們想起我們在一起的美好時光。
我知道他們可能很固執...

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Anyway, I really
appreciate all your
help. When I go back
home, I look forward to
seeing the two of them again.
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦]
總之，我非常感謝你的幫助。
等我回家，我很期待再次見到他們兩個。

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Until then, I need to research,
finish my thesis and accomplish
my academic goals. Oh, please
take this pass which will let you
go back and forth between the
rich and poor areas as my thanks.
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦]
在那之前，我需要研究、完成我的論文並實現我的學術目標。
哦，請收下這張通行證，它可以讓你在富人和窮人區之間自由往返，作為我的感謝。

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Anyway, I wish you
safety in your travels,
adventurer. When the three
of us get together, I'll be
sure to let you know~
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦]
總之，祝你在旅途中平安，冒險者。
當我們三個聚在一起時，我一定會告訴你的~

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Aw nuts, this is
taking much longer
than I had expected.
Now where did I put
that thing? Hmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦]
哎呀，這花的時間比我預期的要長得多。
我把那個東西放哪兒了？嗯...

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Oh, is that it?
Did you find my
journal? Quick, let
me check. Yes, yes...
This is it! Thank you
for finding this for me!
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦]
哦，是這個嗎？
你找到我的日記了嗎？快，讓我檢查一下。
是的，是的...
就是這個！謝謝你幫我找到這個！

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Would you mind doing
a favor for me? It'd be
better if I talk to them
myself, but I'm too busy
working on this thesis...
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦]
你介意幫我一個忙嗎？
最好是我親自跟他們談，但我現在太忙於寫論文了...

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Would you please give this
journal to Digotz and Maku?
I wrote in it when we were
really young, so it should
remind them of all the good
times we used to share.
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦]
請幫我把這本日記交給迪戈茨和馬庫好嗎？
這是我們小時候寫的，應該能讓他們想起我們曾經一起度過的美好時光。

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Anyway, this should at
least help them realize
how stupid they've been
acting. Thanks in advance,
and please take care of
Maku and Digotz for me.
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦]
總之，這至少能讓他們意識到自己現在的行為有多愚蠢。
提前謝謝你了，也請幫我照顧好馬庫和迪戈茨。

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Aw nuts, this is
taking much longer
than I had expected.
Now where did I put
that thing? Hmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦]
哎呀，這花的時間比我預期的要長得多。
我把那個東西放哪兒了？嗯...

scripts.text:
^3355FFPerhaps it would
be best if you help
Benkaistein look for
he is searching for.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF也許你該幫本凱斯坦找找他正在尋找的東西。^000000

scripts.text:
[Passionate Student]
Oh, you startled me!
Still, I'm aware that it's
hard to get my attention
once I immerse myself
in a book. So, how can
I help you, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[熱情的學生]
哎呀，嚇我一跳！
不過我知道，一旦沉浸在書裡就很難注意到別人。那麼，冒險者，有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: Tell him about Maku and Digotz.
scripts.translation: 告訴他關於馬庫和迪戈茨的事

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Oh, how are my friends
doing? Oh, what? They're
having a huge fight just
because one's rich and
the other one's poor?
That's pretty childish!
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦]
哦，我的朋友們最近怎麼樣？哦？他們因為一個有錢一個沒錢就在大吵大鬧？
這也太幼稚了！

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
But then again, that's just
like them. *Sigh* I really want
to go back home and get those
two to make up, but I also need
to finish this thesis. Let's see... What can I possibly do from here?
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦]
不過話說回來，他們就是這樣的人。*嘆氣* 我真想回家讓他們和好，但我還得完成這篇論文。
讓我想想...我現在能做什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Benkaistein]
Oh, I know what I can do!
Wait, but where did I put it?
Oh, how could I lose something
so important? Wait! Would you
please wait a second while
I look for something?
scripts.translation:
[本凱斯坦]
哦，我知道該做什麼了！
等等，我把它放哪兒了？
我怎麼會把這麼重要的東西弄丟呢？等等！請等一下，讓我找找東西。

scripts.text:
[Passionate Student]
Let's see, now.
Wind Magic, Black Magic,
Porings, ah, there it is.
Monster race properties.
Hopefully this contains
the information I need...
scripts.translation:
[熱情的學生]
讓我看看。
風魔法，黑魔法，波利，啊，在這裡。
魔物種族特性。
希望這裡面有我需要的資訊...

scripts.text:
^3355FFUpon briefly glancing at
this student's belongings,
you notice that the name
''Benkaistein'' is printed
on them. This is the friend
mentioned by Maku and Digotz!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你粗略地看了看這個學生的物品，發現上面印著“本凱斯坦”的名字。
這就是馬庫和迪戈茨提到的那位朋友！^000000

scripts.text: Excuse me...
scripts.translation: 打擾一下...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...
Benkaistein?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下...
本凱斯坦？

scripts.text:
[Passionate Student]
...The world of humans
and the world of demons,
yes, yes... No, what I'm
looking for is a reference
to the heavens or Asgard.
Hmm, this here might help...
scripts.translation:
[熱情的學生]
...人類的世界和惡魔的世界，是的，是的...
不，我要找的是關於天堂或阿斯加德的記載。
嗯，這個可能有用...

scripts.text: Hey...

[{0}]
Hey...
Over here.
Benkaistein!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿...
這邊。
本凱斯坦！

scripts.text:
[Passionate Student]
...Oh, now that's a very
interesting observation.
If I can incorporate that
into my thesis without too
much trouble, my standpoint
would look much more solid...
scripts.translation:
[熱情的學生]
...哦，這是一個非常有趣的觀察。
如果我能不費太多力氣把它融入我的論文，我的論點就會看起來更紮實...

scripts.text: HEY YOU...!

[{0}]
HEY YOU...!
BENKAISTEIN~!

[Passionate Student]
Oh, good heavens!
C-can't you keep
your voice down?
I-I'm trying to study!
No, wait. Have you been
calling me all this time?
scripts.translation:
[熱情的學生]
哦，天哪！
你...你能不能小聲點？
我...我在做研究！
等等。你剛才一直在叫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Passionate Student]
Let's see, now.
Wind Magic, Black Magic,
Porings, ah, there it is.
Monster race properties.
Hopefully this contains
the information I need...
scripts.translation:
[熱情的學生]
讓我看看。
風魔法，黑魔法，波利，啊，在這裡。
魔物種族特性。
希望這裡面有我需要的資訊...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis student seems to
be dilligently conducting
intensive research on some
academic subject. For now,
it would be best to leave him
alone so that he can study.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這個學生似乎正在專心致志地進行某項學術研究。
目前，最好讓他一個人安靜地學習。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's nothing
over here that you
really need anymore.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡沒有什麼你真正需要的東西了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis book is labeled,
''Benkaistein's Journal
Vol. 6.'' This is probably
what Benkaistein was trying
to find, so it might be best to
bring this and show it to him.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這本書的標籤上寫著
“本凱斯坦的日誌第6卷”。這大概就是本凱斯坦一直在尋找的東西，最好把它帶給他看看。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's nothing of
any real interest
over here for now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡暫時沒有什麼特別有趣的東西。^000000

scripts.text:
[??????]
I...
I despise the living.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
我...
我憎恨活著的人。

scripts.text:
[??????]
I...
I despise the living.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
我...
我憎恨活著的人。

scripts.text:
[??????]
I...
I despise the living.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
我...
我憎恨活著的人。

scripts.text:
[?????]
Honey, I'm sorry,
but I... We know how
hungry you are, but we
have nothing to feed you.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
親愛的，對不起，但是...我們知道你很餓，可是我們沒有東西給你吃。

scripts.text:
[?????]
*Sniff* I know, I know,
but somehow, that tragic
truth eats away at me just
a little bit more everyday...
scripts.translation:
[?????]
*吸吸鼻子* 我知道，我知道，但不知為何，那個悲慘的事實讓我每天都更加痛苦...

scripts.text:
[?????]
D-damn it...!
Why do we have
to live like this?!
It's like we're less
than animals. I hate this!
scripts.translation:
[?????]
該死...！
為什麼我們要過這種日子？！
簡直比動物還不如。我恨透了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Those voices weren't
just in my head, were they?
Hello...? Anybody there...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那些聲音不只是在我腦海裡，對吧？
你好...？有人在嗎...？

scripts.text:
[?????]
Hey, you won't
believe it! Rekenber
decided to hire us!
scripts.translation:
[?????]
嘿，你絕對不敢相信！雷根貝勒決定僱用我們了！

scripts.text:
[???????]
You sure that's so great?
Those big corporations
always take advantage
of the little guy. We're
probably gonna end up
slavin' away for our wages...
scripts.translation:
[???????]
你確定那是好事嗎？
那些大公司總是欺負小人物。我們大概又要為了工資拼命幹活了...

scripts.text:
[?????]
No, that's not the
case at all. I mean,
sure, we won't start off
with much responsibility,
but they'll pay us well!
scripts.translation:
[?????]
不，完全不是那樣。我是說，當然，我們一開始不會承擔很多責任，但他們給的薪水很高！

scripts.text:
[?????]
Well, we do need to eat.
If they're true to their word,
that'll be even better!
scripts.translation:
[?????]
嗯，我們確實需要吃飯。
如果他們說到做到，那就更好了！

scripts.text:
[???]
Waaaah!
Waaaaaaah~!

[????]
Woman, shut this
baby up! Shut up, kid!
scripts.translation:
[????]
女人，快讓這個嬰兒安靜下來！閉嘴，小鬼！

scripts.text:
[?????]
Honey, please...
He's just a baby!
scripts.translation:
[?????]
親愛的，求你了...
他只是個嬰兒！

scripts.text:
[????]
I don't care how
crummy this house is!
It's mine and I want quiet!
scripts.translation:
[????]
我才不管這房子有多破！
這是我的房子，我要安靜！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm hearing things
again! Where are all of
these voices coming from?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我又聽到聲音了！
這些聲音都是從哪裡來的？

scripts.text:
[?????]
Mommy, why don't those
dirty people get new clothes?
Don't they know it's gross?
They're scaring me...
scripts.translation:
[?????]
媽媽，為什麼那些髒兮兮的人不穿新衣服？
他們難道不知道那樣很噁心嗎？
他們嚇到我了...

scripts.text:
[???????]
Honey, don't look at
them and hurry up!
scripts.translation:
[???????]
親愛的，別看著他們，快點走！

scripts.text:
[????]
Please, do you have
any spare change? I...
I need something to eat...
scripts.translation:
[????]
請...請問您有零錢嗎？我...
我需要買點吃的...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is...
This is insane!
I must be hallucinating!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這...這太瘋狂了！
我一定是產生幻覺了！

scripts.text:
[?????]
Listen, I know you're
the newest hire, but you've
shown us a lot of potential.
I think you'd be a perfect
fit for this new position.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
聽著，雖然你是新來的，但你展現出了很大的潛力。
我覺得你非常適合這個新職位。

scripts.text:
[???????]
Are you really serious?

[?????]
I'll tell it to you straight.
This new position will require
you to be away from home once
in a while, but that comes with
the new responsibilities.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
我直說了吧。
這個新職位偶爾需要你離家，但這伴隨著新的職責。

scripts.text:
[?????]
But you'll receive
many new benefits that
I'm sure your family would
appreciate and you'll be
generously compensated.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
但你會獲得許多新的福利，我相信你的家人會很高興，而且你會得到豐厚的報酬。

scripts.text:
[???????]
...Alright, I'm in.

[?????]
So, what exactly did you
want me to do? I'm sorry,
I wasn't able to gather my
actual job function from
the presentation...
scripts.translation:
[?????]
那麼，你具體想讓我做什麼？
抱歉，我在介紹會上沒能搞清楚我的具體職責...

scripts.text:
[???]
Hee hee hee~
Don't worry about it.
Just relax and stay
right where you are.
scripts.translation:
[???]
呵呵呵~
別擔心。
就放鬆地待在原地吧。

scripts.text:
[?????]
Mmm. Alright.
I just thought that I was
supposed to go somewhere,
that's all. Um, shouldn't
I be getting ready...?
scripts.translation:
[?????]
嗯。好的。
我只是以為我該去某個地方，僅此而已。嗯，我不該準備一下...？

scripts.text:
[???]
Oh, don't worry about
that, either. All of the
arrangements will be
taken care of. You'll
be taken to that far
off place very soon...
scripts.translation:
[???]
哦，那個也不用擔心。
所有安排都會處理好的。
你很快就會去那個遙遠的地方...

scripts.text:
[????]
Oh, I'm so sorry to
hear that you want to
quit. Are you sure there
isn't anything we can do
to change your mind?
scripts.translation:
[????]
聽到你想辭職，我很遺憾。你確定我們不能做點什麼改變你的想法嗎？

scripts.text:
[???]
Well, I'm thinking of
retiring early and just
spending more time
with my family. But I won't
ever talk about the company
or any of its, well, secrets.
scripts.translation:
[???]
嗯，我想提前退休，多陪陪家人。但我永遠不會談論公司或它的，嗯，秘密。

scripts.text:
[????]
I really appreciate
your honesty and sincerity.
You've really done a great
job for us and I can't thank
you enough for your years of
dedication to this company.
scripts.translation:
[????]
我非常感激你的誠實和真誠。
你為我們做了很多，我無法感謝你對公司多年的奉獻。

scripts.text:
[???]
Thank you, sir.
scripts.translation:
[???]
謝謝您，先生。

scripts.text:
[????]
It would be a great loss
for this company to let you
go now. But I guess we have
no choice, since you've had
that horrible accident.
scripts.translation:
[????]
現在讓你離開對公司是個巨大的損失。但我想我們別無選擇，既然你遭遇了那場可怕的事故。

scripts.text:
[???]
Sir...?
Accident...?
I don't understand
what you're talking ab--
scripts.translation:
[???]
先生...？
事故...？
我不明白你在說什麼——

scripts.text:
[???]
N-no! Please...!
I didn't, I swear on
my life that I won't ever
say anything about this
place! I'm begging you,
for the love of god!
scripts.translation:
[???]
不！求求你...！
我沒有，我發誓我永遠不會說這個地方的任何事！
我求求你，看在神明的份上！

scripts.text:
[????]
Your life...?
Sorry, not good enough.
You should have known.
scripts.translation:
[????]
你的命...？
抱歉，這不夠。
你早該知道的。

scripts.text:
[???]
Ssstop! I have chil--
MY LEEEEGS!! OH MY GOD
WHAT HAVE YOU DONE TO
MY LEGS?! HELP ME, OH MY G--
scripts.translation:
[???]
住手！我有孩--
我的腿！！天哪你們對我的腿做了什麼？！
救救我，天哪--

scripts.text:
[??]
Doctor Varmunt,
you've finally agreed
to join us. Welcome!
scripts.translation:
[??]
瓦爾蒙特博士，你終於同意加入我們了。歡迎！

scripts.text:
[Varmunt]
Well, I don't know if I agree
with this company's policies,
but the project you're offering
seems to be an opportunity that
comes once in a lifetime, so...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
嗯，我不確定自己是否認同這家公司的政策，但你們提供的專案似乎是一生難遇的機會，所以...

scripts.text:
[??]
To be honest, this project
can only be a success with
your cooperation. We need
your genius and will provide
whatever you require.
scripts.translation:
[??]
說實話，這個專案只有靠你的合作才能成功。
我們需要你的天才，並且會提供你所需的一切。

scripts.text:
[Varmunt]
I'm flattered.
And of course, I'll
do my best. It's just
that this deal sounds
too good to be true...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
我很榮幸。
當然，我會盡力而為。
只是這交易聽起來好得讓人難以置信...

scripts.text:
[??]
Amazing. You've accomplished
what most have thought to be
impossible ahead of schedule.
An imitation of Ymir's Heart!
This will surely spur Airship
and Guardian development~!
scripts.translation:
[??]
太棒了。你提前完成了大多數人認為不可能的事。
依美樂的心臟的仿製品！
這肯定會推動飛空艇和守衛的開發~！

scripts.text:
[Varmunt]
I still don't believe that
were able to do it. This is
a huge leap for science, even
if this imitation isn't as powerful as the real Ymir's Heart.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
我還是不敢相信我們居然做到了。這對科學來說是一次巨大的飛躍，即使這個仿製品不如真正的依美樂之心強大。

scripts.text:
[??]
Come, we must celebrate!
Let's go outside and have
a toast in your honor! Ha ha~
scripts.translation:
[??]
來吧，我們必須慶祝！
讓我們出去為你乾一杯吧！Ha ha~~

scripts.text:
[??]
But why, Doctor Varmunt?
If you're unhappy with the
Rekenber Corporation for
any reason whatsoever...
scripts.translation:
[??]
但是為什麼，瓦爾蒙特博士？
如果你因為任何原因對雷根貝勒公司不滿意...

scripts.text:
[Varmunt]
Well, I don't really
have a reason to remain
now that we've accomplished
what I've agreed to do. It's time for me to return and work on
my personal research.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
嗯，既然我們已經完成了我答應要做的事，我現在沒有理由留在這裡了。
是時候回去進行我的個人研究了。

scripts.text:
[??]
Please, Doctor Varmunt,
reconsider! You may have
full use of our facilities to
conduct your research. I'm
willing to make you an offer.
scripts.translation:
[??]
請，瓦爾蒙特博士，再考慮一下！你可以完全使用我們的設施進行研究。我願意給你一個報價。

scripts.text:
[Varmunt]
No, I can't...
If I continue to work
here, I'm afraid I might
make a lot of people
unhappy. But, thank
you for everything.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
不，我不能...
如果我繼續在這裡工作，我恐怕會讓很多人不高興。但是，謝謝你所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[??]
Wait...
Doctor Varmunt.
You forgot your cane.
scripts.translation:
[??]
等等...
瓦爾蒙特博士。
你忘了你的柺杖。

scripts.text:
[Varmunt]
Since when have you
seen me use a cane?
And even if I did,
that one isn't mi--
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
你什麼時候見過我用柺杖？
即使我用了，那根也不是我的--

scripts.text:
Doctor Varmunt,
you've finally agreed
to join us. Welcome!
scripts.translation: 瓦爾蒙特博士，你終於答應加入我們了。歡迎！

不，我不能...
如果我繼續在這裡工作，我恐怕會讓很多人不高興。但是，謝謝你所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[??]
Wait...
Doctor Varmunt.
You forgot your cane.
scripts.translation:
[??]
等等...
瓦爾蒙特博士。
你忘了你的柺杖。

scripts.text:
[Varmunt]
Since when have you
seen me use a cane?
And even if I did,
that one isn't mi--
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
你什麼時候見過我用柺杖？
即使我用了，那根也不是我的--

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's something on
the floor, but you can't
really take a good look at
what it is right now. Perhaps
if you freed up more space
in your inventory...
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地上有東西，但現在看不清是什麼。
也許騰出更多背包空間就能看清了...

scripts.text:
[???]
It's over.
I really want
to quit. This is
the end for me.
scripts.translation:
[???]
一切都結束了。
我真的想辭職。
我撐不下去了。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco]
^3131FFThis is the end!
This is the end!^000000
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥]
^3131FF結束了！
結束了！^000000

scripts.text:
[???]
He was right to say that
we'd be paid well, but going
through this much torture isn't
worth any sum of money in the
world to me. *Sigh* Money...
scripts.translation:
[???]
他說我們會得到豐厚的報酬，但經歷這麼多折磨，世界上沒有任何金錢能彌補。*嘆氣* 金錢...

scripts.text:
[???]
She must be so worried
about me by now. And her
health is so bad. I'm such
a fool for leaving her behind.
scripts.translation:
[???]
她現在一定很擔心我。
而且她的身體很不好。
我真是個傻瓜，把她一個人留在那兒。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco]
Such a fool!
Such a fool!
*Squaaawk~*
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥]
傻瓜！
傻瓜！
*Squaaawk~*

scripts.text:
[???]
Damn it!
Shut up, you stupid bird!
Be quiet for just a minute!
scripts.translation:
[???]
該死！
閉嘴，你這蠢鳥！
安靜一分鐘！

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco]
*Squaaaawk!*
Death Penalty!
Death Penalty!
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥]
*Squaaaawk!*
死刑！
死刑！

scripts.text:
[???]
Death penalty?
Where'd you learn
to say something weird
like that? Huh. That's...
scripts.translation:
[???]
死刑？
你從哪兒學會說這種奇怪的話？
嗯。那是...

scripts.text:
[???]
I'm the only one still
in this room. Everyone
else left and never came
back. If they were... And
I were to go out... Then...
Maybe I better not leave.
scripts.translation:
[???]
我是這個房間裡唯一還留在這裡的人。其他人都離開了，再也沒有回來。如果他們...如果我也出去...那麼...
也許我還是別離開好了。

scripts.text:
[???]
If I could only give
this pendant back to
her, she wouldn't have
to worry about me that
much. But I might not
be able to get back...
scripts.translation:
[???]
如果我能把這個吊墜還給她，她就不會那麼擔心我了。
但我可能回不去了...

scripts.text:
[?????]
Hey there, been
waiting long? It's
time for you to finish
up your contract.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
嘿，等了很久吧？
是時候結束你的契約了。

scripts.text:
[???]
Finish up my...?
N-no! I've decided!
I'm not leaving this room!
scripts.translation:
[???]
結束我的...？
不！我決定了！
我不離開這個房間！

scripts.text:
[?????]
Hey hey, what the hell
are you talking about?
You came here to work,
didn't you? And now it's
time for you to collect, so...
scripts.translation:
[?????]
嘿，你在說什麼呢？
你來這裡是為了工作，不是嗎？現在是時候領取報酬了，所以...

scripts.text:
[???]
N-no, l-let go of me!
Please let me go!
I want to see her again,
please let me see her...!
scripts.translation:
[???]
不，放開我！
請放開我！
我想再見她一面，請讓我見她...！

scripts.text:
[??]
Hm? Who the hell
brought in this cheap
jewery? Someone must
have forgotten to throw
away their trash...
scripts.translation:
[??]
嗯？誰把這種廉價的首飾帶進來了？
一定是有人忘了扔掉垃圾...

scripts.text:
[????]
Yeah, it's just a
cheap trinket. That
pendant isn't even
worth picking up.
scripts.translation:
[????]
是啊，只是個廉價的小玩意。
那個吊墜甚至不值得撿起來。

scripts.text:
^3131FFYou pick up an old
pendant from the ground.
No matter how hard you try,
you can't open its clasp to see
what this pendant contains.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF你從地上撿起一箇舊吊墜。
無論怎麼嘗試，都無法開啟它的扣環，看看裡面藏著什麼。^000000

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco]
You're a fool!
You're a fool!
You're a fool!
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥]
你是笨蛋！
你是笨蛋！
你是笨蛋！

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco]
You're a fool!
You're a fool!
You're a fool!
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥]
你是笨蛋！
你是笨蛋！
你是笨蛋！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
No wonder you look
so weary. Come, let
me help relieve you
of the burden that
you are carrying.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
難怪你看起來如此疲憊。過來，讓我幫你卸下你揹負的重擔。

scripts.text: Um, burden...?
Crazy old woman!
scripts.translation: 瘋老太婆！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Ah yes, they may not
be apparent to you, but
my eyes can clearly see
them. Yes. You're being
followed by those things.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
啊，是的，也許你自己察覺不到，但我看得一清二楚。
沒錯，那些東西正在跟著你。

scripts.text: Things?
scripts.translation: 東西？

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Yes. The best way I can
describe them is as evil
thoughts left in the world
when someone dies in
such a way that his grudge
survives to menace the living.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
是的。我只能這樣描述它們：有人以某種方式死去，怨恨卻留存下來，繼續威脅活人，這種怨恨便化作留在世間的邪念。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Sometimes, these lingering
thoughts are created when
someone is broken hearted
or clings to this plane for the
sake of a loved one. Yes, those
thoughts are following you.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
有時候，這些殘留的念頭是在某人傷心欲絕，或為了所愛之人而眷戀此世時產生的。
是的，那些念頭正在跟著你。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
I don't know why they
are following you, but I'm
certain they're there. Have
you been experiencing chills
down your spine, cold sweats,
maybe even hearing voices?
scripts.translation:
[長老]
我不知道它們為什麼跟著你，但我確信它們在那裡。
你有沒有感到脊背發涼、冷汗直流，甚至聽到聲音？

scripts.text: Yes! How do I get rid of them?
scripts.translation: 有！我該怎麼擺脫它們？

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Well, usually these lingering
thoughts have some sort of
physical anchor, an object
that has feelings attached
to it, something important
to its late owner.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
嗯，通常這些殘留的念頭會有某種物理錨點，一個附著了情感的物體，對其已故主人來說很重要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
The rage they're directing
at you seems to be growing
and I can see the angry spirits
pulling at the hems of your
clothes. Tell me, have you
wronged anyone recently?!
scripts.translation:
[長老]
它們對你發出的怒意似乎越來越強。我看見憤怒的亡靈正拉扯著你的衣角。告訴我，你最近得罪過誰嗎？！

scripts.text: I don't... think so.
scripts.translation: 我...不覺得有

scripts.text: I can't remember every bad thing I've done!
scripts.translation: 我記不清我做過每一件壞事！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Well, you better do
something soon, before
the evil taints your mind
and drives you to insanity!
Now, I need to know for sure
if you've been hearing voices.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
嗯，你最好快點做點什麼，在邪惡侵蝕你的心靈，讓你發瘋之前！
現在，我需要確切知道你是否聽到了聲音。

scripts.text: Y-yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 是...是的，我聽到了

scripts.text:
[Elder]
There's still hope.
The spirits are trying
to reach you for now, but
if you wait too long, you may
become a victim of their wrath.
Hurry, there is much to do!
scripts.translation:
[長老]
還有希望。
亡靈們目前只是在試圖接觸你，但如果你等待太久，你可能會成為它們憤怒的受害者。
快一點，還有很多事要做！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
You must appease these
forces by finding out what
happened to them in life.
Now, I don't possess great
power, but I can encourage
the spirits to guide you.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
你必須通過查明它們生前的遭遇來平息這些力量。
現在，我並沒有強大的力量，但我可以鼓勵亡靈指引你。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
I can only have the spirits
reveal the places they wish
for you to search only once.
You must remember the
locations that I am about
to show you. Get ready...
scripts.translation:
[長老]
我只能讓亡靈向你揭示它們希望你搜索的地方一次。
你必須記住我即將展示給你的地點。
做好準備...

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Yaaaaappp ---!
scripts.translation:
[長老]
呀啊啊啊——！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
There! The locations
you must search should
be clear to you now! Don't
forget these placemarks!
scripts.translation:
[長老]
好了！
你應該已經清楚需要搜尋的地點了！
別忘了這些地標！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Good luck, youngster.
I hope you can appease
the wrath of these spirits...
But as long as you let them guide you, you ought to be safe.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
祝你好運，年輕人。
希望你能平息這些亡靈的怒火...
只要讓它們指引你，你應該就是安全的。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Crazy...? Hm, you must
not quite understand what's
happening to you. Please do
not hesitate to come back to
me when you realize that you
need my help, youngster.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
瘋了...？嗯，你似乎還沒完全明白正在發生什麼。
當你意識到需要我的幫助時，請隨時回來找我，年輕人。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
I'm sorry, but there's
nothing more I can do for
you right now. But if you
find anything related to the
spirits that torment you,
please let me know.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
很抱歉，我現在無能為力。
但如果你找到了任何與折磨你的亡靈有關的東西，請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Greetings, adventurer.
How goes your search for
the remains of the spirits
that still cling to this plane?
scripts.translation:
[長老]
你好，冒險者。
你尋找那些仍滯留於現世的亡靈遺物的進展如何？

scripts.text: Show him the Pendant.
scripts.translation: 給他看吊墜

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Oh my... There are some
incredibly powerful emotions
clinging to this pendant. If we
don't do anything about this,
you'll be cursed very soon.
This is what you must do.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
天哪...這個吊墜上附著著極其強烈的情感。
如果我們不採取行動，你很快就會受到詛咒。
這是你必須做的事。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Hurry and bring
^3131FF5 Holy Water^000000 and
^3131FF1 Bouquet^000000. The Holy Water
will purify this Pendant and
the Bouquet will comfort
the spirit of its owner.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
快帶
^3131FF5瓶聖水^000000和
^3131FF1個花束^000000來。聖水將淨化這個吊墜，花束將撫慰它主人的靈魂。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
You don't have much
time, so return to me
as soon as possible!
It won't be long until
the spirits are consumed
by their supernatural rage...
scripts.translation:
[長老]
你時間不多了，請儘快回來！
亡靈們很快就會被超自然的憤怒吞噬...

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Greetings, adventurer.
How goes your search for
the remains of the spirits
that still cling to this plane?
scripts.translation:
[長老]
你好，冒險者。
你尋找那些仍滯留於現世的亡靈遺物的進展如何？

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Wait...
Why do I sense
that you've found
something, but have
not brought it with you?
You must retrace your steps!
scripts.translation:
[長老]
等等...
為什麼我感覺你找到了什麼，卻沒有帶在身上？
你必須重新檢查一遍！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Good, good.
All is in readiness.
Please be silent as
I focus my spirit for the
great task before me.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
很好，很好。
一切準備就緒。
請保持安靜，我要集中精神完成眼前的大任務。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Yaaaaapp ---!
scripts.translation:
[長老]
呀啊啊啊——！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Whew! I've managed
to nullify this curse for you.
That still doesn't change the
fact that what happened to this
pendant's owner was tragic...
scripts.translation:
[長老]
呼！我成功為你解除了這個詛咒。
但這並不改變吊墜主人遭遇悲劇的事實...

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Why don't you bring
this pendant to the place
where it really belongs?
I'm sure that would bring
great comfort to its owner.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
你為什麼不把這個吊墜帶到它真正該去的地方？
我相信那會給它的主人帶來巨大的慰藉。

scripts.text:
^3355FFSuddenly, the clasp on
the pendant pops open,
revealing a picture of a happy
couple. Somehow, the girl in
the picture, sitting uncomfortably^FFFFFF^3355FF in an old chair, looks familiar...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF突然，吊墜的扣環彈開了，露出了一張幸福情侶的照片。
不知為何，照片中那個坐在舊椅子上、^FFFFFF^3355FF顯得不太自在的女孩，看起來很眼熟...^000000

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Hurry and bring
^3131FF5 Holy Water^000000 and
^3131FF1 Bouquet^000000 in order
for me to nullify this
curse. Do not forget to
bring the Pendant as well.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
快帶
^3131FF5瓶聖水^000000和
^3131FF1個花束^000000來，以便我解除這個詛咒。
別忘了帶上吊墜。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Predators are always
on the lookout for easy
prey. Be careful, youngster!
You look innocent enough
to become a victim in the city.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
掠食者總是在尋找容易下手的目標。
小心點，年輕人！
你在城裡看起來人畜無害，很容易成為受害者。

scripts.text: About Lighthalzen
scripts.translation: 關於裡希塔樂鎮

scripts.text: About the Slum
scripts.translation: 關於貧民窟

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Lighthalzen might seem
like a splendid city at first,
but you'll quickly learn that
the poor are segregated from
the rich and treated as less
than second class citizens.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
裡希塔樂鎮乍看之下可能是一座繁華的城市，但你很快就會發現，窮人被隔離在富人之外，受到的待遇甚至不如二等公民。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
At first, separation between
the rich and poor districts was
subtly enforced. They built the
railroad right between the two
districts to make it easier for
the rich to ignore the poor.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
起初，貧富區的隔離只是隱性的。
他們在兩個區域之間修建了鐵路，讓富人更容易無視窮人的存在。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
But now they even have
guards to make sure that
the poor can't bother the
rich. I'm pretty sure that
this segregation won't be
ending anytime soon...
scripts.translation:
[長老]
但現在他們甚至派了衛兵，確保窮人不會打擾到富人。
我很確定，這種隔離狀態短時間內不會結束...

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Now, I've heard that the
Rekenber Corporation is
actually providing jobs for
people in the slums. Beggars
can't be choosers, so I'm sure
these jobs aren't that great.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
我聽說，雷根貝勒公司實際上正在為貧民窟的人提供工作。
乞丐們別無選擇，所以我相信這些工作條件不會太好。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
To live in the slum is to
be familiar with poverty,
disease, condemnation
and contempt. But we're all
still people, you know, so let
go of any of your misgivings.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
生活在貧民窟，意味著要熟悉貧窮、疾病、指責和蔑視。但我們畢竟都是人，所以請放下你的顧慮吧。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
We're struggling just
to survive here. At the
very least, please respect
that. It's a fact that the
people in the rich district
seem to keep forgetting.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
我們在這裡只是勉強求生。
至少，請尊重這一點。
這是富人區的人似乎總是忘記的事實。

scripts.text:
[Elder]
Well, if you need any
help around here or have
any questions, come back
and ask me. I get the feeling
that we'll probably meet again.
scripts.translation:
[長老]
好了，如果你在這裡需要任何幫助，或者有任何問題，隨時回來找我。
我有種預感，我們還會再見的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey there, are
you feeling alright?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，你好，你還好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Crippled Girl]
Oh, thanks,
I'm fine. But...
Have we met before?
scripts.translation:
[行動不便的女孩]
哦，謝謝，我沒事。但是...
我們以前見過嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeah, we did.
You should know who
I am by now. Hey, you
didn't forget, did you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我們見過。
你現在應該知道我是誰了。
嘿，你沒忘記吧？

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Oh, how do I put this?
The fever she had for the
last few days. She's gotten
better, but she's forgotten
everything that's happened
in the past few weeks...
scripts.translation:
[女士]
哎呀，該怎麼說呢？
她前幾天發高燒。
現在好多了，但她忘記了過去幾週發生的所有事情...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... Oh. I'm so
sorry. But maybe this
is for the best? Here,
I think you should keep
this pendant, though.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦...哦。真抱歉。
但也許這樣是最好的？
拿著，我覺得你應該保留這個吊墜。

scripts.text:
^3131ffYou place the
old pendant
into her hands.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131ff你將舊吊墜放入她的手中。^000000

scripts.text:
[Possessed {0}]
^3131FFSetsu, please remember
that I'd never do anything
to hurt you. Forgive me for
leaving you behind. I hope
that one day we'll meet
again, little princess.^000000

Oh, how do I put this?
The fever she had for the
last few days. She's gotten
better, but she's forgotten
everything that's happened
in the past few weeks...

walk but I don't cry

scripts.translation:

be his friend, is that right?

scripts.text:
[{0}]

[{0}]

[{0}]

scripts.text:

...
......
scripts.translation:
[腿腳不便的女孩]
...
...

scripts.text:

happy of that, because

scripts.translation:

[{0}]

brother come.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Representative]
Greetings, and welcome
to the Rekenber Corporation.
How may I be of service today?
scripts.translation:
[代表]
您好，歡迎光臨雷根貝勒公司。
請問今天有什麼可以幫您的？

scripts.text: Building Information
scripts.translation: 大樓資訊

scripts.text: Corporation History
scripts.translation: 公司歷史

scripts.text:
[Representative]
Please tell me
which floor you'd like
to know more about.

scripts.translation: 1樓

scripts.text: 2F

The ^3131FFRekenber Library^000000 can
be found at the end of the
left hallway. Our library is
a great resource of innovative
ideas and information for our
system development employees.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
^3131FF雷根貝勒圖書館^000000位於左側走廊的盡頭。我們的圖書館為系統開發員工提供了豐富的創新理念與資訊。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
The ^3131FFBall Room^000000, where
various official events are
usually held, can be accessed
through the right hallway.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
^3131FF宴會廳^000000通常用於舉辦各種官方活動，可以通過右側走廊進入。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
Please use the stairs
located on both sides of
the Help Desk to go to the
Second Floor. The Second
Floor is mostly used for
administrative purposes.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
請使用服務檯兩側的樓梯前往二樓。二樓主要用於行政辦公。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
There, you can find
the ^3131FFConference Room^000000,
^3131FFSecretary's Office^000000, the
^3131FFAuditorium^000000 and the
^3131FFChairman's Office^000000.

[Representative]
The first underground floor
is used by ^3131FFRegenschirm^000000,
our laboratory affiliate. For
security reasons, this floor
is not accessible to visitors.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
地下一層由我們的實驗室附屬機構^3131FF雷根席爾姆^000000使用。
出於安全原因，訪客無法進入該層。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
We are always doing our
best to provide the best
services to our customers.
Remember that Rekenber
is the name you can trust.
Thank you and have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
我們始終致力於為顧客提供最優質的服務。
請記住，雷根貝勒是您值得信賴的名字。
謝謝，祝您有美好的一天。

learning the history of

speak to the representative

scripts.text: Corporation History
scripts.translation: 公司歷史

scripts.text: Rekenber's Businesses
scripts.translation: 雷根貝勒的業務

scripts.text:
[Representative]
Rekenber was established
400 years ago, around the
same time as the foundation
of the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
雷根貝勒成立於400年前，大約與秀髮茲發德共和國建國的時間相同。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
We began as the ''Zent Zerter
Lighthal Research Center,''
named after our first chairman.
In 560 A.W. (After War), our
organization was renamed after
our new chairman, Mr. Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
我們最初名為“森特·澤特萊特哈爾研究中心”，以我們的首任會長命名。
在戰後560年，隨著新任會長雷根貝勒先生的上任，組織也改名為雷根貝勒。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
Mr. Rekenber expanded the
Corporation's purposes, but
also founded the Regenschirm
Laboratory to continue this
company's original goal of
scientific research.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
雷根貝勒先生擴大了公司的業務範圍，同時也建立了雷根席爾姆實驗室，以延續公司最初科學研究的目標。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
In the year 700 A.W.,
^FF0000Doctor Varmunt^000000 joined
Regenschirm. It was his work
in science that enabled the
Rekenber Corporation to grow into the nation's biggest company.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
戰後700年，
^FF0000瓦爾蒙特博士^000000加入了雷根席爾姆。正是他的科學研究使雷根貝勒公司成長為全國最大的企業。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
In addition to merchandising,
freight transport and trading,
the Rekenber Corporation is
also heavily involved with
providing the Airship service,
one of our major projects.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
除了商品銷售、貨運和貿易之外，雷根貝勒公司還深度參與飛空艇服務，這是我們的主要專案之一。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
Rekenber is involved in
almost any business that
you can imagine. Remember
that Rekenber is the name
that you can trust.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
雷根貝勒涉足幾乎您能想到的所有行業。
請記住，雷根貝勒是您值得信賴的名字。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
If you'd like to know more
about our mission statement,
please refer to the Rekenber
Guidebook located to my side.
Thank you and have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
如果您想了解更多關於我們的使命宣言，請查閱我身旁的
《雷根貝勒指南》。
謝謝，祝您有美好的一天。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
Welcome to the
Rekenber Corporation.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[代表]
歡迎光臨雷根貝勒公司。
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: Building Information.
scripts.translation: 大樓資訊

scripts.text:
[Representative]
Please tell me
which floor you'd like
to know more about.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
請告訴我您想了解哪一層樓的情況。

scripts.text: 1F
scripts.translation: 1樓

scripts.text: 2F
scripts.translation: 2樓

scripts.text: B1
scripts.translation: 地下1樓

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Representative]
The ^3131FFRekenber Library^000000 can
be found at the end of the
left hallway. Our library is
a great resource of innovative
ideas and information for our
system development employees.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
^3131FF雷根貝勒圖書館^000000位於左側走廊的盡頭。我們的圖書館為系統開發員工提供了豐富的創新理念與資訊。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
The ^3131FFBall Room^000000, where
various official events are
usually held, can be accessed
through the right hallway.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
^3131FF宴會廳^000000通常用於舉辦各種官方活動，可以通過右側走廊進入。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
Please use the stairs
located on both sides of
the Help Desk to go to the
Second Floor. The Second
Floor is mostly used for
administrative purposes.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
請使用服務檯兩側的樓梯前往二樓。二樓主要用於行政辦公。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
There, you can find
the ^3131FFConference Room^000000,
^3131FFSecretary's Office^000000, the
^3131FFAuditorium^000000 and the
^3131FFChairman's Office^000000.

[Representative]
The first underground floor
is used by ^3131FFRegenschirm^000000,
our laboratory affiliate. For
security reasons, this floor
is not accessible to visitors.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
地下一層由我們的實驗室附屬機構^3131FF雷根席爾姆^000000使用。
出於安全原因，訪客無法進入該層。

scripts.text:
[Representative]
We are always doing our
best to provide the best
services to our customers.
Remember that Rekenber
is the name you can trust.
Thank you and have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[代表]
我們始終致力於為顧客提供最優質的服務。
請記住，雷根貝勒是您值得信賴的名字。
謝謝，祝您有美好的一天。

scripts.text:
^3131FF#The Vision^000000
In the pursuit of knowledge,
Rekenber will search the
Rune-Midgarts continent for
ancient relics. We hope to make
significant scientific progress by learning the secrets of the past.
scripts.translation:
^3131FF#願景^000000
在追求知識的道路上，雷根貝勒將在盧恩·米德加茲大陸搜尋古代遺蹟。我們希望通過了解過去的秘密，取得重大的科學進步。

scripts.text:
By making scientific
headway, we hope we can
improve current technologies
to provide more convenient
and affordable services in
the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation: 通過科學上的進步，我們希望改進現有技術，在秀髮茲發德共和國提供更便捷、更實惠的服務。

scripts.text:
^3131FF#The Commitment^000000
Although magic and the
power of the gods has always
maintained an aura of mystery
and superstition, Rekenber hopes^FFFFFF ^3131FF to understand these forces from
a more logical standpoint.
scripts.translation:
^3131FF#使命^000000
儘管魔法和神祇的力量一直籠罩著神秘與迷信的色彩，雷根貝勒仍希望^FFFFFF ^3131FF從更理性的角度理解這些力量。

scripts.text:
^FF0000Our goal is to make
the lives of our customers
easier and more enjoyable
by making the ancient power
of the gods more accessible
by means of new technologies.
scripts.translation: ^FF0000我們的目標是通過新技術使神的力量更易獲取，從而讓顧客的生活更輕鬆、更愉快。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
No one shall
interrupt my
research! If you
dare, I'll simply...
Eat you. Eat you alive.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
誰都不許打擾我的研究！
如果你敢的話，我就...
吃掉你。把你活活吃掉。

scripts.text: No... N-no!
scripts.translation: 不...不不！

scripts.text: Do you need any help?
scripts.translation: 需要幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Out of my sight,
microcephalic fool!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
滾出我的視線，小頭蠢貨！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Huh? You think I have
the luxury of remembering
the face of every part-timer
I've fired? Get lost, or I'll
treat you to the pain of
being eaten alive!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
哈？你以為我有閒心記住每一個被我解僱的臨時工的臉嗎？
滾遠點，不然我就讓你嚐嚐被活活吃掉的滋味！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
You again?!
What the hell do
you want from me?!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
又是你？！
你到底想從我這裡得到什麼？！

scripts.text: Let me speak with you.
scripts.translation: 讓我和你對話

scripts.text: Sorry for bothering you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉打擾你了

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
I don't have time to
waste with drivel! I'm
too busy with my research!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
我沒時間聽你胡扯！
我正忙著做研究呢！

[沃爾夫切夫]
...！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Ah, but wait! I am collecting
something. Yes, bring me the
thing I must collect. Yes, yes.
Here's a hint... It's round...
Shiny... Kids love playing games with them! Oh, I said too much!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
啊，等等！我正在收集一些東西。
沒錯，把我需要收集的東西帶給我。
是的，是的。
給你一個提示...它是圓的...
亮晶晶的...小孩們喜歡拿它們玩遊戲！
哎呀，我說太多了！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
''Sorry?!'' Do you
think ''sorry'' will
get back that precious
minute I've lost yelling
at you?! Get the hell out!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
“抱歉”？！
你以為一句“抱歉”就能彌補我對你大吼大叫浪費的那寶貴一分鐘嗎？！
給我滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Yes...! Beads!
You brought them!
You're not as dumb
as I thought you'd be!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
是的...！玻璃珠！
你帶來了！
你並沒有我想像的那麼蠢！

scripts.text: Why do you want Glass Beads?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼想要玻璃珠？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
..................
I take that back!
You should know by
now that I would never
tell you why I neeeeed
these Beads. Bweh-heh!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
...
我收回剛才的話！
你現在應該知道了，我絕不會告訴你我為什麼需要這些玻璃珠。
嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
This favor you've done
is worth a small chat and
I can spare a minute or two
for you inane questions. So
what is it you want to know?!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
你幫了這個忙，值得我跟你聊幾句。
我可以抽出幾分鐘回答你那些愚蠢的問題。
所以，你想知道什麼？！

scripts.text: Ask about hobbies
scripts.translation: 詢問愛好

scripts.text: Ask about work
scripts.translation: 詢問工作

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Hyuu~ I think you're
just a little too innocent
to know about my secret
hobby. Yes, yes, I couldn't
tell you possibly, it'd be
so weird, so strange...
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
呼呼~ 我覺得你太天真了，不可能知道我的秘密愛好。
是的，是的，我絕對不可能告訴你，那太奇怪了，太詭異了...

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Oh. Oh no, oh no,
I couldn't possibly...
It's a-- I-It's a secret.
You wouldn't want to know
anyway. Bweh-heh-heh-heh!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
哦。哦不，哦不，我絕對不可能...
這是一個-- 這是一個秘密。
反正你也不想知道。
嘿嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Oh, I don't know if you
can call it work. After all,
I do research whatever it is
I want. And they pay me to
do it! This is the best place
for a scientist like me, yes.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
哦，我不知道你能不能稱之為工作。
畢竟，我想研究什麼就研究什麼。
而且他們還付錢讓我做！
這對像我這樣的科學家來說是最好的地方，沒錯。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Now, in a perfect world,
my test subjects would be
much more cooperative, but
I suppose I cannot blame
them. Not that I cause them
undue suffering or anything...
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
現在，在一個完美的世界裡，我的實驗物件應該會更配合一些，但我想我不能責怪他們。
畢竟我沒有給他們造成過度的痛苦什麼的...

scripts.text: What kind of research?
scripts.translation: 什麼型別的研究？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Well, I couldn't tell you
exactly. But don't you
worry, the discovery I'm
working on will benefit the
entire world, you'll see.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
嗯，我不能確切地告訴你。
但別擔心，我正在進行的發現將會造福整個世界，你會看到的。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Let's just say that once
I'm successful, I'll satisfy
one of mankind's most primal
instincts, the desire to become
powerful and gain dominance
over those that are weaker.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
這麼說吧，一旦我成功了，我將滿足人類最原始的慾望之一，那就是變得強大，並支配那些弱者。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
I haven't made as much
progress as I'd like, but
no matter. It's only a matter
of experimentation! Yes, to
make mankind stronger and
better and more powerful and--
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
我的進展沒有我預期的那麼快，但這沒關係。這只是實驗的問題！沒錯，讓人類變得更強大、更優秀、更強大，而且——

scripts.text: Um, what are you testing on?
scripts.translation: 呃，你在拿什麼做實驗？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
What do you know?
I better get back to
work if I wish to keep
on schedule. I can't afford
the leisure of speaking with
you any longer. Bweh heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
你懂什麼？
如果我想保持進度，最好還是回去工作。我可沒那麼多閒工夫跟你聊天。嘿嘿!！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
I don't have time to
waste with drivel! I'm
too busy with my research!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
我沒時間聽你胡扯！
我正忙著做研究呢！

[沃爾夫切夫]
...！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Ah, but wait! I am collecting
something. Yes, bring me the
thing I must collect. Yes, yes.
Here's a hint... It's round...
Shiny... Kids love playing games with them! Oh, I said too much!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫切夫]
啊，等等！我正在收集一些東西。
沒錯，把我需要收集的東西帶給我。
是的，是的。
給你一個提示...它是圓的...
亮晶晶的...小孩們喜歡拿它們玩遊戲！
哎呀，我說太多了！

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Excuse me, but you are
not allowed to be in here.
If you have questions regarding
the Rekenber Corporation, I can
direct you to someone qualified
to give you an answer.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
抱歉，您不能進入這裡。
如果您有關於雷根貝勒公司的問題，我可以為您引薦一位有資格回答的人。

scripts.text: About the Slums
scripts.translation: 關於貧民窟

scripts.text: About Secretary Slierre
scripts.translation: 關於秘書蘇埃伊

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
The slums? All I know
is that this corporation
specifically targeted that
area in order to provide ample
opportunity for employment.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
貧民窟？我只知道這家公司特意針對那個地區，以提供充足的就業機會。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
I'm Sueii Slierre,
the personal secretary
for the chairman of the
Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
我是蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾，雷根貝勒公司會長的私人秘書。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Did you have something
else to ask? I can only
divulge information that is
public knowledge, but I can
tell you who to contact for
more specific inquiries.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
您還有其他問題嗎？我只能透露公開的資訊，但我可以告訴您該聯絡誰以獲取更具體的諮詢。

scripts.text: About the Laboratory
scripts.translation: 關於實驗室

scripts.text: About the Corporation
scripts.translation: 關於公司

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Rekenber is perhaps the
biggest contributer of the
Regenschirm Laboratory.
Their work will benefit the
entire Midgard continent, hence our highly involved support.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
雷根貝勒或許是雷根席爾姆實驗室最大的貢獻者。
他們的工作將造福整個米德加爾特大陸，因此我們給予了高度支援。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
A representative at the
Help Desk will be happy
to assist you if you have
more inquiries regarding
the Regenschirm Laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
如果您有關於雷根席爾姆實驗室的更多疑問，服務檯的代表很樂意為您提供幫助。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
I'm sorry, but I don't have
any special information
regarding our corporation.
Why don't you ask one of
our representatives at the
Help Desk to learn more?
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
抱歉，我沒有關於我們公司的特殊資訊。
您不妨去問問服務檯的代表，瞭解更多詳情？

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
You're back? I really
doubt that I can be of
any assistance to you.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
您回來了？我真的很懷疑我能為您提供任何幫助。

scripts.text: Wolfchev's Research
scripts.translation: 沃爾夫切夫的研究

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
.............!
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
...！

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
How do you know
Wolfchev? Are you an
acquaintance of his or...?
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
您怎麼認識沃爾夫切夫的？您是他的熟人，還是...

scripts.text: I'm a friend of his.
scripts.translation: 我是他的朋友

scripts.text: Oh, we're family, you know...
scripts.translation: 哦，我們是親戚，您知道的...

scripts.text: I've heard about him before, so...
scripts.translation: 我之前聽說過他，所以...

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Well, Wolfchev is not
only brilliant, he's also
a respected professional.
He should be doing just fine.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
嗯，沃爾夫切夫不僅才華橫溢，而且是一位受人尊敬的專家。
他應該過得很好。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Ah, you should be
very proud of Wolfchev.
In addition to being a
genius, Wolfchev is also
quite the professional,
truly a model scientist.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
啊，您應該為沃爾夫切夫感到驕傲。
除了是個天才，沃爾夫切夫還非常專業，真是一位模範科學家。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Ah yes, Wolfchev has
quite the reputation. In
fact, he's in such high
demand that Regenschirm
wants him on their staff.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
啊對了，沃爾夫切夫的名聲很大。
事實上，他非常搶手，雷根席爾姆都想請他加入他們的團隊。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Now if you'll excuse me,
I have many task to perform,
so please visit our Help Desk
if you have further inquiries.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
如果您不介意的話，我還有很多工要處理，如果您還有疑問，請去我們的服務檯諮詢。

scripts.text: W-Wait!
scripts.translation: 等等！

scripts.text: Alright, I understand.
scripts.translation: 好的，我明白了

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
...
......
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
...
...

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Thank you for your
cooperation. As you well
know, the Help Desk is there
to answer any of your questions regarding the Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
感謝您的配合。如您所知，服務檯負責回答您關於雷根貝勒公司的任何問題。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
I'm sorry, but please
understand that my office
isn't the place for visitors to
submit their general inquiries.
Please visit the Help Desk if
you have any more questions.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
很抱歉，請理解我的辦公室不是訪客提出一般性諮詢的地方。
如果您還有任何問題，請去服務檯諮詢。

scripts.text: About Wolfchev's Research
scripts.translation: 關於沃爾夫切夫的研究

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
I couldn't tell you any
more about Wolfchev.
But is there anything you
need to tell me about him?
Well, if you have something
to ask, be quick about it.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
我無法告訴您更多關於沃爾夫切夫的事。
不過，您有什麼關於他的事要告訴我嗎？
嗯，如果您有想問的，請快一點。

scripts.text: Wolfchev's Past
scripts.translation: 沃爾夫切夫的過去

scripts.text: Wolfchev's Test Subjects
scripts.translation: 沃爾夫切夫的實驗物件

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
I remember hearing that he
received a high recommendation
to work here, but specifics elude me since I don't work in Human
Resources. There's a rumor that
he had a troubled love life...
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
我記得聽說他得到了很高的推薦才來到這裡，但具體細節我不清楚，因為我不在人力資源部工作。
有個傳聞說他感情生活很坎坷...

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
But aside from a few
rumors, we really don't
know much about Wolfchev's
personal life. But then again,
it may be unethical to pry too
much into our employee's lives.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
但除了幾個傳聞，我們真的不太瞭解沃爾夫切夫的私生活。
不過話說回來，過多打探員工的私生活可能是不道德的。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Wolfchev's test subjects?
Well, I know we have a policy
of using the most humane
methods depending on the
experiment. And of course, he should only be testing on animals.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
沃爾夫切夫的實驗物件？
嗯，我知道我們有政策，根據實驗情況使用最人道的方法。
當然，他應該只會在動物身上做實驗。

scripts.text: Wolfchev's research is great!
scripts.translation: 沃爾夫切夫的研究很棒！

scripts.text: His experiments are suspicious...
scripts.translation: 他的實驗很可疑...

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Yes, yes, I'd agree if
I understood science a
little bit better. Now, you'll
have to excuse me. I've been distracted long enough as it is...
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

merits an investigation.

scripts.translation:

目前，您的指控值得進行調查。
如果我們發現任何重要線索，我會通知您...

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Evidence...?
I'm sorry, but you don't

that can be construed as proof.
I suggest you bring something that actually supports your claim.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
證據...？
很抱歉，您似乎沒有攜帶任何可以作為證明的東西。
建議您攜帶一些真正支援您指控的物品。

scripts.text:

If you're finished,
I'd like to get back on

scripts.translation:

如果您說完了，我想繼續工作。
