scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
嗯。我無法將您這次帶來的東西視為能消除我疑慮的證據。
現在，請原諒我，我需要繼續工作了。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Oh, I'd like to have
a word with you. Would
you please come back after
reducing the weight of the
items you are carrying please?
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
哦，我想和您說幾句話。
請您在減輕攜帶物品的重量後再回來好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Oh good, you're here.
You were right all along.
In our investigation, we found
that Wolfchev was conducting
unauthorized and very dangerous
research. I owe you our thanks.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
哦，太好了，您來了。
您之前的判斷完全正確。我們的調查發現，沃爾夫切夫正在進行未經授權且極其危險的研究。我們應該感謝您。

scripts.text: What was he doing...?
scripts.translation: 他在做什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
It turns out that Wolfchev
was kidnapping weak and sick
people from the slums and
using them as his guinea pigs.
Rest assured, he'll be punished
for his behavior, if not fired.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
原來沃爾夫切夫一直在從貧民窟綁架體弱多病的人，把他們當作實驗品。
請放心，我們會對他的行為進行處罰，甚至可能將他解僱。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
I think you deserve an
apology. Without your
report, our corporation's
reputation could have been
potentially damaged. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
我覺得我們應該向您道歉。若非您舉報此事，公司的聲譽可能會受損。謝謝您。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Yes, there's nothing so
taboo as trying to perform
Homunculus experiments
on people! Anyway, please
accept this as a token of
our gratitude, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
是的，沒有什麼比試圖在人身上進行生命體實驗更禁忌的了！
無論如何，請收下這份禮物，作為我們的一點心意，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Let me promise you
that Rekenber will ensure
that this kind of incident
will not be repeated and
we'll do everything in our
power to compensate for this...
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
我向您保證，雷根貝勒將確保此類事件不再發生，我們將竭盡全力進行補償...

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Oh, our investigation
of your claim is still in
progress. However, we
will let you know when any
new developments arise.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
哦，我們對您指控的調查仍在進行中。不過，一旦有新進展，我們會通知您。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
I'm glad to know that
we have such proactive
and concerned customers
such as yourself to support
the Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
很高興知道我們有像您這樣積極主動且關心公司的顧客，支援雷根貝勒公司。

scripts.text:
[Sueii Slierre]
Excuse me, but you are
not allowed to be in here.
Please visit the Help Desk
if you have any questions about
the Rekenber Corporation.
Thank you for cooperating.
scripts.translation:
[蘇埃伊·斯利埃爾]
抱歉，您不允許進入這裡。
如果您有關於雷根貝勒公司的問題，請前往服務檯諮詢。
感謝您的配合。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Hello there~
Isn't Lighthalzen such
a wonder to behold with
all of its splendor and
magnificent beauty?
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
你好呀~
裡希塔樂鎮是不是充滿了輝煌與壯麗，美得令人驚歎？

scripts.text: I guess.
scripts.translation: 我想是吧

scripts.text: Yes, it is.
scripts.translation: 是的，確實如此

scripts.text: Well, I don't know.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我不知道

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Oh, and the weather is
so nice today, perfect
for a stroll in the park
or a lovely picnic. Ah~
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
哦，今天的天氣真好，適合在公園散步，或者來一次愉快的野餐。啊~

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Oh, I'm so glad you
agree. The people who
live here are so kind and
so happy, you can literally
feel everyone's gentle warmth.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
哦，很高興你同意。
這裡的人都很善良、快樂，彷彿能真切感受到每個人的溫暖。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Well, maybe if you
don't see it right this
moment, I'm sure you'll
discover something to
love about this city soon.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
嗯，也許你現在還沒看到，但我相信你很快會發現這座城市的可愛之處。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Ha ha ha!
Anyway, I hope you
have a good day today~
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
Ha ha ha!！
總之，祝你今天過得愉快~

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Yes, Lighthalzen
couldn't be perfecter.
Ahahahaha... But still...
Hm. Um. Oh, never mind.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
是的，裡希塔樂鎮完美無缺。
啊哈哈...不過...
嗯。呃。哦，算了。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Ha ha ha!
Anyway, I hope you
have a good day today~
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
Ha ha ha!！
總之，祝你今天過得愉快~

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Hm? It's a little
cloudy today, isn't it?
It would be nice to stay
inside, listening to some
nice music while enjoying
a hot cup of tea, wouldn't it?
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
嗯？今天有點陰天，不是嗎？
要是能待在屋裡，聽著美妙的音樂，再喝上一杯熱茶，那該多好啊。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Ahhh!
Such pleasant weather~
I'm so glad I'm outside
and enjoying the sunlight.
Feel it. It's so warm and
nice on your face, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
啊哈！
天氣真好~
我很高興能待在戶外享受陽光。
感受一下，陽光照在臉上是不是很溫暖舒適？

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
The sun is gently
shining, the breeze is
gently blowing. Oh, this
weather could not be better!
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
陽光溫柔地照耀著，微風輕柔地吹拂著。哦，這天氣簡直完美！

scripts.text: Yes, you're right.
scripts.translation: 是的，你說得對

scripts.text: Uh, what were you doing just now?
scripts.translation: 呃，你剛才在做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Yes, right now is the
best time to be outside
and to enjoy all of this
fresh, wonderful air. Come,
take a deep breath with me.
Ooooh. Ahhhhhh~ Excellent!
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
是的，現在正是走出戶外，享受這清新美好空氣的最佳時機。來，跟我一起深呼吸。
噢噢噢。啊哈~ 太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
...
......
I don't quite follow what
you're saying. I was merely
enjoying the sunny perfection
of Lighthalzen as usual...
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
...
...
我不太明白你在說什麼。我只是像往常一樣，在享受裡希塔樂鎮完美的陽光而已...

scripts.text: But I heard you talking about something...
scripts.translation: 但我聽到你在談論什麼...

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
No! You must
have mistaken me
for somebody else!
Now, if you'll excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
不！你一定是把我當成別人了！
好了，請原諒我失陪...

scripts.text:
^3355FFEven if it wasn't
Ghalstein that you
just heard, he reacted
pretty strongly to what
you said to him. Almost
as if he had something to hide... ^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF即使剛才聽到的不是加爾斯坦，他對你的話反應也很強烈。
簡直像是有什麼事在隱瞞... ^000000

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Hm? Judging from the
look on your face, you
apparently still believe
that I was involved in some
kind of clandestine meeting.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
嗯？看你的表情，你顯然還認為我參與了某種秘密集會。

scripts.text: Yes, I'm sure of it!
scripts.translation: 是的，我確信！

scripts.text: Well...

[{0}]
Yes, I'm sure of it!
That was definitely you!
Your voice, your way of
speaking is unmistakable!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我確信！
那絕對是你！
你的聲音，你的說話方式，我都認得出來！

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Alright. Yes, it's
true that I did meet
someone in secret. But
what gives you the right
to interrogate me in this
rather aggressive fashion?
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
好吧。是的，我確實秘密見過某人。
但你有什麼權利用這種咄咄逼人的方式審問我？

scripts.text: I'm not interrogating...
scripts.translation: 我沒有在審問...

scripts.text: Sorry about that.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，是我失言了

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm not interrogating
you. No, not at all.
It's, um, it's just...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒有在審問你。
不，完全不是。
只是，呃，只是...

scripts.text: Who are you dealing with?
scripts.translation: 你在和誰打交道？

scripts.text: I was just curious.
scripts.translation: 我只是好奇

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who are you dealing
with? I heard something
about some organization
that's supposedly very
powerful and I'm starting
to get really concerned.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在和誰打交道？我聽說有一個組織，據說非常強大，我開始真的很擔心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think I can
ignore hearing about
any kind of dangerous
corporation, even if
I wanted to. Turning my
back to this seems wrong...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我覺得我無法忽視任何關於危險公司的傳聞，即使我想這麼做。對這件事視而不見似乎是不對的...

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Hm...
You really
feel that way?
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
嗯...
你真的這麼認為嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Please give me
a moment. I need
some time to think
about how I can best
handle this situation.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
請給我一點時間。我需要時間思考如何最好地處理這種情況。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Just curious...?
Well, I hope that
you don't interfere
too much with other
people's lives just
out of curiosity.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
只是好奇...？
好吧，我希望你不要僅僅出於好奇就過多幹涉別人的生活。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
You really shouldn't
make something your
business if you're not
interested or willing
to commit. Now, if you
would excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
如果你不感興趣或不願意投入，真的不應該把別人的事當成自己的事。現在，請原諒我失陪了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sorry about that.
I didn't mean to
stick my nose into
your personal business.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉。我不是故意要插手你的私事。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Well, that's quite
alright. I accept
your apology, but
I must warn you
not to pry into my
personal affairs.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
沒關係。我接受你的道歉，但我必須警告你，不要打探我的私事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well...
Now I don't know.
I suppose I could
be wrong, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...
現在我不確定了。我想我可能是錯的。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
.......
Yes, I wouldn't
recommend running
around, indiscriminately
accusing random people
of doing strange things.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
...
是的，我不建議你到處亂跑，毫無根據地指控別人做了奇怪的事。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
I've come into a
decision and found
a way that I can let
you into my confidence
without putting the efforts
of my organization at risk.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
我已經做出了決定，並找到了一種方法，可以在不危及我們組織努力的情況下讓你瞭解我的情況。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
As you may have already
guessed, I'm a member of an
organization whose ultimate
goal is to put an end to the
Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
你可能已經猜到了，我是一個組織的成員，該組織的最終目標是終結雷根貝勒公司。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
However, before I relate
more information regarding
my organization and its work, I shall require your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
不過，在我透露更多關於我的組織及其工作的資訊之前，我需要你的合作。

scripts.text: How can I cooperate?
scripts.translation: 我該如何合作？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How can I cooperate?
Um, what exactly is it
that you want me to do?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我該如何合作？
呃，你具體想讓我做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
You do seem interested
in knowing more about us,
and we can also use your
expertise as an adventurer.
But first you must decide if
you will commit to cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
你似乎確實想了解我們更多，我們也可以利用你作為冒險者的專業知識。但首先，你必須決定是否願意合作。

scripts.text: I still don't get it...
scripts.translation: 我還是不明白...

scripts.text: Sure, I'll cooperate.
scripts.translation: 好的，我會合作

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Alright, let me make this 
clearer for you. You have
two choices.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
好吧，讓我給你解釋得更清楚一些。你有兩個選擇。

scripts.text: Two choices?
scripts.translation: 兩個選擇？

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
 If you choose
to cooperate with us, you'll
need to periodically drink
this red magic tonic.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
如果你選擇與我們合作，你需要定期飲用這種紅色魔法藥劑。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
The red tonic will allow
us to monitor your every
move so that we know you
won't betray us. You'll have to
continue cooperating or else
we won't give you the cure.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
紅色藥劑能讓我們監控你的一舉一動，確保你不會背叛我們。你必須繼續合作，否則我們就不給你解藥。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Throughout our mission,
you'll need to take a red
tonic every so often to avoid
suffering fron unpleasant
consequences. When we
finish, you get the antidote.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
在整個任務期間，你需要時不時地服用紅色藥劑，以避免遭受不良後果。
當我們完成任務後，你會得到解藥。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
If you choose not to
cooperate, simply drink
this blue tonic, which will
erase every fragment of your
memory regarding our meeting.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
如果你選擇不合作，只需飲用這種藍色藥劑，它會抹去你關於這次會面的一切記憶。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
So, what have
you decided to do?
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
那麼，你決定怎麼做？

scripts.text: Don't cooperate
scripts.translation: 不合作

scripts.text: Cooperate
scripts.translation: 合作

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Ah, good choice.
So will you take
this red tonic?
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
啊，不錯的選擇。
那麼，你要喝下這瓶紅色藥劑嗎？

scripts.text: Do not take it.
scripts.translation: 不喝

scripts.text: Take it.
scripts.translation: 喝

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Very good.
Then please,
drink this right away.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
非常好。
那麼請，立刻喝下去。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou drink the red tonic.
It doesn't feel any different
from a Red Potion, but it
would be wise to cooperate
with Ghalstein until this
mission is accomplished.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你喝下了紅色藥劑。
感覺和紅色藥水沒什麼不同，但在任務完成之前，最好還是與加爾斯坦合作。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
You may feel a little
disoriented after drinking
this tonic for the first time.
I'll give you a moment to
steady yourself before we
talk about our mission.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
第一次喝這種藥劑後，你可能會感到有些頭暈。
我會給你一點時間緩一緩，然後再談論我們的任務。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Ah, good choice.
So will you take
this red tonic?
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
啊，不錯的選擇。
那麼，你要喝下這瓶紅色藥劑嗎？

scripts.text: Do not take it.
scripts.translation: 不喝

scripts.text: Take it.
scripts.translation: 喝

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Very good.
Then please,
drink this right away.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
非常好。
那麼請，立刻喝下去。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou drink the red tonic.
It doesn't feel any different
from a Red Potion, but it
would be wise to cooperate

mission is accomplished.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你喝下了紅色藥劑。
感覺和紅色藥水沒什麼不同，但在任務完成之前，最好還是與加爾斯坦合作。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
You may feel a little
disoriented after drinking
this tonic for the first time.
I'll give you a moment to
steady yourself before we
talk about our mission.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
第一次喝這種藥劑後，你可能會感到有些頭暈。
我會給你一點時間緩一緩，然後再談論我們的任務。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
You really feel
that way? Well, that's
a shame. Pity, really...
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
你真的是這麼想的嗎？
唉，真可惜。
真是遺憾...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou suddenly get the
weird feeling that someone
has been behind you this
entire time. As you slowly
turn around to look, you
were knocked unconscious...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你突然覺得好像一直有人跟在身後。你慢慢轉過身想看個究竟，卻被人打暈了...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou're forced to swallow
some strange pill which
immediately makes all your
thoughts hazier until it begins
to feel like your entire mind
is getting bleached somehow.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你被迫吞下了一顆奇怪的藥丸，它立刻讓你的思維變得模糊，直到感覺你的整個大腦正在被某種方式漂白。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
So how are you feeling?
Any nausea that you may
be experiencing should
be going away very soon.
Anyway, let's get started.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
你現在感覺如何？
你可能感到的噁心很快就會消失。
總之，讓我們開始吧。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Rekenber Corporation
is closely affiliated with
Regenschirm, an underground
laboratory inhabited by strange
and suspicious creatures.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
雷根貝勒公司與雷根席爾姆實驗室關係密切。雷根席爾姆是一座地下實驗室，裡面住著各種奇怪而可疑的生物。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Your mission will be to
infiltrate this underground lab
and bring back evidence which
proves the existence of these
creatures. You must gather
various kinds of proof.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
你的任務是滲透進這個地下實驗室，並帶回證明這些生物存在的證據。你必須收集各種型別的證據。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
But more importantly,
there is ^FF0000something there
that you have to bring
back to me^000000. I can't tell
you exactly what it is,
but trust me. You'll know.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
但更重要的是，那裡有^FF0000一樣東西，你必須帶回來給我^000000。
我無法確切告訴你它是什麼，但相信我。
你會知道的。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
If you search the
Laboratory enough,
you'll find what I'm
talking about. In any
case, you'll need to find
a way to get inside the lab.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
如果你在實驗室裡搜尋得足夠仔細，你就會找到我所說的東西。
無論如何，你需要找到進入實驗室的方法。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
It might be helpful to
know that we've received
reports about disappearances
of people from the ^FF0000eastside
slums^000000. We believe they are
perhaps traveling illegally...
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
知道這一點可能會有幫助：
我們收到了關於
^FF0000東區貧民窟^000000
有人失蹤的報告。
我們認為他們可能正在非法旅行...

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
If someone there is
transporting people
without authorization,
maybe you can find a
contact who can sneak
you inside the Laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
如果那裡有人未經授權運送人員，也許你可以找到一個聯絡人，讓他把你偷偷帶進實驗室。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
For now, it may be best
to start investigating the
eastside slums to see if you
can find somebody who can
get you inside the Laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
目前，最好先開始調查東區貧民窟，看看能否找到能把你帶進實驗室的人。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
An error occurred.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
發生了一個錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Ah, this looks like a
sufficient amount of
evidence for us to be
able to effectively attack
our enemy. I believe you're
ready for the next mission.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
啊，這看起來像是足夠的證據，讓我們能夠有效地攻擊我們的敵人。我相信你已經準備好接受下一個任務了。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
But first, I believe it's
time for another red tonic
dose so that we can keep
monitoring you. Oh, and
don't worry, it's not addictive
or anything strange like that.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
不過，首先我覺得該再給你一劑紅色藥劑，好讓我們繼續監控你。哦，別擔心，它不會讓人上癮，也沒有什麼奇怪的副作用。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Now, find ^FF0000Gusharr^000000, one of
our members, ^FF0000near Juno^000000.
He will tell you about your
next mission. Show this to
him to prove that you are
working with us. Don't forget.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
現在，去找^FF0000古沙爾^000000，他是我們的成員之一，在^FF0000朱諾附近^000000。
他會告訴你下一個任務。
向他出示這個以證明你在為我們工作。別忘了。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
When you get inside the
Laboratory, make sure that
you search around for any
records and get any sort of
concrete evidence we can
use. I'll be counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
當你進入實驗室後，務必四處搜尋任何記錄，並獲取任何我們可以使用的具體證據。
我會指望你的。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
We'll need more evidence
than this from the Laboratory
to make any impact against our
enemy. I know what we need is
difficult to find, but I'm sure
that you can pull this off.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
我們需要從實驗室獲得更多證據，才能對我們的敵人造成任何影響。我知道我們需要找的東西很難找，但我相信你能做到。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Please find Gushaar
in the vicinity of Juno.
He will give you all the
details for your next mission.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
請在朱諾附近找到古沙爾。
他會給你所有關於下一個任務的細節。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
You've made the decision
to help us in order to learn
more about our organzation.
We appreciate all the help we
can get, but I hope you don't
regret getting in this deep.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
你決定幫助我們，以便更多地瞭解我們的組織。我們感激任何幫助，但我希望你不會後悔捲入這麼深。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
There's a certain price
for knowledge. I believe
you're capable of paying it,
but whether or not this ordeal
will be worthwhile to you is
difficult to determine.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
知識是有代價的。
我相信你有能力支付它，但這場磨難對你來說是否值得，很難確定。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
You're so close to
accomplishing your
mission. If all goes as
planned, we can do some
real damage to our enemy.
And you'll finally be free.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
你離完成任務很近了。如果一切按計劃進行，我們可以對我們的敵人造成真正的傷害。
而你最終將獲得自由。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
I can't believe what
happened. I just heard
that the president was
betrayed! This is horrible!
We'll have to start all over.
Was it all for nothing?!
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
我無法相信竟然發生了這種事。我剛聽說總裁遭人背叛了！太可怕了！
我們得從頭再來嗎？這一切難道都白費了？！

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
No. No, Jargeah would be
so disappointed in me if
I just gave up. I'll have to
follow our dream, no matter
what the obstacles are.
Jargeah, give me strength!
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
不，不行。如果我就這樣放棄，雅格亞一定會對我很失望。無論遇到什麼阻礙，我都要追隨我們的理想。雅格亞，請賜我力量！

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
Also, you've done a great
service for us. Although we
failed, you carried out your
missions perfectly. Here,
take this antidote so that
you'll finally be free of us.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
此外，你為我們做了很大的貢獻。雖然我們失敗了，但你完美地執行了你的任務。這裡，拿著這個解毒劑，這樣你最終就能擺脫我們了。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
I'd like you to take
this small gift, as way
of apology. We asked you
to do so much, but ultimately,
we weren't able to accomplish
what we set out to do. Still...
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
請收下這份小禮物，作為我們的歉意。
我們讓你做了很多事，但最終沒能達成目標。
不過...

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
I'd like to thank you
for everything. Hopefully,
you found the answers
that you were looking for
when you decided to help
us. Farewell, faithful friend.
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
非常感謝你的一切。
希望你在決定幫助我們時，找到了你尋找的答案。
再見了，忠誠的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
I hate being patient,
but the old adage is
true. He who runs away,
lives to fight another day.
But that day seems so
far off into the future...
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
我討厭等待，但老話是對的。
留得青山在，不怕沒柴燒。
但那一天似乎還很遙遠...

scripts.text:
[??????]
^333333Hurry up, before
the others see you...^000000

[{0}]
(Wait a second...
That voice is
awfully familiar.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(等一下...
這個聲音好熟悉。)

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 無視它

scripts.text: Keep listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續聽

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(That voice is
awfully familiar...
But what do I care?)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(這個聲音好熟悉...
但關我什麼事？)

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(This is too weird.
I guess I better keep
listening to see what
I can learn about this...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(這也太奇怪了。
我還是繼續聽聽看，也許能瞭解到些什麼...)

scripts.text:
[??????]
^333333So why did you tell
me to come to such
a dangerous place...?^000000

^3355FFThat's...^000000
That's ^660000Ghalstein's^3355FF voice!^000000

[????]
^666666Something unexpected
came up. Hence the sudden
change in plans. Now listen...^000000

^3355FFSuddenly, both of the
voices grew much quieter
as the two men spoke to each
other in low, hoarse whispers
that are almost inaudible.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF突然，兩個聲音都低了下來。他們壓低嗓音，用沙啞的耳語交談，幾乎聽不見。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ghalstein]
^333333Oh. That does
sound very urgent.
But it's not safe to
talk about this here.
Let's move somewhere
a little more secure.^000000
scripts.translation:
[加爾斯坦]
^333333哦。聽起來很緊急。
但在這裡談論這些並不安全。
我們去個更安全的地方吧。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThat other voice...
Whoever it belonged
to is gone! What's
going on here?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF另一個聲音...
它的主人不見了！
這裡發生了什麼？^000000

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Decisions, decisions.
Sometimes it's hard to
make a choice when it
isn't clear which one will
give you the most benefit.
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
選擇，選擇。
有時候很難做出選擇，因為不清楚哪一個能給你帶來最大的好處。

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
I think most of the good
things in life have some
kind of cost, but they're
usually worth it. I mean,
nothing would have any
worth without any cost, right?
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
我認為生活中大多數美好的事物都有某種代價，但通常都是值得的。
我的意思是，如果沒有代價，任何東西都不會有價值，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Alright. Choose
your poison. I got
two different kinds of
tonics for you, red and blue.
So which one will you drink?
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
好的。選擇你的毒藥。
我有兩種不同的藥劑，紅色和藍色。
那麼，你要喝哪一種？

scripts.text: Red Tonic
scripts.translation: 紅色藥劑

scripts.text: Blue Tonic
scripts.translation: 藍色藥劑

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Well, when you don't
make a decision, you
don't take action. And
when you don't take any
action, nothing happens.
Come on, don't be boring~
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
嗯，當你不做決定時，你就不會採取行動。
而當你不採取行動時，什麼也不會發生。
來吧，別這麼無趣~

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Red, huh? I like
your style. But, eh,
isn't there something
you want to show me first?
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
紅色，是嗎？
我喜歡你的風格。但是，呃，在你喝之前，是不是有什麼東西要先給我看？

scripts.text: Oh, right!
scripts.translation: 哦，對了！

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Hey... Umm...
Aren't you supposed
to be carrying some
sort of secret something?
I'd tell you want it was if we
weren't so, well, secretive.
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
嘿... 呃...
你不應該隨身攜帶某種秘密的東西嗎？
如果我們不那麼...
那麼保密的話，我本來可以告訴你的。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou suavely flash
your Membership Card
to Gushaar, who gives
you an approving nod.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你優雅地向古沙爾出示了你的會員卡，他滿意地點了點頭。^000000

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Yeah, that's what
I wanted to see. Good,
you're the one I've been
waiting here for. Alright,
just give me a second...
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
是的，這就是我想看的。
很好，你就是我在這裡等待的人。好的，請稍等片刻...

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Huh?! Oh geez, I almost
never make this mistake.
I'm sorry, I thought you might
have been someone else.
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
什麼？！哎呀，我幾乎從不犯這種錯誤。
對不起，我原以為你可能是別人。

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Blue...? Huh.
That shouldn't be
the one you want.
Well, if you're who
I think you are... Are you?
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
藍色...？嗯。
那不應該是你想要的。
好吧，如果你就是我認為的那個人... 是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Alright, first of all,
you should know why the
Rekenber Corporation is
our sworn enemy. Did you
know that it basically controls
the Schwarzwald Republic?
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
好的，首先，你應該知道為什麼雷根貝勒公司是我們的死敵。你知道嗎，它基本上控制了秀髮茲發德共和國？

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
They're so powerful, they
manipulate everything in the
economy, media and even the
politics of this nation. There are other corporations, sure, but
they're nothing in comparsion.
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
他們如此強大，操縱著這個國家的經濟、媒體，甚至政治。其他公司當然也有，但與雷根貝勒相比都微不足道。

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Rekenber Corporation...
They've even got a hold on
all the other companies, simply
by bribing politicians to pass
the bills they want passed.
This isn't a real republic...
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
雷根貝勒公司...
它們甚至控制了所有其他公司，僅僅是通過賄賂政客讓他們通過想要的法案。
這不是一個真正的共和國...

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
The ultimate goal of our
group, ''Secret Wing,'' is to
establish true independence
in the Schwarzwald Republic
by destroying Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
我們組織“秘密之翼”的最終目標，是通過摧毀雷根貝勒公司，讓秀髮茲發德共和國真正獨立。

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Fortunately, the new president
of the Schwarzwald Republic,
Mr. Weierstrass, is sympathetic
to our cause. He is working with us to bring about a revolution and
overthrow Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
幸運的是，秀髮茲發德共和國的新任總裁魏爾斯特拉斯先生支援我們的事業。他正與我們合作，推動革命並推翻雷根貝勒公司。

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Your mission will be to
visit with the president and
bring back any information
he may have for us. Remember,
because of his position, you can only see him during certain hours.
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
你的任務將是拜訪總裁，並帶回他可能有的任何資訊。記住，由於他的職位，你只能在特定時間見他。

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
I hope you understand
''Secret Wing's'' ultimate
goal now. In any case, you've
got to meet our president,
Karl Theodor Weierstrass.
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
我希望你現在理解“秘密之翼”的最終目標了。無論如何，你必須見我們的總裁，卡爾·特奧多爾·魏爾斯特拉斯。

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
It won't be easy to see
such an important man,
so show your Secret Wing
Membership Card to his
secretary and there should
be very little hassle.
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
見到這樣重要的人物並不容易，所以向他的秘書出示你的秘密之翼會員卡，應該就不會有太多麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Because of his schedule,
you'll only be allowed to see
him from ^FF00008:00 PM to 11:00 PM^000000,
and from ^FF000011:00 AM to 2:00PM PST^000000.Good luck on this mission, friend.
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
由於他的日程安排，你只能在^FF0000晚上8點至11點^000000，以及^FF0000上午11點至下午2點（太平洋標準時間）^000000與他會面。祝你順利，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Gushaar]
Rekenber...
I shall see your
destruction if it's the
very last thing I do!
scripts.translation:
[古沙爾]
雷根貝勒...
哪怕這是我最後的任務，我也要見證它的毀滅！

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Good day, how
may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奧尼爾]
您好，請問有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: Oh. I'm fine, thanks.
scripts.translation: 哦，我很好，謝謝

scripts.text: I want to meet the president~
scripts.translation: 我想見見總裁~

scripts.text: W-who are you...?

[Hes O'Neil]
Since this is an
important government
building, please keep
in mind that certain areas,
monitored by guards, are
off limits to visitors.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奧尼爾]
這裡是重要的政府建築，請注意，某些由衛兵監控的區域禁止訪客進入。

scripts.text:

President Weierstrass?
Do you have an appointment
to meet with him today?
scripts.translation:

魏爾斯特拉斯總裁？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

Alright, let me see.
May I please have your
name so that I can look
it up in today's schedule?
scripts.translation:

好的，讓我看看。
請告訴我您的名字，以便我在今天的日程中查詢。

scripts.text:

{0}?
I'm sorry, but I can't find
your name on the list. You
can only visit the president
if you have an appointment.
Thank you for your cooperation.

{0}？
很抱歉，我在名單上找不到您的名字。只有預約後才能拜訪總裁。

I'm so sorry, but because

scripts.translation:

非常抱歉，由於總裁非常忙碌，他只能抽出時間見有預約的人。

Schwarzwald Republic,

嗯...？

scripts.text: Nothing.

scripts.translation:

哦...我明白了。
總裁一直在等您。
請，這邊請。

scripts.text:

Oh... I see.
I'm sorry, but you've

scripts.translation:

哦...我明白了。
很抱歉，您來得比預約時間早了。
您稍後再來見總裁好嗎？

這裡是重要的政府建築，請注意，某些由衛兵監控的區域禁止訪客進入。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Hm? I thought the
president was supposed
to give you some kind of
file, but perhaps I was
mistaken? Let me think...
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奧尼爾]
嗯？我以為總裁應該要給您一些檔案，但我可能記錯了？讓我想想...

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Hello, may I be
of any assistance?
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奧尼爾]
您好，請問有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: I brought this.
scripts.translation: 我帶來了這個

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Ah, the file folder
I needed. I'm so sorry
to trouble you. Thank
you so much for your help.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奧尼爾]
啊，正是我需要的資料夾。
真是麻煩您了，非常感謝您的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
I'm sorry, but the
president is currently
outside on business.
Please come back to
visit him another time.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奧尼爾]
很抱歉，總裁目前正在外出公幹。
請您改日再來拜訪他。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Oh, the president
is expecting you.
Please, go right
on ahead, sir.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奧尼爾]
哦，總裁正在等您。
請進吧，先生。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Oh, the president
is expecting you.
Please, go right
on ahead, ma'am.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奧尼爾]
哦，總裁正在等您。
請進吧，女士。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
The President has given the order that 
nobody is allowed to enter this place.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奧尼爾]
總裁下令，任何人都不得進入這裡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, you will change your mind after listening to my explanation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不過，聽完我的解釋後，您會改變主意的。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
...............
Is it something very important?
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奧尼爾]
...
這是非常重要的事情嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is the most important thing.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是最重要的事情。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Alright then, there you go.
(Whisper) I hope you will become his source of strength.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奧尼爾]
好吧，請進吧。
（低聲）希望您能成為他的力量源泉。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
The president said that you're welcome to visit him anytime.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奧尼爾]
總裁說，您隨時都可以來拜訪他。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
I'm sorry...
It seems that the
president would like
to have some privacy now.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奧尼爾]
很抱歉...
看來總裁現在需要一些私人空間。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You are in the

without authorization in
this government building.
Thank you for your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
您已進入總裁官邸。
未經授權的武器在此政府建築內是被禁止的。
感謝您的配合。

scripts.text:

啊，克什納爾先生。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Mr. Keshnaar,
I present {0}.
{1}, allow me

克什納爾先生，向您介紹{0}。
{1}，請允許我介紹埃裡丹·克什納爾。

scripts.text:

A pleasure to meet you.
Now, if you would excuse
me, I have some business
to attend to. Good day~
scripts.translation:

很高興見到您。
那麼，失陪了，我還有些公務要處理。再見~

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Take care,
Mr. Keshnaar.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
請保重，克什納爾先生。

scripts.text:

Please wait a moment.

scripts.translation:

感謝您的耐心等待。

scripts.text:

Now you may enter
and speak with the

scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
現在您可以進入與總裁對話了。
感謝您一直以來的等待。

scripts.text: Thank you.
scripts.translation: 謝謝

scripts.text: Who was that gentleman...?
scripts.translation: 那位紳士是誰...？

A Mister {0}

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Karl]
How did you get in here?
Please leave this place
immediately! Security...!
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你是怎麼進來的？

保安...！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ah, welcome~
I understand that you
must have had a lot of
trouble coming here.
It's a pleasure to
finally meet you.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
啊，歡迎~
我想你一定經歷了很多麻煩才來到這裡。
很高興終於見到你。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
As I'm sure Ghalstein
has told you, ''Secret Wing''
was formed to overthrow the
evil Rekenber Corporation.
Now, I'm sure that you must
have some questions for me...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
正如加爾斯坦告訴你的那樣，
“秘密之翼”是為了推翻邪惡的雷根貝勒公司而成立的。
現在，我想你一定有很多問題要問我...

scripts.text: Secret Wing's Background
scripts.translation: 秘密之翼的背景

scripts.text: Rekenber's Purpose
scripts.translation: 雷根貝勒的目的

scripts.text: Secret Wing's Goal
scripts.translation: 秘密之翼的目標

scripts.text: Details about my mission
scripts.translation: 關於我的任務詳情

scripts.text: I'm ready for my mission.
scripts.translation: 我已準備好執行任務

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Rekenber has been
unopposed for a very long
time. Our nation is unhappy
with their rule, but since our
country lacks solidarity, the
people can do nothing.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
雷根貝勒已經獨大很久了。
我們的國家對他們的統治感到不滿，但由於缺乏團結，人民無能為力。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
But one day, I was contacted
by some people who claimed to
share my sentiments against
the Rekenber Corporation.
Later, I learned that they were
from the Kafra Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
但有一天，我收到了一些人的聯絡，他們聲稱與我一樣，反對雷根貝勒公司。
後來我得知，他們來自卡普拉公司。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Apparently, they were
facing some aggressive
competition from Cool
Event Corp, which is
actually backed by the
Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
顯然，他們正面臨來自酷活動公司的激烈競爭，而後者實際上由雷根貝勒公司支援。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
We decided to pool our
resources to deal with what
we perceived as a common
enemy. Before long, we gathered
more devotees to our cause and
formed the ''Secret Wing.''
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我們決定聯合力量，對付這個共同的敵人。不久，我們又聚集了更多志同道合的人，成立了“秘密之翼”。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
It may be helpful for
you to know that our
direct contact to the
Kafra Corporation is the
^FF00003rd Security Team^000000. Oh, did
you have any other questions?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
也許你需要知道，我們與卡普拉公司的直接聯絡是
^FF0000第三安全隊^000000。
哦，你還有其他問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
It's true that companies
exist to create money, but
the Rekenber Corporation
is much more nefarious.
They actually want to dominate the entire Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
雖然公司存在的目的是賺錢，但雷根貝勒公司更加險惡。
他們實際上想要統治整個米德加爾特大陸。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
In fact, the chairman of
that company is shrouded
in mystery. Although I'm
the president, I go through
many difficulties just to
send a message to him.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
事實上，那家公司的會長籠罩在神秘之中。
雖然我是總裁，但僅僅為了給他傳遞一條訊息，我就必須經歷重重困難。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
It's disheartening,
but we really have no
idea what their true goals
and plans might be. Now, did
you have any other questions?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
這令人沮喪，但我們真的不知道他們的真正目標和計劃是什麼。那麼，你還有其他問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
''Secret Wing's'' only
goal is to destroy the
Rekenber Corporation in
order to break the Schwarzwald Republic free from its oppression.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
“秘密之翼”唯一的目標就是摧毀雷根貝勒公司，讓秀髮茲發德共和國擺脫它的壓迫。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Of course, we realize
that it will take time and
a lot of sacrifice to make
this a reality. Now, do you
have anything else to ask?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
當然，我們意識到這需要時間和大量的犧牲才能實現。
那麼，你還有什麼要問的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ah, your next mission.
I'm ready to give you
some of the details if
you no longer have any
questions to ask. Let me
know when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
啊，你的下一個任務。
如果你不再有其他問題，我準備給你一些細節。當你準備好時請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Very well, then.
Your mission will not
be too difficult, but it does
have great urgency so you
must accomplish it as soon
as you can. Understood?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
很好。
你的任務不會太難，但非常緊急，所以你必須儘快完成。
明白了嗎？

scripts.text: Wait, I have one more question!
scripts.translation: 等等，我還有一個問題！

scripts.text: Yes sir, Mr. President.
scripts.translation: 是的，總裁先生

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hm? I thought you
didn't have any more
questions. However, I still
have the luxury to give you
any answers that I can provide.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
嗯？我以為你沒有其他問題了。
不過，我還有餘力給你一些我能提供的答案。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I'm glad to hear that.
Alright, give me a second
to search for this file before
I explain the mission.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
很高興聽到這個。
好的，給我一點時間查詢這份檔案，然後再向你解釋任務。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Now, you must first visit
the Kafra Headquarters in
Al De Baran and meet someone
named ^FF0000Benith^000000. She will tell you
all about your next mission.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
現在，你必須先去艾爾帕蘭的卡普拉總部，見一位名叫^FF0000貝尼斯^000000的人。
她會告訴你關於你下一個任務的所有事情。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Be careful and do not
freely mention anything
about ''Secret Wing'' or
your cooperation with us as
it may jeopardize our goals.
Hurry, time is of the essence.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
小心行事，不要隨意提及“秘密之翼”
或你與我們的合作，因為這可能會危及我們的目標。
快去吧，時間緊迫。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ah, before I forget,
please bring this file
folder to ^FF0000Ms. Hes O'Neil^000000
for me before you leave.
Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
啊，差點忘了，請在你離開之前，把這個資料夾帶給^FF0000赫斯·奧尼爾女士^000000。
非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hurry and complete
the mission given to
you by Benith, who is
in the Kafra Headquarters
in Al De Baran. It is a very
urgent, high priority task...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
快去完成貝尼斯在艾爾帕蘭卡普拉總部交給你的任務。
這是一個非常緊急、高優先順序的任務...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hm? I was expecting
for you to bring me
back an important file.
Please hurry, our entire
organization is at stake!
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
嗯？我原本期待你帶回來一份重要檔案。
請快點，我們整個組織都岌岌可危！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ah, you're here.
Good work, I hear that
the mission was a success.
An official success anyway.
...............................
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
啊，你來了。
幹得好，聽說任務成功了。
至少表面上是成功了。
...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Poor, dear sweet
Jargeah. Why him?
Must fate be so cruel
and harsh? I still can't
believe he's gone. Just
last week, we were...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
可憐、親愛的雅格亞。為什麼偏偏是他？
命運為何如此殘酷？我仍然無法相信他已經離開了。就在上週，我們還...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I'm sorry. You didn't
know him that well, but
all those who did know
him, loved him. And I can
say that with pride. L-let
me check the files a minute...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
抱歉。你和他並不熟，但所有認識他的人都愛他。
我可以自豪地說這一點。
讓...讓我檢查一下檔案...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hm. After completely
reviewing this file, I've
found that it offers some
great leads, but it's still not
enough hard evidence to
really hurt Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
嗯。我仔細審閱了這份檔案，發現其中有一些很有價值的線索，但還不足以成為能真正打擊雷根貝勒的確鑿證據。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
However, according to
this, there's a researcher
from Rekenber named
Shinokas who vanished all
of a sudden. Apparently, he
knew some kind of secret.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
不過，根據這份檔案，雷根貝勒有一位名叫希諾卡斯的研究員突然失蹤了。
顯然，他知道某種秘密。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Luckily, my men have
reported sightings of
Shinokas somewhere in
Einbroch. He's certainly
out there. But what does
he have to hide?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
幸運的是，我的人報告說在艾音布羅克看到了希諾卡斯。
他肯定在那裡。
但他有什麼要隱瞞的？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
We must learn his
secret if we hope to
do any lasting damage to
the Rekenber Corporation.
Your next mission is to
find Shinokas. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
如果我們希望給雷根貝勒公司造成持久的傷害，就必須查明他的秘密。
你的下一個任務是找到希諾卡斯。
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
And please hurry.
I don't want our enemies
to discover Shinokas before
we can get him to talk.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
請快點。
我不希望我們的敵人在我們讓他開口之前先找到希諾卡斯。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I'm sorry, but it's
taking me a long time
to analyze the information
in this file. A-and Jargeah
sacrificed himself to get
it for us. ^333333*Sigh*^000000 Jargeah...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
抱歉，解析這份檔案中的資訊花了我很長時間。
而雅格亞為了得到它獻出了生命。
^333333*嘆氣*^000000 雅格亞...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Why don't you relax
while I peruse this
file? I should be done
with this soon, hopefully...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
在我翻閱這份檔案的時候，你不妨休息一下。
希望我很快就能看完...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ymir's Heart Pieces?
Is that what they're
trying to collect?
What are they going
to do with something
so incredibly dangerous?!
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
依美樂之心的碎片？
這就是他們想收集的東西嗎？
他們打算拿如此危險的東西做什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Huh. This new information
raises some new questions.
Fortunately, we have a new
lead from the spy who got
us the info on Shinokas.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
嗯。這個新資訊引發了一些新的疑問。
幸運的是，我們從那個提供希諾卡斯情報的間諜那裡得到了新的線索。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
We've recently learned that
Shinokas managed to access
the Regenschirm Secret Archive, a lab affiliated with Rekenber.
That's how Shinokas was able
to learn so much about them.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我們最近得知，希諾卡斯設法進入了雷根席爾姆秘密檔案室，那是雷根貝勒旗下的一個實驗室。
希諾卡斯就是這樣瞭解到關於他們的這麼多資訊的。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
It will be difficult
and very dangerous to
access this archive, so
I want you to meet with
someone from the Kafra
Corporation near Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
進入這個檔案館將非常困難且極其危險，所以我想讓你去見裡希塔樂鎮附近卡普拉公司的一位人員。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
And don't worry...
She'll know exactly
who you are and
how to help you.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
別擔心...
她會確切地知道你是誰，以及如何幫助你。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
We don't know how
helpful Shinokas's
information may be for
us, but we must learn
anything we can about
the Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我們不知道希諾卡斯的資訊對我們有多大幫助，但我們必須瞭解關於雷根貝勒公司的一切。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
There is so much we
don't know about them.
Their motives, their methods,
almost all of the important
details are still in the dark.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
關於他們，我們還有太多未知。
他們的動機、手段，幾乎所有重要細節仍然籠罩在黑暗中。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
By all means, you
must find Shinokas and
see what you can learn!
Your efforts will not go
unrecognized, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
無論如何，你必須找到希諾卡斯，看看你能學到什麼！
你的努力不會白費，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hm? What's wrong?
Now that I think about
it, you reacted as if you
recognized his name back
when I mentioned Shinokas.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
嗯？怎麼了？
現在回想起來，當我提到希諾卡斯時，你的反應好像認識他。

scripts.text: Oh, no. Not really.
scripts.translation: 哦，不。不是的

scripts.text: Actually, Shinokas is...
scripts.translation: 其實，希諾卡斯是...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Then it must be
my imagination.
Okay then, go and
find Shinokas, he
may be in grave
danger as we speak!
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
那一定是我的錯覺。
好吧，快去找到希諾卡斯，他此刻可能正處於危險之中！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Oh...
You've already met
Shinokas, did you?
You witnessed his 
death?! This is a very
strange coincidence.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
哦...
你已經見過希諾卡斯了？
你目睹了他的死亡？！
這真是奇怪的巧合。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I see, there must be
no need to investigate
Shinokas now. And you
did learn the secret for
which he was hunted...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我明白了，看來現在沒必要再調查希諾卡斯了。
而且你也知道了他被人追殺的秘密...

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Mr. President,
Ms. Hes O' Neil has an
urgent message for you.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
總裁先生，赫斯·奧尼爾女士有緊急訊息要向您彙報。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hmm...
Then please,
let her in.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
嗯...
那就請讓她進來吧。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Sir, I'm sorry
for interrupting
you, but there's
something I need to
show you immediately!
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奧尼爾]
先生，抱歉打擾您，但我有件必須立刻向您展示的事情！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Alright, let's
have it. Let me
see those new files.
Oh, these are--! Thank
you, Ms. O' Neil, you
may leave now.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
好的，給我看看。
讓我看看這些新檔案。
哦，這些是——！
謝謝你，奧尼爾女士，你可以離開了。

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
Thank you sir.
Once again, let me
apologize for disturbing
your private conference.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奧尼爾]
謝謝先生。
再次為打擾您的私人會議致歉。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Alright. Please let me
review these documents
to see if there are any
new developments in the
investigation involving
Shinokas and his secret...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
好的。請讓我審閱這些檔案，看看關於希諾卡斯及其秘密的調查是否有新的進展...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Alright, I just
completed reading
all of these new reports
from our field agents.
Thank you for waiting.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
好的，我剛讀完所有這些來自我們特工的新報告。
謝謝你的等待。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
We've recently learned that
Shinokas managed to access
the Regenschirm  Secret Archive,a lab affiliated with Rekenber.
That's how Shinokas was able
to learn so much about them.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我們最近得知，希諾卡斯設法進入了雷根席爾姆秘密檔案室，那是雷根貝勒旗下的實驗室。
希諾卡斯就是這樣瞭解到關於他們的這麼多資訊的。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
It will be difficult
and very dangerous to
access this archive, so
I want you to meet with
someone from the Kafra
Corporation near Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
進入這個檔案館將非常困難且極其危險，所以我想讓你去見裡希塔樂鎮附近卡普拉公司的一位人員。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
If you keep looking around
the ^3355FFfields just outside of
Lighthalzen^000000, you'll certainly
find her. I'm sorry that I can't
tell you more, but we've got
to protect our security...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
如果你在^3355FF裡希塔樂鎮外^000000的野外四處尋找，肯定能找到她。抱歉我不能透露更多，但我們必須保護我們的安全...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
And don't worry...
She'll know exactly
who you are and
how to help you.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
別擔心...
她會確切地知道你是誰，以及如何幫助你。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I apologize, but it's
taking me a long time
to go through all of the
reports in these files.
Please give me a little more
time to make sense of them.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
抱歉，但我花了很多時間來梳理這些檔案中的所有報告。
請再給我一點時間來理清頭緒。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I hope you continue
to keep up the good
work, not only for the
sake of the Schwarzwald
Republic, but for peace
on all of Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我希望你能繼續保持出色的工作，不僅為了秀髮茲發德共和國，也為了米德加爾特全境的和平。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Did you find any
of that evidence in
the Secret Archive yet?
Hurry! The movements in
Rekenber Corporation are
making me feel really uneasy.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你在秘密檔案室裡找到那些證據了嗎？
快一點！雷根貝勒公司的動向讓我感到很不安。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ah, you're here.
I've already received a
message from Esuna
about your success.
If you would, please
let me read the file...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
啊，你來了。
我已經收到艾斯娜關於你成功的訊息了。
如果可以的話，請讓我讀一下這份檔案...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ah, now everything is
clearer. Shinokas and his
friends were killed over
that piece of Ymir's Heart.
That's what the Rekenber
Corporation ultimately wants.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
啊，現在一切都清楚了。希諾卡斯和他的朋友們是因為那塊依美樂之心碎片而被殺的。
這就是雷根貝勒公司最終想要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
But this raises some
new questions. What
are they planning to
do with Ymir's Heart?
It must be more powerful
than we had thought...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
但這引發了一些新的問題。他們打算用依美樂的心臟做什麼？
它一定比我們想像的更強大...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
We'll need even more
information. For now,
please go back to Esuna.
It seems that she just
received some critically
important intel to give you.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我們需要更多的資訊。現在，請回到艾斯娜那裡。
看來她剛收到一些極其重要的情報要給你。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Please hurry and meet
Esuna just outside of
Lighthalzen. Perhaps I am
getting paranoid, but I keep
getting the feeling that
Rekenber is on to us...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
請快點去裡希塔樂鎮外與艾斯娜會面。
也許是我多心了，但我總覺得雷根貝勒盯上我們了...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You don't have the
file? Retrieve it for
me as soon as you can.
It's imperative that I read
what Esuna has to report!
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你沒有那份檔案？
儘快把它取回來。
我必須讀到艾斯娜的報告！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ah, good to see you
again. I hear you have
some important news for
me, something of the utmost
urgency. But I fear the worst.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
啊，很高興再次見到你。
聽說你有重要訊息要告訴我，而且十萬火急。
但我恐怕是最壞的情況。

scripts.text: Give the file from Esuna.
scripts.translation: 交給艾斯娜的檔案

scripts.text:
[Karl]
What...?
I can't believe this!
How can our security
be breached like this?!
Only someone from
really deep inside could...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
什麼...？
難以置信！
我們的安保怎麼會被這樣突破？！
只有內部非常核心的人才能...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Please...
Would you go and
speak to Esuna one
more time? I need to
know more about how
all of this happened...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
拜託了...
你能再去和艾斯娜談談嗎？
我需要知道這一切到底是怎麼發生的...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
No...
I can't...
Kurelle? We've
worked together,
trusted each other
for years. No, it's not....
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
不...
我不相信...
庫蕾爾？我們共事多年，彼此信任。不，不可能...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
If it's true, then
that means I've been
playing into the enemy's
hands this whole time.
I've... I've got to know
and ask Kurelle myself.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
如果這是真的，那就意味著我一直被敵人牽著鼻子走。
我...我必須親自去問庫蕾爾。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
O'Neil!
Bring Kurelle in
here, right now!
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
赫斯·奧尼爾！
馬上把庫蕾爾帶進來！

scripts.text:
[Hes O'Neil]
...Yes, sir.
Right away.
scripts.translation:
[赫斯·奧尼爾]
...是的，總裁先生。
馬上就來。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Advisor Kurelle
is here now.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
顧問庫蕾爾已經到外面了。

[卡爾]
讓他進來！
...

[衛兵]
...？
是的，總裁先生...

scripts.text:
[Kurelle]
Hello, Mr. President.
What exactly did you
need from me today?
scripts.translation:
[庫蕾爾]
你好，總裁先生。
今天您找我有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Did you...
Why did you betray us?!
After all this time, why now?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
是你...？
你為什麼要背叛我們？！
這麼多年了，為什麼偏偏是現在？

scripts.text:
[Kurelle]
...
......
So you know.
Well, you're smarter
than I gave you credit for.
scripts.translation:
[庫蕾爾]
...
...
原來你知道。
看來你比我以為的要聰明。

scripts.text:
[Kurelle]
Ha ha ha~
Right, it was me.
Your right hand man.
I reported everything
you were doing to the
Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[庫蕾爾]
Ha ha ha~~
沒錯，就是我。
你的得力助手。
我把你做的一切都報告給了雷根貝勒公司。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
But why...?
I thought we were
working together for
the greater good, to
do the right thing?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
但為什麼...？
我以為我們是為了更大的利益，為了做正確的事才一起工作的？

scripts.text:
[Kurelle]
Forget that! I'm sick
of being second place
to you. All our lives, you've
always been on top. School,
athletics, politics. Well, here's my chance to finally beat you!
scripts.translation:
[庫蕾爾]
別提了！我受夠了永遠屈居你之下。從小到大，你總是站在頂端。學業、體育、政治。現在，我終於有機會打敗你了！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I can't believe this. All
those years of friendship
were all a lie? We even
joined Secret Wing together.
This whole time, you were
harboring a silly grudge...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
難以置信。這麼多年來的友誼竟然都是假的？我們還一起加入了秘密之翼。原來你一直懷有這種愚蠢的怨恨...

scripts.text:
[Kurelle]
Shut up! It's not a
silly grudge! ...You there.
Adventurer. Can't you see
this man is finished?! But
it's not too late. Join us.
Rekenber could use you.
scripts.translation:
[庫蕾爾]
閉嘴！這不是愚蠢的怨恨！...你，冒險者。難道你沒看出來這個男人已經完蛋了嗎？但還來得及。加入我們吧。雷根貝勒需要你。

scripts.text:
[Kurelle]
Now that I've helped
the Rekenber Corporation,
I'll get their support in the
next presidential election.
I'll beat you for sure, Karl!
Bwahahahahahaahahahhaah~!
scripts.translation:
[庫蕾爾]
既然我幫助了雷根貝勒公司，下次總裁選舉他們就會支援我。我一定會打敗你的，卡爾！哇哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
It's all over for
now. This isn't good
at all. You're finished
here too. Go and talk to
^3355FFGhalstein^000000 again. It's time
we let you loose, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
現在一切都結束了。情況非常不妙。你在這裡也完蛋了。去和^3355FF加爾斯坦^000000再談談吧。是時候放你走了，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, where did I put the record?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，我把記錄放哪兒了？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
It's you.....!
It's really been a long time.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
是你...！
真的好久不見了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So, are you still having the idea to go against Rekenber?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以，你還有對抗雷根貝勒的想法嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I'm not sure.
The Secret Wing has been disbanded and I am just another puppet they have, just like the previous presidents.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我不確定。
秘密之翼已經解散了，我現在只是他們手中的傀儡，就像之前的總裁一樣。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not long ago, the scientists of Regenschrim have stolen the research record and destroyed the machines that they used for research purposes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不久前，雷根席爾姆的科學家偷走了研究記錄，並摧毀了用於研究的機器。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
...!
Did you do that? 
I still fail to move on after the incident of my friends' betrayal and the disband of the Secret Wing...
You are really a great friend.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
...！
是你做的嗎？
在朋友背叛和秘密之翼解散的事件之後，我一直無法釋懷...
你真是個大好人。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Didn't you speak about the research record just now?
Oh! Can you give me the record?
It will be a big trouble to them.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你剛才提到了研究記錄？
哦！你能把記錄給我嗎？
這對他們來說會是很大的麻煩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you insist to go against them, I will give you the record.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你堅持要對抗他們，我就把記錄給你。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I am the president of this country.
I have failed before but I won't stop trying when there is still an opportunity.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我是這個國家的總裁。
我以前失敗過，但只要還有機會，我就不會停止嘗試。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You remind me of the day I made up my mind to rebuild this country.
How could I forgot such important responsibilities of mine.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你讓我想起了我下定決心重建這個國家的那一天。
我怎麼能忘記我肩負的重要責任呢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's great.
Here's the record.
I hope you will make good use of it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
太好了。
這是記錄。
希望你能好好利用它。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Oh! That's some interesting information.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
哦！這資訊真有意思。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have another good news. The Secret Wing has not given up yet. They are still working on the project and I hope that you won't be giving up on it too.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我還有一個好訊息。秘密之翼並沒有放棄，他們仍在推進這個專案。我希望你也不要放棄。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
.....I feel so sorry for what I did.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
...我為我所做的一切感到抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Thank you for bringing this great gift. I will stay strong and work hard to achieve my target.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
謝謝你帶來這份珍貴的禮物。我會保持堅強，努力工作以實現我的目標。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I will recruit the new batch of members and use them to let the world know about what the corporation had really done.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我將招募新一批成員，讓他們向世界揭露這家公司的真面目。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Thank you so much. 
You can count on me to right what was wrong.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
非常感謝。
你可以指望我糾正過去的錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I am trying to recruit capable people who can help me to bring down Rekenber Corporation.
Thanks to you, I have enough information as a good beginning to nail them now down.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我正在招募有能力的人，幫助我扳倒雷根貝勒公司。
多虧了你，我獲得了足夠的資訊，這是一個很好的開端，足以讓他們現出原形。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I have had my men to gather some information and learned that Regenschrim had stopped operating now.
You have done well for the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我派人收集了一些情報，得知雷根席爾姆現在已經停止運作了。
你為秀髮茲發德共和國做得很好。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhat the...?
You can hear
whispers coming
from the window.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什...什麼？
你聽到從窗戶傳來低語聲。^000000

scripts.text:
[????]
^333333That's expected...
But... Why did...
... the president...^000000

^3355FFThe whispers grow
lower and lower until
you can no longer hear
anything. One of those
voices seemed so familiar...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF低語聲越來越小，直到你再也聽不見任何聲音。其中一個聲音聽起來很熟悉...^000000

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome to the
Kafra Headquarters.
Here in the heart of
Kafra's operations, you
can be provided with special
services offered nowhere else!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
歡迎來到卡普拉總部。
這裡是卡普拉的業務中心，您可以享受其他地方沒有的特別服務！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
If you need anything,
please inquire the Kafra
Employees inside the building.
Thank you and have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
如果您有任何需求，請諮詢大樓內的卡普拉職員。
謝謝，祝您愉快~

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Good day~
The Kafra Corporation is
always working to ensure
our customers' satisfaction.
How may I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
您好~
卡普拉總公司始終努力讓每一位顧客滿意。
今天有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: I have a question.
scripts.translation: 我有一個問題

scripts.text: I'm fine, thanks.
scripts.translation: 我沒事，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Sure, I'll answer your
question to the best of
my ability. However, I may
need to reference you to
another employee for
specialized information.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
當然，我會盡力回答您的問題。
不過，涉及專業知識時，可能還得請您諮詢其他職員。

scripts.text: Do you know where I can find Benith?
scripts.translation: 你知道貝尼斯在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Oh, Benith? Sure, you
can find her here inside
Kafra Headquarters to the
right somewhere. She wears
a special uniform, so you
can spot her easily.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
哦，貝尼斯？
她就在卡普拉總部裡面，往右邊找找就能看到。
她穿著特別的制服，很好認的。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Okay then,
have a good day!
Always remember
that the Kafra Service
will be on your side~
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
好的，祝您今天愉快！
請記住，卡普拉服務永遠在您身邊~

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Feel free to ask any
one of our conveniently
located employees if you
ever have need of Kafra's
special services. Thank
you and have a nice day~
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
如果您需要卡普拉的特殊服務，請隨時詢問我們分佈在各處的職員。
謝謝，祝您度過美好的一天~

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務將部分物品存入倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome to
Kafra Headquarters.
What's new with Kafra?
Glad you asked. Right now,
we're developing a brand new
program with Cool Event Corp.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
歡迎來到卡普拉總部。
想知道卡普拉有什麼新訊息？
您可問對了！
目前，我們正在和酷活動公司合作開發一項全新計劃。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
This new program will
provide a direct teleport
service to dungeons for
the convenience of our
valued customers. Is
that not... exciting?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
為方便各位顧客，這項新計劃將提供直達地下城的傳送服務。
是不是...很讓人期待呢？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Due to technical issues,
Kafra Corp and Cool Event
Corp cannot provide teleport
services to the same dungeon,
so one common teleport service
provider will be selected.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
由於技術問題，卡普拉總公司和酷活動公司無法同時提供前往同一座地下城的傳送服務，因此只能選出一家公司統一提供這項服務。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Therefore, elections will
be held to determine which
company will provide this
Dungeon Teleport Service.
Please check the eligibility
requirements before voting.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
因此，我們會舉行投票，決定由哪家公司提供地下城傳送服務。
投票前，請先檢視參與資格。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome to
Kafra Headquarters.
What's new with Kafra?
Glad you asked. Right now,
we're developing a brand new
program with Cool Event Corp.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
歡迎來到卡普拉總部。
想知道卡普拉有什麼新訊息？
您可問對了！
目前，我們正在和酷活動公司合作開發一項全新計劃。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
This new program will
provide a direct teleport
service to dungeons for
the convenience of our
valued customers. Is
that not... exciting?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
為方便各位顧客，這項新計劃將提供直達地下城的傳送服務。
是不是...很讓人期待呢？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Due to technical issues,
Kafra Corp and Cool Event
Corp cannot provide teleport
services to the same dungeon,
so one common teleport service
provider will be selected.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
由於技術問題，卡普拉總公司和酷活動公司無法同時提供前往同一座地下城的傳送服務，因此只能選出一家公司統一提供這項服務。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
We'd like to inform
you that the customers
will decide the teleport
service provider through
an election. Your vote will
be much appreciated.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
這項傳送服務將由顧客投票決定交給哪家公司提供。
希望您也能投上一票！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Remember to take part
in the polls that will be
taking place in the cities
of Prontera and Juno.
Happy voting.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
記得參加在普隆德拉和朱諾舉行的投票哦。
祝您投票愉快！

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: I can't wait!
scripts.translation: 我等不及了！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Uh oh...
Did you have a question?
In all honesty, I don't know
very much about the services
Kafra offers. My work is...
I'm in a different department.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
呃...
您有什麼問題嗎？
老實說，我不太瞭解卡普拉的服務。
我的工作...我是在別的部門工作的。

scripts.text: Oh, that's okay then.
scripts.translation: 哦，那沒關係

scripts.text: Are you Benith..?
scripts.translation: 你是貝尼斯嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
*Whew!*
Oh good. Well, if you
do have any questions
about the Kafra Services,
please ask one of the regular
Kafra Employees. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
*呼！*
那就好。
如果您對卡普拉服務有疑問，請諮詢負責日常服務的卡普拉職員。
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Benith]
Yes, that's me.
Is there anything
that I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[貝尼斯]
是的，就是我。
有什麼我可以為您效勞的嗎？

scripts.text: No, not really.
scripts.translation: 不，不是

scripts.text: Show Membership Card.
scripts.translation: 出示會員卡

scripts.text:
[Benith]
Really?
Okay, then.
scripts.translation:
[貝尼斯]
真的嗎？
好的，那麼。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait...
You can't show
your ''Secret Wing''
Membership Card
if you don't have it!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等等...
如果你沒有
“秘密之翼”會員卡，就不能出示它！^000000

scripts.text:
[Benith]
Oh, I've been waiting
for you. Finally, I can
drop this promotional
pretense and get down
to business and tell you
about your mission.
scripts.translation:
[貝尼斯]
哦，我一直在等您。
終於，我可以放下這種宣傳姿態，開始正事，告訴您關於您的任務了。

scripts.text:
[Benith]
As an experienced
adventurer, your specialty
is in retrieving items and
fighting against monsters.
We have a rescue mission
that suits your expertise.
scripts.translation:
[貝尼斯]
作為一名經驗豐富的冒險者，您的專長是獲取物品和與魔物戰鬥。
我們有一個救援任務適合您的專長。

scripts.text:
[Benith]
One of our special
agents got into an
accident and is stuck
in ^FF0000Grim Reaper's Valley^000000,
located somewhere between
Einbroch and Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[貝尼斯]
我們的一名特工出了事故，被困在
^FF0000死神峽谷^000000，位於艾音布羅克和裡希塔樂鎮之間。

scripts.text:
[Benith]
Our agent, Jargeah,
is reported to be hiding
near a broken bridge there.
All of our other agents are
assigned on other missions,
so you're all he has right now.
scripts.translation:
[貝尼斯]
我們的特工雅格亞據報正躲藏在那裡一座斷橋附近。
我們其他特工都在執行其他任務，所以目前只有你能幫他了。

scripts.text:
[Benith]
He's seriously wounded,
so please hurry before
the enemy can get to him...
scripts.translation:
[貝尼斯]
他傷勢嚴重，請快點趕過去，別讓敵人先找到他...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
That makes one of u--
I mean, your participation
is very much appreciated.
Remember that Kafra is
always on your side.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
這下你就是我們的人...
我是說，非常感謝您的參與。
請記住，卡普拉永遠在您身邊。

scripts.text:
[Benith]
Please hurry and save
Jargeah. If the enemy
gets to him before we
do, all his efforts, as well
as his life, may be forfeit.
scripts.translation:
[貝尼斯]
請快點去救雅格亞。
如果敵人先找到他，他所有的努力，甚至他的生命，都可能付諸東流。

scripts.text:
[Benith]
You should be able to
find him near a broken
bridge in Grim Reaper's
Valley, which is located
somewhere between
Einbroch and Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[貝尼斯]
你應該能在死神峽谷的一座斷橋附近找到他，那裡位於艾音布羅克和裡希塔樂鎮之間。

scripts.text:
[Benith]
Please hurry!
I don't want the enemy
to find Jargeah before
we do! His life and the
Secret Wing are at stake!
scripts.translation:
[貝尼斯]
請快點！
我不希望敵人先找到雅格亞！
他的生命和秘密之翼都懸於一線！

scripts.text:
[Benith]
Great, you're back,
and you even have the
information that Jargeah
managed to obtain. But...
Where's Jargeah? Is he...?
scripts.translation:
[貝尼斯]
太好了，你回來了，而且你還帶回了雅格亞設法獲得的情報。但是...
雅格亞呢？他...？

scripts.text: He's in a better place.
scripts.translation: 他去了更好的地方

scripts.text:
[Benith]
What...?! Noooo!
Comrade Jargeah!
I swear to you your
death won't be in vain!
Why did another good man
have to die? Answer me!!
scripts.translation:
[貝尼斯]
什...什麼？！不！
同伴雅格亞！
我向你發誓，你的死不會白費！
為什麼又一個好人必須死去？回答我！！

scripts.text:
[Benith]
I can't... No. We must
first honor Jargeah's noble
sacrifice before we can allow ourselves the luxury of mourning
our loss. Let me read these files first before you deliver them...
scripts.translation:
[貝尼斯]
我不能...不，我們必須先向雅格亞的英勇犧牲致敬，然後才能盡情哀悼他的離去。讓我先看看這些檔案，然後你再把它們交上去...

scripts.text:
[Benith]
Alright. Please take
this file to ^FF0000him^000000 now.
I believe you know
whom I am talking about.
The Secret Wing is counting
on you, brave adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[貝尼斯]
好的。請把這個檔案交給^FF0000他^000000。
我相信你知道我說的是誰。
秘密之翼正指望著你，勇敢的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Benith]
I swear by my father's
grave that the tears I shed
for Jargeah will only be
matched by the blood I will
spill in holy retribution.
Jargeah, watch over me!
scripts.translation:
[貝尼斯]
我以我父親的墳墓發誓，我為雅格亞流下的淚水，將只會被我為神聖復仇所流的鮮血所匹敵。
雅格亞，請保佑我！

scripts.text:
[Benith]
W-welcome to the
Kafra Headquarters.
What's new with Kafra?
^333333Glad... You... Asked...^000000
scripts.translation:
[貝尼斯]
歡...歡迎來到卡普拉總部。
卡普拉有什麼新訊息？
^333333高...興...你...問...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務將部分物品存入倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[?????]
^333333*Cough cough*^000000
Can't hold out...
Much longer. They...
They better send
someone soon...
scripts.translation:
[?????]
^333333*咳咳*^000000
撐不住了...
再撐不了多久了。他們...
他們最好快點派人來...

scripts.text: ^3355FFIt's a wounded man...!^000000

[{0}]
H-hey...!
Are you hurt?
Do you need any he--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你...你好...！
你受傷了嗎？
你需要什麼幫--

scripts.text:
[?????]
N-no..!
Get away, do-gooder!
Don't attract attention,
they're gonna find me!
Don't worry, don't ask,
j-just get the hell away!
scripts.translation:
[?????]
不...不！
走開，多管閒事的人！
別引起注意，他們要找到我了！
別擔心，別問，快...快滾開！

scripts.text:
[?????]
^333333*Cough cough*^000000
Can't hold out...
Much longer. They...
They better send
someone soon...
scripts.translation:
[?????]
^333333*咳咳*^000000
撐不住了...
再撐不了多久了。他們...
他們最好快點派人來...

scripts.text: Jargeah?
scripts.translation: 雅格亞？

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[Jargeah]
^333333*Cough Gasp*^000000
H-how do you know my...
Never mind that. Who...
What... What organization
are you working for...?
scripts.translation:
[雅格亞]
^333333*咳 倒吸一口氣*^000000
你...你怎麼知道我的...
算了。你...
你...你是為哪個組織工作的...？

scripts.text:
[Jargeah]
Th-thank goodness!
You finally came for me.
If you came a little later,
I'd be a goner. H-here,
t-take this with you...
scripts.translation:
[雅格亞]
謝...謝天謝地！
你終於來救我了。
再晚一點，我就沒命了。給，把這個...拿去吧...

scripts.text:
[Jargeah]
Oh... Oh no.
*Cough cough*
I think... It might
T-tell Cilantro that...
Tell her I still lov-- ^333333*Huk*^000000
scripts.translation:
[雅格亞]
噢...噢不。
*咳咳*
我想...我可能得告訴西蘭特羅...告訴她我還愛-- ^333333*Huk*^000000

scripts.text:
[Jargeah]
No... No, you're
not the one who's
supposed to come
for m-me... ^333333*Huk*^000000

^3355FFThis isn't good.
Jargeah just passed
out in a very ugly way.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF情況不妙。
雅格亞以非常難看的方式昏了過去。

scripts.text:
^3355FFAnd so you left the
wounded man alone. Not
exactly the best moral choice.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF於是你丟下那個受傷的男人離開了。
這可不是什麼好的道德選擇。^000000

scripts.text:
[?????]
^333333*Cough cough*^000000
Everything's getting
darker. So c-cold...

[????]
Here,
Come this way.

^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務將部分物品存入倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
I've been waiting for you.
We don't have much time,
so I'll explain quickly. Your
mission is to sneak into the
Rekenber Corporation and
steal incriminating evidence.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
我一直在等你。
時間不多，我長話短說。你的任務是潛入雷根貝勒公司，竊取罪證。

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
However, this place won't
be easy to infiltrate and
there'll be more security
because they learned about
what happened with Shinokas
and... and Jargeah. Jargeah...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
不過，這個地方不容易滲透，而且因為希諾卡斯和...和雅格亞的事，安保會更嚴密。雅格亞...

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
You'll need to acquire
identification through one
of our agents who's managed
to get in really deep without
arousing any suspicion.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
你需要通過我們的一名特工獲取身份證明，他已深入內部，且未引起任何懷疑。

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
Afterwards, find the
^FF0000Secret Archive^000000, disable the
security system and steal
that evidence as quickly as
possible. Understood?
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
之後，找到
^FF0000秘密檔案室^000000，關閉安保系統，並儘快竊取證據。明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
For now, use the pass you
have for the Rekenber buildings
and meet up with Agent ^FF0000Lestin^000000.
He'll explain everything else,
so be careful and don't let
them get suspicious of you!
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
現在，使用你手中的通行證進入雷根貝勒大樓，與特工^FF0000萊斯廷^000000會合。
他會解釋其餘的一切，小心行事，別讓他們起疑！

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
Use the pass that you
have to enter the Rekenber
buildings and find Secret
Agent Lestin. Remember
that he's undercover...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
使用你手中的通行證進入雷根貝勒大樓，找到特工萊斯廷。
記住，他是臥底...

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
Good work.
Please bring this file
to President Weierstrass
right away. We'll also be
directly sending information
as a safeguard measure.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
幹得好。
請立刻把這個檔案交給魏爾斯特拉斯總裁。
我們也會直接傳送情報作為保障措施。

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
I know it's sudden, but
there's a new development.
I can't explain it now, but you
have to check on the president
for me first. Plus, this new
intel needs to be confirmed...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
我知道很突然，但出現了新情況。
我現在無法解釋，但你必須先替我去確認總裁的情況。另外，這份新情報需要核實...

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
You're back. Listen,
you could not have helped
us out at a worse time. We
just learned that something
horrible has happened...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
你回來了。聽著，你來得太不巧了。我們剛得知發生了可怕的事情...

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
I can't give you all
the details now, but
you've got to give this
file to the president as
quickly as you can. Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
我現在不能告訴你所有細節，但你必須儘快把這個檔案交給總裁。
快！

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
What are you waiting
for?! It's important that
you give that file to the
president as soon as
possible! It's bad news,
but he deserves to know...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
你在等什麼？！
必須儘快把那份檔案交給總裁！雖然訊息很壞，但他有權知道...

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
Good, you're back.
Listen, all members of
Secret Wing need to leave
the Schwarzwald Republic
immediately! We've been
severely compromised...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
很好，你回來了。
聽著，“秘密之翼”的所有成員都必須立即離開秀髮茲發德共和國！我們的身份已經嚴重暴露...

scripts.text: What happened?
scripts.translation: 發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
We've been tremendously
damaged. A lot of agents
died to give us this intel,
but we've been betrayed.
The president's closest
aide totally sold us out...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
我們遭受了重創。許多特工為了獲取這份情報而犧牲，但我們被出賣了。
總裁最親近的助手徹底背叛了我們...

scripts.text: Who could have done such....?
scripts.translation: 誰會做出這種事...？

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
I can't believe Kurelle
did this to us. And there's no
way we can save the president.
Even if we wanted to, we need
to stick with our contigency
plan. We all knew the risks...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
我無法相信庫蕾爾竟然這麼對我們。我們已經無法救出總裁了。即使想救，也只能執行備用計劃。我們都知道會有這樣的風險...

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
Kurelle has been secretly
meeting with directors from
Rekenber Corporation and
his mansion is littered with
incriminating evidence...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
庫蕾爾一直在秘密會見雷根貝勒公司的總監們，他的宅邸裡到處都是罪證...

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
Damn it! We have no
choice but to abandon
the president now! But
this won't mean that his
sacrifice, and Jargeah's
death, will be vain!
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
該死！我們別無選擇，只能暫時放棄總裁！
但這並不意味著他的犧牲，以及雅格亞的死亡是徒勞的！

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
Still, aside from a few
agents, almost all of Secret
Wing must pull out of the
Schwarzwald Republic for
now so that we can live to
fight another day.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
儘管如此，除了少數特工外，“秘密之翼”的絕大多數成員現在都必須撤出秀髮茲發德共和國，才能留得青山在，日後再戰。

scripts.text:
[Esuna]
For now, this is
goodbye. Take care...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯娜]
暫時，這就是告別了。保重...

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
You know what's weird?
Why do they use blue and
red wires when they make
bombs? There's so many
others you could use, like
pink or yellow or or green...
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
你知道奇怪的是什麼嗎？
為什麼製作炸彈時要用藍色和紅色的線？
明明可以用很多其他顏色，比如粉色、黃色或者綠色...

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Hey, here's a completely
hypothetical question. Let's
say you find a bomb and it's
about to go off. You better
cut a wire! So which one are
you gonna cut? Red or blue?
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
嘿，這裡有個完全假設性的問題。假設你發現了一個炸彈，它馬上就要爆炸了。
你最好剪斷一根線！
那你打算剪哪根？紅色還是藍色？

scripts.text: Red
scripts.translation: 紅色

scripts.text: Blue
scripts.translation: 藍色

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Red, eh...?
...................
Heh, yeah, just like
in the movies. I like
the way you think~
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
紅色，是嗎...？
...
呵，沒錯，就像電影裡演的一樣。
我喜歡你的思維方式~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou surrepticiously
check the researcher's
ID badge and see that the name ''Lestin'' is written on it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你偷偷檢查了研究員的ID徽章，上面寫著名字“萊斯廷”。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
So...
Is there anything
I can help you with?
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
那麼...
有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Alright then.
Just be quiet when
you're in the Laboratory.
The people here work
pretty feverishly and get
irritated pretty easily, okay?
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
好的。
在實驗室裡請保持安靜。
這裡的人工作起來非常狂熱，而且很容易煩躁，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
So what exactly did
you need? I'm just an
ordinary researcher,
so I don't know how
much help I could be...
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
那你具體需要什麼幫助？我只是個普通的研究員，不知道能幫上多少忙...

scripts.text: Show Secret Wing Card.
scripts.translation: 出示秘密之翼會員卡

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Whoa, whoa~!
Careful where you
flash that! Okay, I know
who you are. But we better
continue this someplace
a bit more private...
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
哇哦，哇哦~！
小心你亮出那個東西！
好吧，我知道你是誰了。
但我們最好找個更私密的地方繼續談...

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Blue, huh? Yeah,
that's what everyone
else here picks. Now
what color would I pick?
Well, that's a secret~
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
藍色，是嗎？沒錯，這裡其他人都會選這個。那我會選什麼顏色呢？
嗯，那是個秘密~

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Geez, I've been so
tired lately. Work?
Forget it, I'm gonna
just kick back today~
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
天哪，我最近太累了。工作？
算了，今天我就好好放鬆一下~

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務將部分物品存入倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
This is a restricted
area. Please leave
immediately.
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
這是限制區域。
請立即離開。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
This place should be
safe enough for us to talk
for now, so please listen
carefully. Esuna must have
told you that they beefed
up security lately, right?
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
這裡應該足夠安全，我們可以暫時在這裡交談，請仔細聽我說。
艾斯娜應該告訴過你，最近這裡加強了安保措施，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Anyway, since my location
is being monitored, I can't
risk going inside there. You
need to sneak in on your own
when the guards change shifts. It's an old trick, but it works.
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
總之，由於我的位置正在被監控，我不能冒險進去。
你需要在衛兵換班時獨自潛入。這是個老把戲，但很有效。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
My pass will get you inside,
but you'll only be able to
stick around for 3 minutes
at a time. The Secret Archive is to the right of this laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
我的通行證能讓你進去，但你每次只能停留3分鐘。
秘密檔案室在這間實驗室的右邊。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
When you're finished,
come back and give me
the pass since it'll be real
suspicious if I don't have it.
Good luck to you. This job
is risky, but not impossible.
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
完成後，記得回來把通行證還給我；如果我沒有通行證，會顯得非常可疑。祝你好運。這項任務有風險，但並非不可能。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Remember, you gotta
sneak past that set of
two guards while they're
changing shifts. If you hide
behind a corner and wait for
a bit, you should get lucky.
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
記住，你必須在兩名衛兵換班時溜過去。如果你躲在拐角處等一會兒，應該能走運。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Once you sneak into the
Secret Archive, look for
the File Search Engine that
should be right next to the
door. You gotta use to find
specific information, okay?
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
潛入秘密檔案室後，尋找門邊的檔案檢索引擎。你得用它查詢特定資訊，明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
My suggestion? You really
ought to look for any files
containing any information
regarding ^3355FFRekenber's secret
that Shinokas discovered^000000.
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
我的建議是？
你最好查詢任何包含
^3355FF希諾卡斯發現的雷根貝勒的秘密^000000
相關資訊的檔案。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Remember that this pass
will get you into the Secret
Archive for only 3 minutes
at a time. Be really careful
and don't get caught!
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
記住，這張通行證每次只能讓你在秘密檔案室停留3分鐘。
務必小心，別被抓到！

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
My pass will get you inside,
but you'll only be able to
stick around for 3 minutes
at a time. The Secret Archive is to the right of this laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
我的通行證能讓你進去，但你每次只能停留3分鐘。
秘密檔案室在這間實驗室的右邊。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
When you're finished,
come back and give me
the pass since it'll be real
suspicious if I don't have it.
Good luck to you. This job
is risky, but not impossible.
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
完成後，回來把通行證還給我，如果我不在，會很可疑。
祝你好運。這項任務有風險，但並非不可能。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
You found what you were
looking for? That must have
been like looking for a needle
in a haystick, but you managed
to do it. Great work, guy~
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
你找到要找的東西了嗎？那一定像大海撈針，不過你還是找到了。幹得好，夥計~

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
It's a good thing you
found that when you did.
Although it'd help to steal
even more intel, sticking
around even longer makes
it easier for us to get caught.
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
幸好你找到了那個。
雖然多偷一些情報會有幫助，但停留時間過長會增加我們被抓的風險。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Alright, you better get
out of here and find Esuna
now. Watch your back and
be careful. We're not all
clear until this is all over.
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
好了，你最好趕緊離開這裡，去找艾斯娜。小心身後，注意安全。在一切結束之前，我們都不安全。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Esuna should be right
outside of the city of
Lighthalzen where you
found her last time. She'll
know that you're coming.
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
艾斯娜應該在裡希塔樂鎮外，你上次找到她的地方。
她知道你要來。

scripts.text:
[Lestin]
Oh man...
Everyone here is
getting too paranoid
for their own good!
You better steer clear
from this place for now.
scripts.translation:
[萊斯廷]
天哪...
這裡每個人都變得過於多疑了！
你最好暫時遠離這個地方。

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you approach
the corner, you can
hear hushed whispers
just over the wall.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF當你走近拐角處時，你可以聽到牆那邊傳來低語聲。^000000

scripts.text:
[Senior Guard]
Hey, my shift is over.
Hurry and get the next
guy to relieve me, will you?
scripts.translation:
[資深衛兵]
嘿，我的班結束了。
快點叫下一個人來接班，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie Guard]
Already?
Wow, time sure
flies fast. Fine,
wait here a bit.
scripts.translation:
[新人衛兵]
已經結束了？
哇，時間過得真快。好吧，請稍等一下。

scripts.text:
^3355FFOne of the guards left
his post, and now there
is only one remaining
guard monitoring this area.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF一名衛兵離開了崗位，現在只剩下一名衛兵在監控這個區域。^000000

scripts.text:
[Senior Guard]
Criminy...
I need to go to
the bathroom. Well,
I'm sure nothing will
happen while I'm gone.
scripts.translation:
[資深衛兵]
該死...
我得去上廁所。嗯，我走開的時候應該什麼事都不會發生。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou listen to the
guard's footsteps as
they grow fainter and
fainter into the distance.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你聽著衛兵的腳步聲越來越遠，直到消失在遠處。^000000

scripts.text: Sneak in now.
scripts.translation: 現在潛入

scripts.text: Wait for another chance.
scripts.translation: 等待其他機會

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the perfect
opportunity to infiltrate
the Secret Archive! You
approach the door and
find a device where you
can insert Lestin's card pass.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這是潛入秘密檔案室的絕佳機會！你走近大門，發現一個可以插入萊斯廷通行卡的裝置。^000000

scripts.text: Insert Card
scripts.translation: 插入卡片

scripts.text: Retreat
scripts.translation: 撤退

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou forgot to bring
the card pass that
you got from Lestin.
You need it in order
to open this door.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你忘記帶萊斯廷給你的卡片了。
你需要它才能開啟這扇門。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAfter inserting the
pass, a panel within
the door slides open,
revealing a numeric keypad.
You need to input the correct
password to open the door.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF插入卡片後，門內的面板滑開，露出了一個數字鍵盤。
你需要輸入正確的密碼才能開啟門。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Beep~*
You hear a pleasant
sounding electronic chirp,
signaling that you have input
the correct password. The door
automatically slides open.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*嗶~*
你聽到一聲悅耳的電子提示音，表明你輸入了正確的密碼。
門自動滑開了。

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Retreat
scripts.translation: 撤退

scripts.text:
[Security System]
You have 3 minutes to
search the Information Archive.
When this time elapses, you
will be automatically sent
outside for security reasons.
scripts.translation:
[安保系統]
你有3分鐘的時間搜尋資訊檔案室。
時間一到，出於安全考慮，你將被自動傳送出去。

scripts.text:
^3355FFPerhaps now would
not be the best time to
enter the Secret Archive.
Or at least, that's what
you've decided for yourself.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF也許現在不是進入秘密檔案室的最佳時機。
至少，你是這樣認為的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Eeeeeee*
The door emits an
unnerving, high pitched
screech after you input
the password. You really
should try to input it again.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*吱——*
輸入密碼後，門發出令人不安的高頻尖叫聲。
你真的應該再試一次。^000000

scripts.text:
[Security System]
*Gzzzzz*
You have entered the
password incorrectly
3 times. Please stand by
for managerial assistance.
scripts.translation:
[安保系統]
*吱——*
你連續3次輸入了錯誤的密碼。
請等待管理人員協助。

scripts.text:
^3355FFUh oh!
You better get
out of here before
you get caught!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF糟糕！
在你被抓到之前，最好趕緊離開這裡！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFPerhaps now would
not be the best time to
enter the Secret Archive.
Or at least, that's what
you've decided for yourself.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF也許現在不是進入秘密檔案室的最佳時機。
至少，你是這樣認為的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFPerhaps now would
not be the best time to
enter the Secret Archive.
Or at least, that's what
you've decided for yourself.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF也許現在不是進入秘密檔案室的最佳時機。
至少，你是這樣認為的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis machine can be
used to locate specific
documents within the
Secret Archive. However,
you must enter the correct
keywords to in order to find
specific file locations.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這臺機器可以在秘密檔案室內查詢特定檔案。不過，你必須輸入正確的關鍵詞，才能找到檔案的位置。

scripts.text: Search Engine.
scripts.translation: 搜尋引擎

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^663300- Search Engine Initiated -
- Please enter a keyword -
 
*Search Engine
is case sensitve.
Please do not use
capital letters.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300- 搜尋引擎已啟動 -
- 請輸入關鍵詞 -
 
*搜尋引擎區分大小寫。
請不要使用大寫字母。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Result]
Documents regarding
Kafra Corporation and
Cool Event Corp are
located in Arena 3-2.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜尋結果]
關於卡普拉總公司和酷活動公司的檔案位於競技場3-2。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Result]
Documents regarding
Shinokas are located
in Arena 1-5.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜尋結果]
關於希諾卡斯的檔案位於競技場1-5。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Result]
Documents regarding
S.T.E.I.N are considered
highly classified and
cannot be accessed
through this system.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜尋結果]
關於S.T.E.I.N的檔案屬於高度機密，無法通過此係統訪問。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Result]
Documents regarding
