Ymir's Heart are ranked
as highly classified and
cannot be accessed
through this system.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜尋結果]
關於依美樂的心臟的檔案屬於高度機密，無法通過此係統訪問。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Result]
2nd Class documents on
President Karl Weierstrass
are located in Area 1-7. For
more highly classified files
on Weierstrass, please use
a higher security archive.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜尋結果]
關於卡爾·魏爾斯特拉斯總裁的二級檔案位於區域1-7。
如需查閱關於魏爾斯特拉斯的更高級別機密檔案，請使用更高安全級別的檔案庫。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Result]
Documents regarding
Einbroch are stored
in Area 6-1.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜尋結果]
關於艾音布羅克的檔案儲存在區域6-1。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Result]
Documents regarding
Lighthalzen are stored
in Area 3-3.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜尋結果]
關於裡希塔樂鎮的檔案儲存在區域3-3。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Result]
Documents regarding
Rekenber are highly classified and cannot be accessed by this system.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜尋結果]
關於雷根貝勒的檔案屬於高度機密，無法通過此係統訪問。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Result]
Keyword not found.
Please search another
archive or increase
access permissions.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜尋結果]
未找到關鍵詞。
請搜尋其他檔案庫或提升訪問許可權。^000000

scripts.text:
^663300[Search Engine Close]
File search has been
canceled. Please be aware
that sudden shutdown may
cause system errors.^000000
scripts.translation:
^663300[搜尋引擎關閉]
檔案搜尋已取消。
請注意，突然關閉可能會導致系統錯誤。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis machine can be
used to locate specific
documents within the
Secret Archive, However,
you no longer need to
search through the files.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這臺機器可用於在機密檔案庫中定位特定檔案。
不過，你現在不再需要搜尋這些檔案了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Guard]
This is a
restricted area.
Please keep clear
if you do not have
special authorization.
Thank you for cooperating.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
這是限制區域。
如果沒有特別授權，請保持距離。
謝謝配合。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe door is shut, but
there is a device that
looks sort of like the
entry keypad that was on
the other side of this door.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF門是關著的，但有一個裝置，看起來有點像這扇門另一側的入口鍵盤。^000000

scripts.text: Manipulate device.
scripts.translation: 操作裝置

scripts.text: Investigate further.
scripts.translation: 進一步調查

scripts.text:
^3355FFOnce you touch the
device, it automatically
responds and the door
quickly slides open.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF一旦你觸控裝置，它會自動響應，門迅速滑開了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務將部分物品存入倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's literally thousands
of documents to sort through.
There's no way you can find
something of value here in
just three minutes...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡有成千上萬的檔案需要整理。
你不可能在短短三分鐘內在這裡找到有價值的東西...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait, one of these files
looks pretty incriminating.
It seems to contain the
kind of information that
you've been looking for.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等等，其中一份檔案看起來很可疑，像是罪證。裡面似乎有你一直在尋找的資訊。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717A piece of Ymir's Heart
was uncovered in one of
the mines in Einbech and
immediately transported to
the Laboratory for research.^000000
scripts.translation:
[機密情報]
^8C1717在艾音貝赫的一座礦場中發現了一塊依美樂心臟堆積物，並立即被運往實驗室進行研究。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717However, something
happened to the miners
who discovered the piece
of Ymir's Heart. Apparently,
a beast from Einbroch folk
lore inhabited the area...^000000
scripts.translation:
[機密情報]
^8C1717然而，發現依美樂心臟堆積物的礦工們發生了意外。
顯然，艾音布羅克民間傳說中棲息在該地區的野獸...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's literally thousands
of documents to sort through.
There's no way you can find
something of value here in
just three minutes...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡有成千上萬的檔案需要整理。
你不可能在短短三分鐘內在這裡找到有價值的東西...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis looks like a file
containing information
on President Weierstrauss.
Perhaps there's something
in here that might be helpful.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這看起來像是一份包含魏爾斯特拉斯總裁資訊的檔案。
也許這裡有一些可能有用的東西。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717Karl Weierstrass has
been a long distinguished
politician in the Schwarzwald
Republic and was elected as
its president in the year 984.^000000
scripts.translation:
[機密情報]
^8C1717卡爾·魏爾斯特拉斯是秀髮茲發德共和國一位久負盛名的政治家，於984年當選為該國的總裁。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717Although he has enjoyed
high popularity ratings and
success in his endorsing his
policies, Wierstrass is rumored
to be have some sort of feud
against Rekenber.^000000
scripts.translation:
[機密情報]
^8C1717儘管他享有高支援率並在推行其政策方面取得成功，但據傳魏爾斯特拉斯與雷根貝勒之間存在某種敵對關係。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717Although there is no
need to bring this to the
attention of the media, it
is highly recommended
to monitor his activities
throughout his term...^000000
scripts.translation:
[機密情報]
^8C1717雖然沒有必要讓媒體注意到這一點，但強烈建議在整個任期內監控他的活動...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's a great amount
of information in this file,
but it doesn't look like any
of it will be of help to you.
You should continue with
your search for evidence.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這份檔案包含大量資訊，但看起來對你沒有任何幫助。
你應該繼續尋找證據。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis file doesn't
look like it contains
any evidence that will
help you. You should
continue your search
through the rest of the files.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這份檔案看起來不包含任何對你有幫助的證據。
你應該繼續翻閱其餘的檔案。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's literally thousands
of documents to sort through.
There's no way you can find
something of value here in
just three minutes...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡有成千上萬的檔案需要整理。
你不可能在短短三分鐘內在這裡找到有價值的東西...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a file
containing information
on the Kafra Corporation
and Cool Event Corp.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你找到了一份檔案，其中包含關於卡普拉總公司和酷活動公司的資訊。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717Rekenber Corporation.
in an effort to expand its
power into the Rune-Midgarts
Kingdom, will cooperate with
and support Cool Event Corp.^000000
scripts.translation:
[機密情報]
^8C1717雷根貝勒公司為了將其勢力擴充套件至盧恩·米德加茲王國，將與酷活動公司進行合作並提供支援。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717Although this partnership
has been greatly successful,
Kafra Corporation has been
working to check Cool Event
Corp's explosive growth.^000000
scripts.translation:
[機密情報]
^8C1717儘管這次合作取得了巨大的成功，但卡普拉總公司一直在努力遏制酷活動公司的爆發式增長。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717More than Kafra Corporation's
lobbying, Kafra's 3rd Security
Team stands as a formidable
threat to our success. One of
our highest priorities is to
investigate their activities.^000000
scripts.translation:
[機密情報]
^8C1717除了卡普拉總公司的遊說活動外，卡普拉第三安保隊構成了對我們成功的巨大威脅。
調查他們的活動是我們最高優先順序的任務之一。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717It is believed that Kafra's
3rd Security Team has alrady
placed secret agents in key
strategic locations within
the Schwarzwald Republic.^000000
scripts.translation:
[機密情報]
^8C1717據信，卡普拉第三安保隊已經在秀髮茲發德共和國的關鍵戰略地點安插了特工。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis file is very intriguing,
but it doesn't really cover
any information that can be
considered incriminating.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這份檔案非常引人入勝，但它並沒有涵蓋任何可以被視為定罪證據的資訊。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis file doesn't
look like it contains
any evidence that will
help you. You should
continue your search
through the rest of the files.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這份檔案看起來不包含任何對你有幫助的證據。
你應該繼續翻閱其餘的檔案。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's literally thousands
of documents to sort through.
There's no way you can find
something of value here in
just three minutes...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡有成千上萬的檔案需要整理。
你不可能在短短三分鐘內在這裡找到有價值的東西...^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717...After negotiating with
the existing residents, all of
the property rights were sold
and the city was renamed
''Lighthalzen'' in 865.^000000
scripts.translation:
[機密情報]
^8C1717...在與現有居民談判後，所有產權均已售出，該城市於865年更名為“裡希塔樂鎮”。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717The city was then separated
into three districts. These are
the common trade district, the
old residential district and
the Rekenber Headquarters.
.................^000000
scripts.translation:
[機密情報]
^8C1717隨後，該城市被劃分為三個區域：普通商業區、舊居民區和雷根貝勒總部區。
...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis file covers
Lighthalzen's history.
However, the founding of
the city is common knowlege,
so this document probably won't
have any significant evidence.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這份檔案記載了裡希塔樂鎮的歷史。
然而，城市的建立是眾所周知的事情，因此這份檔案可能不包含任何重要證據。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis file doesn't
look like it contains
any evidence that will
help you. You should
continue your search
through the rest of the files.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這份檔案看起來不包含任何對你有幫助的證據。
你應該繼續翻閱其餘的檔案。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's literally thousands
of documents to sort through.
There's no way you can find
something of value here in
just three minutes...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡有成千上萬的檔案需要整理。
你不可能在短短三分鐘內在這裡找到有價值的東西...^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717........
Our organization purchased
all of western Einbech and
began construction of Einbroch
in 927 in order to obtain more
pieces of Ymir's Heart.^000000
scripts.translation:
[機密情報]
^8C1717...
我們的組織買下了艾音貝赫西部地區的所有土地，並於927年開始建造艾音布羅克，以獲取更多依美樂心臟堆積物。^000000

scripts.text:
[Classified Info]
^8C1717Unofficially, each and
every single factory belongs
to the Rekenber Corporation.
Their highest priority is
to uncover Ymir Heart Pieces...^000000
scripts.translation:
[機密情報]
^8C1717非官方地講，每一家工廠都屬於雷根貝勒公司。
他們的最高優先順序是尋找依美樂心臟堆積物...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAlthough this file contains
surprising information about
Einbroch, none of it can be
considered to be incriminating
evidence against Rekenber.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF雖然這份檔案包含關於艾音布羅克的驚人資訊，但其中沒有任何內容可以被視為針對雷根貝勒的定罪證據。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis file doesn't
look like it contains
any evidence that will
help you. You should
continue your search
through the rest of the files.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這份檔案看起來不包含任何對你有幫助的證據。
你應該繼續翻閱其餘的檔案。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務將部分物品存入倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are several
broken machines lying
around that pretty much
seem completely useless.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF周圍散落著幾臺壞掉的機器，看起來完全沒用。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are several
broken machines lying
around that pretty much
seem completely useless.
However, you catch the
glimmer of a dim light
amongst the scrap metal.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF周圍散落著幾臺壞掉的機器，看起來完全沒用。
然而，你在廢鐵中捕捉到了一絲微弱的光芒。^000000

scripts.text: Investigate it.
scripts.translation: 調查一下

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 無視它

scripts.text:
^3355FFAfter digging through
the discarded machinery,
you find a strange rock that
is about as large as your fist
and shimmers with a faint glow.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在翻找廢棄的機器後，你發現了一塊奇怪的岩石，大小約如拳頭，散發著微弱的光芒。^000000

scripts.text: This might be important.
scripts.translation: 這可能很重要

scripts.text: This doesn't seem useful.
scripts.translation: 這似乎沒什麼用

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis weird rock
might be just the
thing that ^000000Ghalstein^3355FF
sent you here to find.
He was probably right
not to describe it to you.
Words alone aren't enough...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這塊奇怪的岩石可能正是^000000加爾斯坦^3355FF
派你來尋找的東西。
他當時沒有向你描述它，可能是對的。
光靠語言是無法形容的...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFJust because this rock
looks funny doesn't make
it any more special than
the countless number of
rocks you've seen in
your entire lifetime.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF僅僅因為這塊岩石看起來奇怪，並不意味著它比你一生中見過的無數塊岩石更特別。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhat can possibly
be of value in this
pile of useless junk?^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這堆沒用的垃圾裡怎麼可能有什麼有價值的東西？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are several
broken machines lying
around that pretty much
seem completely useless.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF周圍散落著幾臺壞掉的機器，看起來完全沒用。^000000

scripts.text:
[Patch]
Tell me what you want.
scripts.translation:
[帕奇]
告訴我你想要什麼。

scripts.text: Current Variables
scripts.translation: 當前變數

scripts.text: How Many
scripts.translation: 數量

scripts.text: Shinokas - Quest Complete
scripts.translation: 希諾卡斯 - 任務完成

scripts.text:
[Kudiuu]
Holy...!
Will this place
ever get cleaned up?!
^333333*Cough cough*^000000 There's
so much dust here, it's
almost a health hazard!
scripts.translation:
[庫迪烏]
天哪...！
這個地方到底什麼時候才能清理乾淨？！
^333333*咳咳*^000000 這裡的灰塵太多了，簡直危害健康！

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Just...
Leave me alone.
I feel nothing but
guilt when I see you.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
請...
別管我了。
看到你，我只感到愧疚。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Don't take it the wrong
way. I mean, it's not like
you did nothing wrong. I'm
the one who's... Geez. I wish
I could live the way you do.
Someday I'll be strong enough...
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
別誤會，我不是說你一點錯都沒有。是我...唉。我真希望能像你那樣生活。總有一天，我會變得足夠強大...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Hey, you're back. As usual,
you've done a good job. You
look exhausted: did you run
into those thugs again?
Why don't you take a rest?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
嘿，你回來了。一如既往，你做得很好。你看起來很疲憊：
又遇到那些惡棍了嗎？
不如休息一下？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Kazien...
While I was fighting
those thugs, one of the
packages was accidentally
opened, and I saw what was
inside of those packages.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
卡濟恩...
在我與那些惡棍戰鬥時，其中一個包裹意外打開了，我看到了包裹裡的東西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wh-why are you supplying
those things? If we let those
packages get imported by
other countries, it can
cause a lot of trouble...!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為-為什麼你要提供這些東西？
如果讓其他國家進口這些包裹，可能會引起很多麻煩...！

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Stop. Please.
J-just stop it.
I don't want to
hear anymore.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
停下。求你了。
就-就停下吧。
我不想再聽了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hold it, I deserve an
answer! How can you turn
a blind eye and provide just
anyone with ^FF0000hi-tech weapons
and guardians^000000? It's like you're
promoting war and violence!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，我有權知道答案！
你怎麼能視而不見，向任何人提供
^FF0000高科技武器和守衛^000000？這簡直是在煽動戰爭和暴力！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And what about your little
brother Lyozien? He has
no idea what he's doing!
Don't we have a responsibility
to the world to make sure these
weapons aren't distributed?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
還有你的弟弟廖齊恩？他根本不知道自己在做什麼！
我們難道沒有責任確保這些武器不被分發嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Shut up! You don't
know anything! Just
shut up! I'm doing this
for the sake of my family!
You don't know what it's like
to live in Lighthalzen's slums!
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
閉嘴！你什麼都不知道！
給我閉嘴！我做這一切都是為了我的家人！
你不知道生活在裡希塔樂鎮的貧民窟是什麼滋味！

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
There'd be days when my
brother and I'd have nothing
to eat. So when I heard about
this job, I took it. What good
is world peace if I'm not even
alive to enjoy it, huh?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
有時候我和弟弟連飯都吃不上。所以當我聽說這份工作，我就接了。如果我連命都沒了，世界和平又有什麼意義呢？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Now, my brother Lyozien is
a gentle soul, has nothing
but love for everybody. So, of
course I can't tell him what
I'm really doing--he'd never
agree to it, believe me.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
我的弟弟廖齊恩是個溫柔的人，對所有人都充滿愛意。所以，我當然不能告訴他我真正在做的事——
相信我，他絕不會同意的。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
I hate this job and what
I'm doing and I want to quit.
But then what? Go back to the
slums? Forget it. As long as
Lyozien is happy, I don't mind if I have to do the devil's work.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
我討厭這份工作，討厭我在做的事，我想辭職。但然後呢？
回到貧民窟？算了吧。
只要廖齊恩幸福，我不介意去幹魔鬼的活。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
At least this way, keeping
it all secret, I can protect
Lyozien from the ugly nature
of this job, even if I'm dirtying my hands, making money
off of other people's deaths.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
至少這樣，通過保守秘密，我可以保護廖齊恩，讓他遠離這份工作的醜陋本質，即使我雙手沾滿鮮血，靠別人的死亡賺錢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But that still isn't right.
You're selling weapons so
that people can kill each other! Even if it's for the sake of
providing for your family...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但這依然不對。
你是在賣武器，讓人們互相殘殺！
即使是為了養家餬口...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Look man, this is what
I decided. I don't care
what other people'll think.
I might go to hell when
I die, but that's my problem.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
聽著，這是我做的決定。
我不在乎別人怎麼想。
我死後可能下地獄，但那是我的問題。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Besides, you adventurers
are always running around
with your swords and magic spells... Isn't that just as bad?
It's not the weapons or the power that's bad: it's how they're used.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
而且，你們冒險者總是拿著劍和魔法到處跑...
這難道不是一樣嗎？
錯的不是武器或力量，而是它們的使用方式。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Granted, most of my clients
are pretty questionable, and
you adventurers usually use
your powers for good, but...
Damn it! Just... Don't come
back. I can't work like this...
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
當然，我的大多數客戶都挺可疑的，你們冒險者通常用力量做好事，但是...
該死！總之...別回來了。
我沒法這樣工作...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Look, I can't have
you working with me
and Lyozien anymore.
Sorry, but it's for Lyozien's
own good. That, and you
make me feel guilty...
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
聽著，我不能讓你繼續和我和廖齊恩一起工作了。
抱歉，但這都是為了廖齊恩好。
而且，你讓我感到愧疚...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Hey now, you better
get a move on. You gotta
assist another delivery to
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
嘿，你最好抓緊時間。你得幫忙把另一批貨物送往盧恩·米德加茲王國。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Ah, I heard from Lyozien
that you guys finished your
delivery. You're probably
the best part-timer that I've
had in a long, long while.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
啊，我聽廖齊恩說你們完成了送貨。
你們大概是我很久以來遇到的最好的兼職人員了。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Anyway, we've got yet
another delivery for the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. It's
weird that we're getting more
orders from there, but orders from other countries are decreasing.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
總之，我們又有一筆送往盧恩·米德加茲王國的貨物。
奇怪的是，來自那裡的訂單越來越多，但來自其他國家的訂單卻在減少。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Eh, I don't have the time
to wonder about stuff like
that. Lyozien's waiting for
you, so get to it, okay?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
呃，我沒時間想這些。
廖齊恩在等你，所以快點去吧，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W-wait! During the last
delivery, I was attacked
by a group of thugs that
wanted to destroy the
packages? Why would
they want to do that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等！在上一次送貨時，我被一群惡棍襲擊了，他們想破壞包裹？
他們為什麼要這麼做？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Look... You're better
off not knowing. Or are
you asking me to pay you
more for this job since
you're risking your life?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
聽著...你最好別知道。
還是說你想讓我因為你在冒生命危險而給你多付點錢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I understand that the
customer's confidentiality
is important, but I'd feel a
lot better if I knew what was
in those packages, and why me
and Lyozien are being attacked.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我理解顧客的保密性很重要，但如果我知道包裹裡是什麼，以及為什麼我和廖齊恩會被襲擊，我會安心很多。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Listen, I'm not obligated--
I can't tell you. Heck, I can't
even tell my own brother what's
in those packages. You can see
that, can't you? Anyway, you
can handle those thugs, right?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
聽著，我沒有義務——
我不能告訴你。
天哪，我甚至不能告訴我親弟弟包裹裡是什麼。你能理解吧？
總之，你能對付那些惡棍，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Right. Now get back to
the Airship and talk to
Lyozien again. Don't give
him any trouble and make
sure you protect him.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
沒錯。現在回到飛空艇，再和廖齊恩談談。
別給他添麻煩，並確保保護他。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
What are you doing
waiting around here
for? You've got a job to
do, so hurry up and do it~
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
你在這裡等什麼？
你有工作要做，所以快點去做吧~

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Hey, you're back. I got a
message from Rune-Midgarts,
telling us they received their
order. Good work! So how do
you like working with Lyozien?
He's one of my best men.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
嘿，你回來了。我收到盧恩·米德加茲的訊息，說他們收到了訂單。
幹得好！那麼，你覺得和廖齊恩一起工作怎麼樣？
他是我手下最好的人之一。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, aren't you and
Lyozien supposed
to be brothers?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，你和廖齊恩不是兄弟嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Whoa, he told you that?
I guess he feels that he
can trust you enough with
that kind of personal talk...
Yeah, he's my little brother.
And a better man than me...
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
哇，他都告訴你了？
看來他覺得已經足夠信任你，才會跟你聊這些私事...
沒錯，他是我弟弟。
而且他比我強多了...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
I've gotten my hands
pretty dirty doing this...
Oh, forget it. You came 
here for a job, right?
Luckily, I got another
delivery for you to work on...
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
我在這行裡摸爬滾打，手上沾了不少髒東西...
算了，不提了。你是來找工作吧？
幸好，我正好還有一單送貨任務交給你...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, Kazien...
I was curious. What
exactly are we delivering?
I mean, not even Lyozien
doesn't know exactly what
is in those packages.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實，卡濟恩...
我有點好奇。
我們到底在送什麼？
我是說，連廖齊恩都不清楚包裹裡具體是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Huh... Does that mean
you can't work with us if
you don't know exactly what
you're doing?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
嗯...那意思是說，如果你不知道自己在做什麼，就不能跟我們合作嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
 Come on, I told
you before--absolute secrecy.
It goes both ways, you know.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
拜託，我之前說過——
絕對保密。
這是雙向的，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Look, for your own good,
quit asking. Knowing what
you're delivering wouldn't
change a thing. Trust me.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
聽著，為了你好，別再問了。知道你在送什麼也不會改變任何事。相信我。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Anyway, this next job is
more of the same. Meet
Lyozien in the international
flight Airship and protect
another package destined
for the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
總之，下一個任務還是老樣子。去國際航線飛空艇找廖齊恩，保護另一個送往盧恩·米德加茲王國的包裹。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Alright, I'll see you
later. The important
thing is that you do the
best job that you can.
And don't give Lyozien
any trouble: that's my job!
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
好了，回頭見。
重要的是你要盡力做好工作。
還有，別給廖齊恩添麻煩：
那是我的職責！

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Lyozien is waiting for
you on the international
flight Airship, so go and
meet him there as soon
as you can. Alright then,
I'll see you later.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
廖齊恩正在國際航線飛空艇等你，所以儘快去那裡和他碰面。那麼，回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Hey, you're back~
Great, I guess that means
that you've decided to work
for us! Alright, let me tell you about your first real job. As
always: ^FF0000keep it on the down-low^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
嘿，你回來了~
很好，看來你決定為我們工作了！好吧，讓我告訴你你的第一個正式任務。
一如既往：^FF0000保持低調^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Go to the Airship for the
international flights, not
the domestic ones, and meet
a man named ^FF0000Lyozien^000000 inside.
He's our courier that'll provide you with further instructions.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
去國際航線飛空艇，不是國內航線，在裡面找一位名叫^FF0000廖齊恩^000000的人。
他是我們的信使，會給你進一步的指示。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Oh. You can talk to Lyozien
about the job, but definitely
not to anybody else. Anyway,
when you're done with what
he asks you to do, come back
to me for another job, okay?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
哦。你可以和廖齊恩談工作，但絕對不能跟其他人說。總之，做完他讓你做的事後，回來找我接下一個任務，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Don't forget...
Talk to ^FF0000Lyozien^000000, our
courier, on the Airship
for the international flights.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
別忘了...
去國際航線飛空艇找我們的信使^FF0000廖齊恩^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Oh, hey, it's you again.
Wait. No. You only remind
me of someone I've met. Um,
have we met before? I don't
remember at all. Oooh, I hate
being this busy, I can't focus!
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
哦，嘿，又是你。
等等。不。你只是讓我想起了我認識的某個人。嗯，我們以前見過嗎？我完全不記得了。
噢，我討厭這麼忙，我沒法集中注意力！

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Arrgh, this is not good.
We are this busy but we don't have enough people,
yet it is not that extrememly bad
to a point that we need to hire more people.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
啊，這情況不妙。
我們這麼忙，但人手不夠，不過也沒壞到需要再招人的地步。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Will you step back? You are hindering my vision.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
你能退後一點嗎？
你擋住我的視線了。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Oh, hey, it's you again.
Listen, you didn't come here
looking for a part time job,
did you? I already told you
that I can't bring myself
to trust you, you know?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
哦，嘿，又是你。
聽著，你不是來找兼職工作的吧？我已經告訴過你，我沒法信任你，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Look, you're not a bad guy,
so I'm sure you'd be perfect
for some other employer.
Don't feel bad... Um, what
was your name again? Wait,
did you even give it to me...?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
聽著，你不是壞人，所以我確信你會很適合其他僱主。別難過... 嗯，你叫什麼來著？等等，你甚至沒告訴我名字...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
So, were you able to
contact Garins? Or did
you encounter any problems?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
那麼，你聯絡上加林斯了嗎？還是遇到了什麼問題？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I came back to
let you know that I haven't
been able to find a way inside
the Einbroch Laboratory. There
was the guard, but I couldn't
really tell him anything.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我回來是想告訴你，我還沒找到進入艾音布羅克實驗室的方法。
那裡有衛兵，但我真的沒法跟他說什麼。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Whaaaat~?
I'm sure he would
have let you in if you
told him that you had
to talk to Garins, right?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
什...什麼~？
如果你告訴他你需要和加林斯談談，他肯定會讓你進去的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But...
I thought you said
I'm not supposed to
tell anyone the details
of my assignment?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是...
你不是說我不應該告訴任何人任務細節嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Heh... Yeah.
Yeah, that's right.
Heh heh heh! Hahahaha!
Great! I'm happy to say,
buddy, you passed the test!
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
嘿嘿嘿!...是啊。
沒錯，就是這樣。
哈哈哈哈!！哈哈哈！
太好了，夥計，你通過測試了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
H-huh? But I never
even got to see Garins...
I didn't finish the task
that you assigned to me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...什麼？但我甚至都沒見到加林斯...
我沒有完成你分配給我的任務。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Garins is just some
cool name I made up.
He doesn't really exist.
I just wanted to test your
trustworthiness, is all.
Now do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
加林斯只是我編的一個酷名字。
他根本不存在。
我只是想測試一下你的可靠性，僅此而已。
現在你明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I... I guess.
Still, you just tricked
me! How am I supposed
to trust you now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我... 我想是吧。
不過，你剛才騙了我！
我現在該怎麼信任你呢？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Oh... You...
You got a point, there.
Huh, now isn't that ironic? I'm sorry, pal, let me apologize.
Take some time, consider working for me, and then come back, okay?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
哦... 你...
你說得有道理。
哈，這不是很諷刺嗎？抱歉，夥計，讓我道個歉。
花點時間考慮一下是否為我工作，然後回來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
So, were you able to
contact Garins? Or did
you encounter any problems?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
那麼，你聯絡上加林斯了嗎？還是遇到了什麼問題？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I wasn't able to
find him. In fact, I don't
think that Garins even works
at the Einbroch Laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我沒能找到他。事實上，我認為加林斯甚至不在艾音布羅克實驗室工作。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Whaaaat~?
That can't be true.
Well, how'd you
find that out?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
什...什麼~？
這不可能。
那你是怎麼發現這一點的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I happened to ask the
Laboratory Guard, but
he wouldn't even let me in.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我碰巧問了實驗室衛兵，但他甚至不讓我進去。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Uh oh...
I thought so.
I'm sorry, pal, but
you failed the test.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
哎呀...
我就知道。
抱歉，夥計，但你沒通過測試。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
H-huh? What?
What do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...什麼？什麼？
你這是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
You told that to the guard,
but you weren't supposed
to let anyone know any detail
about your assignment. Yeah...
Garins is just a name I made
up. He doesn't really exist.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
你把這些告訴衛兵了，但你本不應該讓任何人知道任務細節。是的...
加林斯只是我編的名字。
他根本不存在。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
I know you meant well,
you know, doing whatever
you can to finish whatever
goal you have, but you can't
forget the details. Anyway,
sorry, but we can't use you...
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
我知道你是出於好意，你知道，盡你所能去完成你的目標，但你不能忘記細節。總之，抱歉，但我們無法使用你...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Remember, visit ^FF0000Garins^000000
in the ^FF0000Einbroch Laboratory^000000
and ^FF0000confirm that he received
his order^000000. We pride ourselves
in our clients' confidentiality,^FFFFFF  ^000000 so keep it secret, got it?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
記住，去^FF0000艾音布羅克實驗室^000000
拜訪^FF0000加林斯^000000，並^FF0000確認他收到了訂單^000000。我們以客戶的保密性為榮，^FFFFFF  ^000000所以保守秘密，明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
I'll just be waiting
around over here, so
once you're done with
that, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
我就在這裡等著，所以等你辦完那件事後，回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Okay, I got it! Your first
assignment for us is pretty
simple, but think of it as
something of a trial run.
You know, for us to see
how reliable you are.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
好的，我明白了！你為我們的第一個任務相當簡單，但你可以把它看作一種試執行。
你知道，為了讓我們看看你有多可靠。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
All you gotta do is head
to Einbroch, find the Lab
there, and find a researcher
named Garins. You need to
confirm whether he safely
received his order from us.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
你只需要去艾音布羅克，找到那裡的實驗室，並找到一位名叫加林斯的研究員。你需要確認他是否安全地收到了我們寄出的訂單。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Simple stuff, yeah?
Now, you can't let anyone
know about your assignment.
Otherwise, we can't trust you
for more important stuff. And
I really wanna trust you.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
很簡單，對吧？
現在，你不能讓任何人知道你的任務。
否則，我們就無法信任你處理更重要的事情。而且我真的很想信任你。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Remember, visit ^FF0000Garins^000000
in the ^FF0000Einbroch Laboratory^000000
and ^FF0000confirm that he received
his order^000000. We pride ourselves
in our clients' confidentiality, so keep it secret, got it?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
記住，去^FF0000艾音布羅克實驗室^000000
拜訪^FF0000加林斯^000000，並^FF0000確認他收到了訂單^000000。我們以客戶的保密性為榮，所以保守秘密，明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
I'll just be waiting
around over here, so
once you're done with
that, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
我就在這裡等著，所以等你辦完那件事後，回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
We're so busy, we barely
have enough people to cover
our workload right now. Still,
it's not so bad that we gotta
invest in some new hires.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
我們忙得不可開交，現在人手幾乎不夠用了。不過還好，還沒到必須立刻招新人的地步。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Oh hey, sorry buddy,
but you mind stepping
back? It's just that you're
blocking my view is all.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
哦，嘿，抱歉，夥計，你介意往後退一點嗎？
只是你擋住我的視線了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, did you just say
that you need help?
I'd like to help solve
your problem, er, for
a nominal fee or some
kind of reward. You know...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，你剛才說需要幫忙？
我想幫你解決這個問題，當然，是收取一點小費或者某種報酬。你知道的...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Hey, alright~
I could use an extra
hand if you're willing
to work part time. Plus,
you're a straight shooter.
I like that. Let's see now...
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
嘿，好啊~
如果你願意做兼職，我確實需要多一雙手。
而且，你是個直率的人。
我喜歡這樣。讓我想想...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Awww, I'm sorry, pal.
I know you mean well, but
to put it bluntly, you're not
not strong enough for this
kinda work. Hey, but if you put on
some muscle, ask me again, okay?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
哎呀，抱歉，朋友。
我知道你是一番好意，但直白地說，你的力氣還不足以勝任這種工作。
嘿，如果你能練出點肌肉，再來找我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Yeah, okay. You look like
you can handle this. But
are you the type of person
I can trust? Hey, you can
keep confidential information
without telling anyone, right?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
嗯，好的。你看起來能勝任這份工作。但是，你是那種我可以信任的人嗎？
嘿，你能保守機密，不告訴任何人，對吧？

scripts.text: Yes, of course.
scripts.translation: 是的，當然

scripts.text: Nope, I love giving away secrets.
scripts.translation: 不，我熱愛分享秘密

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Great, great.
I guess we can just
get down to business,
then. Let me think. First,
I should give you something
easy to do to test you out...
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
很好，很好。
看來我們可以直接談正事了。
讓我想想。首先，我應該給你一件簡單的事做做測試...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Awww, man.
I can't hire you
if you're gonna blab
your mouth. Sorry buddy,
but I can't afford to take
any risks. You understand...
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
哎呀，真是的。
如果你到處亂說，我就不能僱你了。
抱歉，夥計，我承擔不起任何風險。
你懂的...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
We're so busy, we barely
have enough people to cover
our workload right now. Still,
it's not so bad that we gotta
invest in some new hires.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
我們忙得不可開交，現在人手幾乎不夠用了。不過還好，還沒到必須立刻招新人的地步。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Oh hey, sorry buddy,
but you mind stepping
back? It's just that you're
blocking my view is all.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
哦，嘿，抱歉，夥計，你介意往後退一點嗎？
只是你擋住我的視線了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Lately, Kazien seems
to be having a hard time
managing his business.
Always complaining that
he lacks the manpower...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
最近，卡濟恩似乎在經營生意上遇到了困難。
他總是抱怨人手不足...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I don't know what kind of
business he's conducting,
but why don't you help him
out? I don't believe that any
particularly special skills are
required for some positions.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我不知道他在做什麼生意，但為什麼你不幫他一把呢？
我相信某些職位並不需要特別特殊的技能。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Well, if you're interested,
you can find Kazien inside
the corporation building.
Young people like him should
never be too proud to ask for help. He still needs to learn...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯，如果你感興趣，你可以在公司大樓裡找到卡濟恩。
像他這樣的年輕人不應該因為求助而感到驕傲。他還需要學習...

scripts.text:
[Laboratory Guard]
Hold it! This is
a restricted area to
the public! Unless you
have some special business,
you'll have to leave right now.
scripts.translation:
[實驗室衛兵]
站住！這裡是禁止公眾進入的區域！
除非你有特別的事務，否則你必須立刻離開。

scripts.text: Actually, I do have business here.
scripts.translation: 實際上，我確實有事務要辦

scripts.text: Whoa, I'm leaving!
scripts.translation: 哇，我這就走！

scripts.text:
[Laboratory Guard]
Yes? State the nature
of your business here,
as well as any person that
you wish to contact inside
of this laboratory facility.
scripts.translation:
[實驗室衛兵]
是嗎？請說明你在這裡的事務性質，以及你想在這個實驗室設施內聯絡的任何人。

scripts.text: I need to see Mr. Garins...
scripts.translation: 我要見加林斯先生...

scripts.text: I'll... come back later.
scripts.translation: 我...稍後再來

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I need to see Mr. Garins
and confirm that he received
a package that was sent to him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我要見加林斯先生，並確認他是否收到了寄給他的包裹。

scripts.text:
[Laboratory Guard]
Garins, eh?
Alright, let me check
the employee list. Hmm...
Garins... Garins... Eh?
He's not here. Maybe you
came to the wrong place?
scripts.translation:
[實驗室衛兵]
加林斯？
好的，讓我查一下員工名單。嗯...
加林斯...加林斯...咦？
這裡沒有這個人。你是不是來錯地方了？

scripts.text:
[Laboratory Guard]
Sorry, but it looks like
you've wasted your time.
We don't have a Garins
working here. Anyway,
I still can't allow you to
enter the laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[實驗室衛兵]
抱歉，看來你白跑一趟了。
我們這裡沒有叫加林斯的員工。
總之，我還是不能讓你進入實驗室。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll... come back later.
(^333333I better speak to Kazien
and let him know I'm having
trouble getting past this
guard. Otherwise, I might
never finish this job!^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我...稍後再來。
(^333333我得去和卡濟恩談談，告訴他我被這個衛兵攔住了。
不然，我可能永遠都完不成這個任務了！^000000)

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa, I'm leaving!
(^333333I better speak to Kazien
and let him know I'm having
trouble getting past this
guard. Otherwise, I might
never finish this job!^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇，我這就走！
(^333333我得去和卡濟恩談談，告訴他我被這個衛兵攔住了。
不然，我可能永遠都完不成這個任務了！^000000)

scripts.text:
[Laboratory Guard]
This area is restricted
to the public. Unless you
have some kind of special
authorization, I'm going
to have to ask you to leave.
scripts.translation:
[實驗室衛兵]
此區域禁止公眾進入。
除非你有特殊的通行證，否則我必須請你離開。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Hey, I hear from my
brother that you can't work
with us anymore because
of some scheduling conflict.
I'm sorry to hear that: it was
really good working with you...
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
嘿，我聽說因為排班衝突，你不能再和我們合作了。
聽到這個訊息我很遺憾：
和你共事真的很愉快...

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Oh good, you're back.
Mr. Ahman just left and
picked up his goods. We're
done here, so all you have to
do now is report to my
brother in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
哦，你回來了。
阿赫曼先生剛走，已經取走了他的貨物。我們這邊結束了，你現在只需要去裡希塔樂鎮向我哥哥彙報即可。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
You sure you're alright?
You seem kind of upset.
Do you need to take a
break or something?
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
你確定沒事嗎？
你看起來有點不高興。
需要休息一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Heya, keep up the
good work. Once you
talk to Mr. Ahman inside
Izlude Airport, we'll be
done with this delivery.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
嘿，繼續加油。
等你在依斯魯得機場和阿赫曼先生談完，這次配送任務就結束了。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Whoa, you were great!
There were more of them
this time, but you easily
dispatched them. Great job!
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
哇，你太厲害了！
這次它們更多，但你輕鬆就解決了。幹得好！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thanks, but...
Now I'm really worried
about what could be in
those packages. Are you
sure you don't know, Lyozien?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝，但是...
我現在真的很擔心那些包裹裡裝的是什麼。
你確定不知道嗎，廖齊恩？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
You don't know when to
stop, do you? Nah, I don't
know at all. Besides, so long
as my brother says it's a bad
idea, then I don't wanna find
out for myself. Oh, hey...
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
你真是沒完沒了啊。
不，我完全不知道。而且，既然我哥哥說這是壞主意，那我也不想自己去弄清楚。哦，對了...

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Here's a little
something to refresh
yourself after that fight.
Keep up the good work, okay?
Then, we'll be done once you
contact Mr. Ahman in Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
給你一點小東西，讓你在那場戰鬥後恢復一下。
繼續加油，好嗎？
然後，等你聯絡上依斯魯得的阿赫曼先生，我們就結束了。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Okay, just like before, we
gotta get these packages to
Mr. Ahmam. When we arrive
in Izlude, find Mr. Ahman in
the Airport and tell him that
his packages have arrived.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
好的，和之前一樣，我們要把這些包裹送到阿赫曼先生那裡。當我們到達依斯魯得時，在機場找到阿赫曼先生，告訴他他的包裹到了。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
W-wait...
Did you hear that?
I heard--I think it's them.
Those thugs are back! Don't
let them damage the packages!
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
等...等一下...
你聽到了嗎？
我聽到--我想是它們。
那些惡棍又回來了！
別讓他們損壞包裹！

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
I heard that you upset
Kyozien a little bit with
your questions. I mean,
I totally understand, but
you gotta remember that
we've got obligations.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
我聽說你的問題讓卡濟恩有點不高興。我是說，我完全理解，但你得記住，我們有我們的職責。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
I know that these packages
might be putting us in danger,
but I trust my brother. If he says those thugs are bad guys, then
they're definitely bad guys.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
我知道這些包裹可能會讓我們陷入危險，但我信任我哥哥。如果他說那些惡棍是壞人，那他們肯定就是壞人。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Yeah, ever since we were
kids, Kyozien has always
been right. Even though
I'd like to know what's in the
boxes, I don't ever wanna
disappoint him, you know?
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
是啊，從小時候起，卡濟恩總是對的。雖然我很想知道箱子裡裝的是什麼，但我永遠不想讓他失望，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Anyway, that's
enough chit-chat
for now. Let's get
back to work, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
好了，閒聊就到這裡。
讓我們繼續工作，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
I'm lucky that you're
around to keep those
thugs off our backs, eh?
Hey, when you're ready for
another job, just talk to
my brother Kazien, okay?
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
有你在身邊幫我趕走那些惡棍，真是我的幸運，不是嗎？
嘿，當你準備好接下一個任務時，直接去找我哥哥卡濟恩，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
So you spoke to
Mr. Ahman already?
Good, good. Now we can
go back to the Schwarzwald
Republic for our next job.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
你已經和阿赫曼先生談過了嗎？
很好，很好。那我們現在可以回秀髮茲發德共和國，準備下一個任務了。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Just talk to my brother
Kazien and he should give
you any details you need
to know. Man, it's good
that you're working for us.
Those thugs frighten me...
[Lyozien]
Now I feeel much more secure.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
直接去找我哥哥卡濟恩，他會告訴你所有你需要知道的細節。天哪，真高興你在為我們工作。
那些惡棍讓我很害怕...
[廖齊恩]
現在我感覺安全多了。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Now that those thugs are
gone, let's concentrate on
our task. Like before, just
get off at Izlude and then tell
Mr. Ahman that his packages
have arrived. See you later~
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
既然那些惡棍已經走了，我們就專心把事情辦好吧。和之前一樣，在依斯魯得下船，然後告訴阿赫曼先生包裹已經送達。回頭見~

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Oh, thank you!
You saved my life!
As you can tell, I'm
not much of a fighter...
I just ran and hid when
those thugs appeared.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
哦，謝謝你！
你救了我的命！
你也看出來了，我不擅長戰鬥...
那些惡棍出現時，我只能逃跑躲起來。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
That's one reason why
my brother has been hiring
you adventurers-- we need
packages from those hoodlums.
They're always after us...
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
這就是我哥哥一直僱你們冒險者的原因之一——
我們需要有人保護包裹，不被那些惡棍搶走。
他們總是糾纏我們...

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Every time I see them,
they're yelling things like
we're the servants of evil,
or that the packages must
be destroyed. Boy, I sure
am glad that you're here!
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
每次看到他們，他們都在大喊大叫，說我們是邪惡的僕從，或者說必須銷燬那些包裹。天哪，真高興你在這裡！

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Hey, we already have another
package to deliver all the way
to the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
again. Can you believe it? We
seem to be doing a lot of
business around there lately.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
嘿，我們又有另一個包裹要送到盧恩·米德加茲王國了。
你能相信嗎？我們最近在那邊的生意似乎很多。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
It's so far away from
home, but a job's a job.
We're obliged to do what
we're been assigned to do
until we qui--whoa. You
hear that? Wh-what was...?
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
雖然離家很遠，但工作就是工作。
我們有義務完成被分配的任務，直到我們辭——
哇。你聽到了嗎？什...剛才那是...？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Awwww, nuts!
It's those thugs!
I'll explain later, but
for now, please protect
the packages and make
sure they don't get them!
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
哎呀，糟了！
又是那些惡棍！
我稍後解釋，但現在請保護好包裹，確保他們拿不到！

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Hey, would you go see
my brother Kazien to see
if he's got another job for
us to do? I'll just be over
here waiting when you need
to find me. See you later~
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
嘿，你能去見我哥哥卡濟恩，看看他有沒有新的任務給我們嗎？我會在這裡等你，需要我的時候隨時來找我。回頭見~

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Good work, Mr. Ahman just
arrived and picked up his
packages. It looks like we're
done for today. When you're
ready for another job, just
ask to my brother Kazien, okay?
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
幹得好，阿赫曼先生剛到並取走了他的包裹。看起來我們今天的工作結束了。當你準備好接下一個任務時，直接去找我哥哥卡濟恩，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Lyozien, do you know
what kinds of things
we're delivering?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
廖齊恩，你知道我們要送的是什麼東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
No clue. I've been
a little curious myself,
but my brother warned me
not to ask. Besides, I don't
think it makes a difference
to what we gotta do, right?
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
完全不知道。我自己也有點好奇，但我哥哥警告我不要問。而且，我覺得這並不影響我們要做的事，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Anyway, it oughta be
fine. I mean, our clients
are entitled to their privacy
anyway. You've been in that
sort of situation, right? You
know, embarassing orders...
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
總之，應該沒事的。我是說，我們的客戶有權擁有隱私。
你也遇到過那種情況，對吧？
你知道的，尷尬的訂單...

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
No? Eh, just meet up with
my brother to see if he's
got another job for us, okay?
If you wanna find me again,
I'll be waiting right here.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
沒有嗎？呃，那就去見我哥哥，看看他有沒有新的任務給我們，好嗎？
如果你想再找我，我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Alright, when this Airship
arrives in Izlude, get off and
enter the Airport to meet with
a man named Mr. Ahman.
Let him know his order has
already arrived, okay?
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
好，等這艘飛空艇抵達依斯魯得後，下船並進入機場，去見一位叫阿赫曼的先生。告訴他訂單已經送達，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Um, would you mind
treading lightly around
this area, and kind of go
around the piles? Yeah,
these are all pretty fragile.
Thanks, I appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
嗯，你介意在這個區域輕手輕腳地走，並繞開那些堆放的物品嗎？是的，這些都很脆弱。
謝謝，我很感激。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but
are you Lyozien?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，你是廖齊恩嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Hey, are you the one that
my brother Kazien sent?
Nice, I've been waiting
for you. As you can see,
I'm having trouble handling
all of these packages here.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
嘿，你是我哥哥卡濟恩派來的嗎？
太好了，我一直在等你。正如你所見，我處理這些包裹有點吃力。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, Kazien is
your brother? That's
weird, you figure he
would mention that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，卡濟恩是你哥哥？
真奇怪，我以為他會提到這一點。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Oh, yeah, he's been like
that ever since we lived
in Lighthalzen's slums.
Luckily, he joined the
corporation and helped
us improve our lots in life...
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
啊，是的，自從我們住在裡希塔樂鎮的貧民窟以來，他就一直是這樣。
幸運的是，他加入了公司，幫助改善了我們的生活...

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
That's why I appreciate the
fact that he lets me work for
him. I can't let him down.
Anyway, back to business: we
gotta deliver these goods to
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
所以我感激他讓我為他工作。我不能讓他失望。
好了，言歸正傳：我們必須把這些貨物送到盧恩·米德加茲王國。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
I have to ensure that these
packages aren't damaged or
stolen by thieves. Your job is
to go to Izlude, find Mr. Ahman
at the Airport, and tell him that his orders have safely arrived.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
我必須確保這些包裹不被損壞或被盜賊偷走。
你的任務是去依斯魯得，在機場找到阿赫曼先生，告訴他他的訂單已經安全送達。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Once you tell Mr. Ahman
that message, he'll take
care of picking up his own
packages. But yeah, I need
to stay behind to guard these
products in the meantime.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
一旦你告訴阿赫曼先生這個訊息，他會親自去取他的包裹。
不過，在此期間，我需要留下來看守這些貨物。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien]
Um, would you mind
treading lightly around
this area, and kind of go
around the piles? Yeah,
these are all pretty fragile.
Thanks, I appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩]
嗯，你介意在這個區域輕手輕腳地走，並繞開那些堆放的物品嗎？是的，這些都很脆弱。
謝謝，我很感激。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Oh, hello. I've heard
that you had to quit.
It's quite a pity, really.
If it weren't for you, some
of my packages would have
been destroyed by those thugs.
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
哦，你好。聽說你不得不辭職了。
真遺憾。如果不是因為你，我的一些包裹可能已經被那些惡棍毀掉了。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Shouldn't you be
taking a break? Besides,
Lyozien is still waiting for
you on the Airship, isn't he?
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
你不該休息一下嗎？而且，廖齊恩還在飛空艇上等你，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Oh, have my packages
arrived? Good, good.
I appreciate all of your
hard work. I'm surprised
they haven't hired you
full time by now.
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
哦，我的包裹到了嗎？很好，很好。
我很感激你的辛勤工作。真驚訝他們到現在還沒聘你為全職員工。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Is something the matter?
You seem really pale. Oh
well, you'll have plenty of
time to relax on the Airship.
Oh, and don't worry, I'll
take care of the packages.
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
怎麼了？你看起來很蒼白。
算了，你在飛空艇上有的是時間放鬆。
哦，別擔心，包裹我會處理的。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Oh, hello. I'm not
expecting any packages
at this moment, although
I'm aware that there are a
few deliveries in queue, but shouldn't you be in Lighthalzen?
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
哦，你好。我現在沒在等任何包裹，雖然知道還有幾批貨物在排隊，但你不該在裡希塔樂鎮嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Shouldn't you be on
your way and report to
Lyozien? You should hurry
before the Airship takes off.
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
你不該趕路去向廖齊恩彙報嗎？快點，別錯過飛空艇。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Ah, it's you again.
I assume that means that
my packages have arrived
safely. Is that right?
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
啊，又是你。
我猜這意味著我的包裹安全到達了。是嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, that's right.
Actually, this time we 
were attacked by a group
of thugs, so I was wondering
if you knew anything about it...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，沒錯。
實際上，這次我們被一群惡棍襲擊了，所以我在想你是否知道些什麼...

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
They attacked again?
Oh, that isn't good.
Well, I have no idea
what's going on. I wish
I had some idea of what
they were up to, really.
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
他們又襲擊了？
哦，那不好。
好吧，我不知道發生了什麼。我真希望能知道他們在搞什麼鬼。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
For now, you should
go and report to Lyozien.
I assume that you protected
my packages, so thank you
for your diligent work. Now, I shall pick up what I ordered...
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
現在，你應該去向廖齊恩彙報。
我猜你保護了我的包裹，所以感謝你的盡職工作。現在，我要去取我訂購的東西了...

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Oh, it's you again.
Shouldn't you be getting
on the Airship and heading
back to the Schwarzwald
Republic? There are more
deliveries in queue, you know.
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
哦，又是你。
你不該上飛空艇並返回秀髮茲發德共和國嗎？
你知道，還有更多貨物在排隊。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Thank you for letting me
know that my order has arrived.
You should go back to Lyozien
now so you can finish your job.
Perhaps I'll see you again
sometime, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
謝謝你告訴我我的訂單到了。
你現在應該回到廖齊恩那裡，完成你的工作。
也許我們以後還會見面，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Hmm, can you really
call this place an Airport?
It's far too small, wouldn't
you agree? Still, I kind of
enjoy sitting around here.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
嗯，你真的能叫這個地方機場嗎？
它太小了，不是嗎？不過，我有點喜歡坐在這裡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but do
you know where I can
find a man named Ahman?
I have a message for him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，你知道阿赫曼先生在哪裡嗎？我有話要轉告他。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
I'm Ahman, how can--
Oh! You must be here to
tell me that my packages
have arrived. Am I correct?
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
我是阿赫曼，有什麼事——
哦！你一定是來告訴我包裹已經到了，對嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Y-yes. That's right.
Your packages have
arrived and they're
being guarded until
you come to pick them up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，沒錯。
你的包裹已經到了，正在被看守，直到你來取。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Ah, that's very good to
know. Say, are you a new
worker for Lyozien and Kazien?
I don't believe I've seen you
around before. Have they finally started hiring part timers?
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
啊，那真是太好了。
話說，你是廖齊恩和卡濟恩的新員工嗎？
我不記得見過你。
他們終於開始招兼職了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, that's right.
Actually, I'm working for
them part time. I heard
they were really busy, so
I sort of volunteered my time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，沒錯。
其實我是兼職幫他們工作的。
聽說他們很忙，所以我就主動請纓幫忙了。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Alright, alright.
I suppose that you
also don't know what's
being delivered in these
packages, just like Lyozien.
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
好吧，好吧。
我想你大概也不知道這些包裹裡裝的是什麼，就像廖齊恩一樣。

scripts.text:
[Ahman]
Well, it's all confidential
information anyway, so don't
worry about it. Thank you for
notifying me about the delivery.^FFFFFF  ^000000 Now, you should go back and 
tell Lyozien. Take care now~
scripts.translation:
[阿赫曼]
這些都是機密資訊，不用擔心。謝謝你通知我貨物送到了。^FFFFFF  ^000000現在，你該回去告訴廖齊恩了。保重~

scripts.text:
[Man]
Hmm, can you really
call this place an Airport?
It's far too small, wouldn't
you agree? Still, I kind of
enjoy sitting around here.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
嗯，你真的能叫這個地方機場嗎？
它太小了，不是嗎？不過，我有點喜歡坐在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Bully]
Damn it! N-next time...
Next time we'll g-get rid
of those damned packages!
^333333*Cough cough*^000000 For now, we
retreat and fight another day!
scripts.translation:
[惡霸]
該死！下...下次...
下次我們一定...一定要毀掉那些該死的包裹！
^333333*咳咳*^000000 暫時撤退，改日再戰！

scripts.text:
^3355FFHey-- there's a slit
in the wrapping on one
of the packages. It was
probably ripped a little
while you were fighting.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF嘿——其中一個包裹的包裝上有個裂口。
大概是你戰鬥時不小心撕開的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou peek through the
slit in the wrapping
that is covering one
of the packages.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你透過包裹包裝上的裂口往裡看。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... my God!
These are... These are
weapons of mass destruction.
There's even parts for assembling guardians, the kinds that usually
defend those Guild Castles...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢...天哪！
這些是...這些是大規模殺傷性武器。
甚至還有組裝守衛的零件，就是那種通常用來守衛公會城堡的...

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
-Don't you have anything to protect, huh?- 
-Are you sure that you're always doing the right thing?-
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
-你難道沒有什麼需要守護的嗎？-
-你確定自己一直做的是正確的事嗎？-

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Answer me! Answer me! Answer meee!
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
回答我！回答我！回答我啊！

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Look man, this is what
I decided. I don't care
what other people'll think.
I might go to hell when
I die, but that's my problem.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
聽著，這是我做的決定。
我不在乎別人怎麼想。
我死後可能下地獄，但那是我的問題。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
Besides, you adventurers
are always running around
with your swords and magic spells... Isn't that just as bad?
It's not the weapons or the power that's bad: it's how they're used.
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
而且，你們冒險者總是拿著劍和魔法到處跑...
這難道不是一樣嗎？
錯的不是武器或力量，而是它們的使用方式。

scripts.text:
[Kazien]
There'd be days when my
brother and I'd have nothing
to eat. So when I heard about
this job, I took it. What good
is world peace if I'm not even
alive to enjoy it, huh?
scripts.translation:
[卡濟恩]
有時候我和弟弟連飯都吃不上。所以當我聽說這份工作，我就接了。如果我連命都沒了，世界和平又有什麼意義呢？

scripts.text:
[Lyozien Switch]
Input password.
Enter 0 to cancel.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩開關]
輸入密碼。
輸入0取消。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien Switch]
Incorrect.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩開關]
錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien Switch]
Canceled.
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩開關]
已取消。

scripts.text:
[Lyozien Switch]
Do you want to
turn the Lyozien
NPC ON or OFF?
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩開關]
你要將廖齊恩NPC
開啟還是關閉？

scripts.text: On
scripts.translation: 開啟

scripts.text: OFF
scripts.translation: 關閉

scripts.text:
[Lyozien Switch]
Lyozien NPC is
now {0}.
 
/mm airplane_01.gat 96 48
scripts.translation:
[廖齊恩開關]
廖齊恩NPC現在是{0}狀態。
 
/mm airplane_01.gat 96 48
